Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS Company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions.

Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAITM Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data - such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

How We Do It

From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is advancing smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics and time of use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAITM energy analytics provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

For more information, please visit-

Website: www.bidgely.com

Blog: bidgely.com/blog

How You Fit In

You will act as the GM of your problem space, balancing customer empathy, product excellence, and business impact. You are data-obsessed, have a bias-to-action, and fluent in transforming insights into scalable CX outcomes. Standout candidates will be AI-native—comfortable articulating an ML-powered alue proposition and using GenAI tools for speed and scale.

You will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, with responsibility for the end-to-end product lifecycle, from roadmap and design to launch and enablement.

What You’ll Do

Own a customer problem area end‐to‐end: define the vision, strategy, metrics, and delivery to the market; shape a 6-12‐month roadmap. 
Discover & prioritize through market analysis, customer interviews, data mining, and experiment results. 
Write & drive clear PRDs/specs; partner with Design Team to deliver accessible, intuitive UX across channels. 
Collaborate with Engineering & Data Science to ship solutions incrementally, including data

integrations, data engines, multi-application channel UX

Measure outcomes (adoption, CSAT/NPS, call deflection, savings, reliability SLOs); run A/B tests;
Enable GTM with crisp positioning, packaging, and launch plans; support client success and pre‐sales narratives. 
Represent the product with utility clients, regulators, and internal execs; communicate trade‐offs & decisions in writing. 

What Makes You Successful

4–7+ years in Product Management with SaaS + data/analytics; 2+ years owning a CX/engagement or data‐driven product. 
Strong technical fluency: read APIs, reason about data models, eventing, and privacy/consent implications. Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and non-technical customers alike. 
Proven strategy → execution muscle: experience in shipping multi‐quarter roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable processes. 
Facility with experimentation and product analytics; comfort with funnels, cohorts, and AB testing. 
Excellent writing & stakeholder leadership; can align execs and clients around trade‐offs. 
Domain bonus: utilities/energy (DSM/DR, TOU rates, DER/EV/solar), CSR tooling, or regulated industries. 

Nice to Have

Experience with load disaggregation or energy analytics; GenAI applications in CX and internal tooling. 
Working with enterprise buyers, procurements, and security/compliance reviews. 

Core Competencies

Product Visionary – Connects customer needs, data insights, and business growth to a cohesive product direction. 
Bias for Action – Turns insights into results in days and weeks, not quarters. 
Data‐Driven Storyteller – Uses data and experimentation to inform judgment, trade‐offs, and

prioritization.

Polished Communicator – Crafts clear narratives for executives, cross‐functional peers, and

customers.

Hands‐On Technical Aptitude – Understands APIs, models, and AI tools; can prototype or debug to unblock progress. 
Customer‐Centric Leader – Demonstrates empathy for end users and utility partners alike. 
Team Leader – Builds collaboration, motivates cross‐functional teams, and raises the product bar. 

Why Join Bidgely?

Shape the future of clean energy. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers

experience, understand, and participate in the energy transition — from electrification and EVs to smarter home engagement.

Build at scale, backed by real impact. Bidgely’s platform already analyzes billions of energy data points daily; you’ll lead initiatives that amplify that reach through data, AI, and design. 
Join a global, high-caliber team. Collaborate with passionate engineers, designers, data scientists, and utility innovators across Silicon Valley, India, and Europe — all driven by a shared mission to decarbonize intelligently. 
Thrive in a culture of ownership and innovation. Expect autonomy, transparency, and a bias for action — we value ideas over hierarchy and results over noise. 
Grow your craft and your career. With access to cutting-edge GenAI tools, continuous learning opportunities, and visible impact across markets, you’ll have the runway to evolve as a product leader and shape the next chapter of UtilityAITM. 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

As the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build the platform foundation for understanding how customers adopt and get value from our solutions. You’ll partner with Platform leadership and a dedicated engineering team to deliver shared capabilities that produce trustworthy usage and outcomes data, giving Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams clearer insight to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Through strong product judgment, data-driven learning, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll help teams replace one-off approaches with scalable capabilities, expanding what’s possible for the purpose-driven people and organizations Blackbaud serves.

Own the backlog and product lifecycle for platform capabilities serving engineering and analytics teams, from discovery and validation through delivery and adoption.

Experience using agile development practices and tools such as Azure DevOps to deliver products across cross-functional teams.

Job Description
Product Manager – AI & Enterprise Platforms
Company: Ekshvaku Tech Innovations
Location: Hyderabad / Remote (India)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 7–12+ years overall, including at least 4 years in Product Management
Domain: AI/ML, Healthcare Technology, Digital Health, Enterprise SaaS
About the Role
Ekshvaku Tech Innovations is looking for an experienced, strategic, proactive and highly client-focused Product Manager – AI & Enterprise Platforms to lead product discovery, strategy, roadmap planning and execution for AI-powered healthcare and enterprise digital solutions.
We are seeking someone who can independently explore product vision, research market opportunities, analyze competitor products, identify feature gaps and recommend innovative capabilities that transform digital applications into competitive, scalable and enterprise-grade platforms.
The ideal candidate must combine strong product management expertise with excellent client relationship management, emotional intelligence, patience, technical understanding and hands-on execution capabilities.
This is not a traditional Product Owner or backlog management position. The successful candidate must be capable of independently shaping product direction, presenting evidence-based recommendations, managing demanding stakeholders and translating approved strategies into actionable product requirements.
The role requires significant ownership of product outcomes while ensuring major product decisions, strategic priorities and investments receive appropriate stakeholder approval.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap
Independently research and evaluate product vision, market positioning and long-term opportunities.
Understand business objectives, customer expectations and market requirements to shape product direction.
Assess existing product capabilities and identify gaps, limitations and improvement opportunities.
Develop short-term, medium-term and long-term product strategies and roadmaps.
Proactively recommend innovative features, integrations, workflows and enhancements.
Evaluate product opportunities based on customer value, competitive differentiation, technical feasibility and commercial potential.
Prepare product proposals, business cases and roadmap recommendations for stakeholder approval.
Define measurable product objectives and success metrics.
Balance product innovation, customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities.
2. Market Research, Competitor Analysis & Product Innovation
Continuously research competing healthcare AI, digital health, enterprise SaaS and AI-enabled platforms.
Analyze competitor features, user experiences, workflows, pricing, AI capabilities and enterprise offerings.
Conduct competitive benchmarking through product trials, demonstrations, documentation and industry research.
Identify missing features, emerging customer needs and opportunities for competitive differentiation.
Prepare structured competitor comparison matrices, market assessments and product gap analysis reports.
Research emerging technologies and evaluate their practical relevance to product development.
Recommend differentiated features and product improvements supported by market evidence.
Proactively identify what should be built next rather than relying solely on stakeholder-provided requirements.
3. Healthcare AI & Digital Health Product Management
Understand digital healthcare platforms, patient-facing applications, provider workflows and healthcare enterprise systems.
Research healthcare use cases involving clinical decision support, patient engagement, clinical documentation, care coordination and workflow automation.
Identify opportunities to enhance healthcare products through AI-powered features and improved user experiences.
Collaborate with healthcare domain experts to understand clinical workflows and validate product requirements.
Understand Protected Health Information (PHI), healthcare data privacy, security and applicable regulatory considerations.
Demonstrate awareness of HIPAA and other relevant healthcare compliance requirements.
Evaluate interoperability requirements involving EHR/EMR systems, HL7, FHIR and healthcare APIs.
Ensure healthcare-specific features undergo appropriate clinical, technical, privacy and regulatory review.
4. Enterprise Product Development & Transformation
Drive the evolution of existing applications into scalable, secure and enterprise-ready platforms.
Identify and define enterprise requirements, including:
Multi-tenancy and tenant isolation.
Role-based access control (RBAC).
Single Sign-On (SSO) and enterprise identity management.
Enterprise security, authentication and audit trails.
API-first architecture and third-party integrations.
Healthcare interoperability and EHR/EMR connectivity.
Scalability, performance, reliability and availability.
Enterprise administration, monitoring and reporting.
Configurable workflows and intelligent automation.
Data governance, privacy and compliance.
Enterprise deployment and configuration options.
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to assess technical feasibility.
Define enterprise MVP scope, phased releases and product maturity roadmaps.
Evaluate enterprise customer requirements, adoption barriers and implementation considerations.
Recommend capabilities that strengthen enterprise adoption and commercial viability.
5. AI/ML Product Management
Identify practical opportunities to integrate AI/ML into healthcare and enterprise products.
Understand Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI and intelligent automation.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to translate business requirements into AI-powered product capabilities.
Define measurable quality expectations and acceptance criteria for AI features.
Understand hallucination risks, grounding, accuracy, reliability, latency, safety and operational costs.
Evaluate AI governance, human-in-the-loop controls and responsible AI requirements.
Collaborate with AI quality and engineering teams to evaluate product performance and readiness.
Research competing AI solutions and recommend relevant innovations.
Balance AI innovation with reliability, user value, safety and enterprise requirements.
Hands-on AI/ML coding is not mandatory, but candidates must possess sufficient technical understanding to engage meaningfully with AI/ML engineers and solution architects.
6. Client Relationship Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a primary product-facing point of contact for clients, product sponsors and senior business stakeholders.
Build and maintain strong, professional and long-term client relationships based on trust, transparency and consistent communication.
Demonstrate exceptional patience, emotional intelligence and professionalism when managing demanding clients and challenging situations.
Actively listen to client concerns, understand underlying business needs and respond thoughtfully.
Confidently conduct client meetings, product discovery workshops, feature demonstrations and roadmap discussions.
Manage difficult conversations, conflicting priorities, changing expectations and critical feedback with maturity and composure.
Maintain a calm, respectful and solution-oriented approach during escalations and high-pressure situations.
Communicate technical and AI-related concepts clearly to business and non-technical stakeholders.

Respectfully challenge stakeholder assumptions using research, evidence and sound product reasoning.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. Meesho is India’s e-commerce marketplace, on a mission to democratise internet commerce.

Our multi-sided technology platform connects four key stakeholders - consumers, sellers, logistics partners, and content creators - to power inclusive growth at scale.

We enable individuals and small businesses to sell online with ease, offering access to a wide customer base, integrated logistics, payment solutions, and platform support.

For customers, Meesho offers a broad and affordable selection, tailored for diverse needs across Bharat. We also empower creators to build commerce-driven content that drives discovery and engagement.

LinkedIn Instagram YouTube Facebook Twitter Website

Benefits & perks

Health & Insurance

Medical Insurance: Base cover of ₹6 lakhs for employees and their families, including coverage for LGBTIQ+ and live-in partners, with day-1 coverage for pre-existing conditions.

Accident & Life Insurance: Personal accident insurance up to 3x CTC and term life insurance up to 2x CTC.

Wellbeing Support: Free doctor consultations, telehealth services, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Leave & Time Off

Parental & Childcare Support: Gender-neutral parental leave, including 30 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers, 30 days for secondary caregivers, adoption assistance (up to ₹1 lakh), and pet adoption leave.

Wellness & Special Leaves: Company-wide "Reset & Recharge" leaves (approx. 11 days), infinite wellness leaves (up to 365 days), and bereavement/paid time off (around 20 days/year).

Financial Benefits & Equity

Stock Options (ESOPs): Direct ownership via MeeSOPs with employee-friendly vesting schedules and periodic buyback opportunities.

Retirement & Planning: Provident Fund (PF), Gratuity, National Pension System (NPS) contribution options, and flexible benefit plan (FBP) tax benefits.

Work Culture & Learning

#RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About The Position

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform to be part of making that happen.

Position Overview

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership – Cloud Platform

Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).
Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.
Serve as product owner for one or more development teams, owning the definition, prioritization, and hygiene of the backlog from concept through delivery.
Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration

Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.
Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.
Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the product point of contact for cloud platform capabilities across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success.
Ensure endpoint cloud capabilities integrate with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, improving analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience.
Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal users to gather first-hand requirements, validate solutions, and understand operational challenges at scale.
Brief Endpoint Security product leadership on roadmap status, delivery plans, and risks, and provide technical input to Product Marketing as needed.

Metrics & Quality

Define and track product success metrics for cloud platform capabilities, spanning deployment and adoption, migration progress, platform reliability and performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

Key Qualifications

Experience & Expertise

5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years as a product manager at an endpoint security vendor (EPP, EDR, or XDR).
Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.
Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Technical Acumen

Sufficient technical depth to make product decisions involving endpoint agents, agent-to-cloud communication, device enrollment and identity, policy distribution, telemetry pipelines, and operating-system considerations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.
Hands-on experience with agile development practices and serving as product owner for engineering teams.

Product Skills & EQ

Strong decision-making and follow-through, including defining the problem, evaluating alternatives and trade-offs, and measuring results against success criteria.
Highly detail oriented, with the ability to manage complex dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams.
Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to engineers, leadership, and customers.
High EQ and a collaborative approach to partnering across functional teams and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading large-scale endpoint or cloud migrations, product consolidation, or re-platforming initiatives.
Experience with device management, enrollment, or provisioning at scale (e.g., MDM/UEM or similar).
Prior hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering, before moving into product management.

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

Equity for all employees 
18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
Training and career development programs 
Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Job Summary
Senior Product Manager 
Own the collections product for mPokket’s lending business. Improve recovery and reduce roll rates and collection costs while making agents more productive and treating borrowers in financial distress with dignity.
Roles & Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
1. Recovery & Roll-Rate Strategy
Own recovery and roll rates across days-past-due (DPD) buckets, from DPD7 through DPD180+, with a focus on early delinquency.
Use cohort data, borrower interviews and agent observations to identify recovery opportunities. Test early-bucket reminders and improve settlement logic to protect margins.
2. Cost to Collect & Agent Productivity
Reduce the cost per rupee recovered by balancing automation, agent capacity and channel mix. Test voice-bot strategies against recovery and cost metrics.
Shadow collections agents and improve workflows, tooling and the way agents record call outcomes.
3. Borrower Experience & Cross-functional Delivery
Design collections and repayment journeys that help borrowers in financial distress resolve outstanding balances with dignity.
Work with Risk, Data Science, Collections Operations, Engineering, Compliance and Customer Support to run experiments and deliver product improvements.
Success in the First Six Months
Use your own analysis to identify and explain the biggest opportunities to improve recovery.
Run at least one live experiment that meaningfully improves recovery or roll rate.
Shadow agents and fix at least one recurring issue in their workflow.
Build trust with Risk and Collections Operations. Exercise independent judgment and demonstrate the outcome of a decision your manager initially questioned.
What We’re Looking For
Take ownership of ambiguous problems. Use data, borrower conversations and agent observations to diagnose the issue and write your own brief.
Build a plan when the next step is unclear. Aim to ship an initial version in two weeks and use the results to decide what to do next.
Interpret cohort data, spot anomalies and ask analysts precise follow-up questions. SQL is optional.
Show empathy for borrowers in financial distress and communicate your product reasoning clearly in writing.
Prior lending or fintech experience is welcome. We provide training in credit, DPD, regulation and collections strategy. An MBA and top-tier consulting experience are optional.
Selection Process
Roadmap exercise. Prepare a brief within 48 hours outlining your problem framing, the data you need, your top three ideas and what you would ship in the first two weeks.
Working session. Discuss the brief and explain how you would revise it as new information emerges.
Product discussion. Walk through one product decision that worked and one that did not.
Reference checks. We select references, including a peer, to discuss your ownership and judgment.
How to Apply
A 200–400 word note about an ambiguous problem you owned end to end. Explain the problem, your actions, the outcome and what you would do differently.
One writing sample, such as a product requirements document, strategy memo or post-mortem, that shows your reasoning.

Define and deliver the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a new sales strategy and operations platform, building foundational capabilities from the ground up across customer segmentation, seller and sales-team assignments, and quota and incentive design support.
Maintain continuity of current business processes while developing the new platform, balancing essential operational needs with long-term platform investment.

Job Description Summary

The AI Delivery Manager is responsible for defining, owning, and executing the end-to-end AI product delivery for GE Vernova Wind. This hands-on leadership role ensures AI products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards while generating measurable business value.

Serving as a strategic and technical bridge across Wind business stakeholders, Digital Technology, AI Strategy, Data Science, AI Architecture, Data Engineering, and delivery partners, the leader will translate business priorities into scalable, user-centric AI solutions. The role will combine hands-on technical problem solving with cross-functional leadership to drive adoption and integration of AI into day-to-day Wind operations.

As the AI Delivery Leader, this individual will personally drive AI delivery from data-readiness assessment and rapid prototyping through POC, MVP, production deployment, and operational transition. By combining strong Wind business-process understanding with hands-on AI expertise and disciplined delivery execution, the leader will ensure AI investments remain aligned with operational priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Job Description

In this role, you will:

AI Data Readiness and Delivery: Work hands-on with AI Strategy, Data Science, AI Architecture, and Data Engineering teams to assess data readiness, resolve data-quality and integration issues, execute POCs and MVPs, and scale validated solutions into production-grade AI products.
AI Strategy and Demand Management: Partner with AI Strategy, Portfolio, and Wind business teams to build and maintain a strong AI demand pipeline, assess use cases for business value and technical feasibility, establish effective prioritization, and enable a stable and scalable AI delivery model.
AI Product Lifecycle Ownership: Own and actively drive AI products from business problem definition and solution design through prototyping, POC, MVP, production deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization.
Hands-on AI Solution Development: Personally engage in rapid prototyping, prompt engineering, data exploration, API integration, solution testing, and troubleshooting using technologies such as Python, SQL, Databricks, Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI.
Partner and Capacity Management: Translate prioritized Wind AI demand into actionable capacity and delivery plans. Lead Program Increment planning and work with OCIO and strategic partners to secure the right technical resources and capabilities for AI delivery.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the primary liaison across Wind business stakeholders, Digital Technology, Data Science, AI Architecture, Data Engineering, and delivery partners to align business requirements, technical approaches, priorities, dependencies, and execution.
Requirements and Backlog Management: Work directly with Wind users to understand business processes and translate complex needs into AI product requirements, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs using Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
AI Testing and Productionization: Establish practical evaluation methods for AI quality, accuracy, groundedness, reliability, and user acceptance. Drive UAT, production readiness, deployment, monitoring, support transition, and post-production stabilization.
AI Risk and Governance: Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for responsible AI, data governance, architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, internal controls, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Standard Work and Operational Excellence: Establish reusable AI delivery patterns, simplify development and deployment processes, and continuously improve AI platforms, workflows, and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.
Performance and Value Realization: Define product KPIs, monitor AI quality, adoption, user feedback, and business outcomes, and drive continuous product improvements that deliver measurable value across Wind.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or another STEM-related field.
12-15 years of overall professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, machine learning, AI, or related technology disciplines, with progressively increasing technical and delivery responsibility.
Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including prototyping, data exploration, testing, troubleshooting, integration, and production deployment.
Strong practical experience with Python, SQL, APIs, and modern data and AI platforms such as Databricks, AWS, Azure, or equivalent technologies.
Practical experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, APIs, AI agents, model evaluation, and enterprise integration.
Demonstrated leadership across business and technical functions, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams while remaining actively engaged in technical solution delivery.
Demonstrated success taking AI or technology products from POC through MVP and production deployment, including user adoption and measurable business outcomes.

Desired Characteristics

Hands-on AI Proficiency: Strong practical experience with Python, SQL, APIs, Databricks, and cloud AI technologies, with the ability to personally prototype, test, troubleshoot, and validate AI solutions.
Generative and Agentic AI: Practical knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, APIs, AI agents, orchestration, evaluation, and production monitoring.
Wind Business Expertise: Strong understanding of Wind Sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, or related operational value streams and the ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve productivity, cost, quality, cycle time, and decision-making.
AI Product Delivery: Strong understanding of the end-to-end AI lifecycle, including data readiness, solution design, POC execution, MVP development, evaluation, production deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Strategic and Technical Leadership: Ability to move comfortably between senior business discussions and detailed technical working sessions, translating complex AI concepts into clear business decisions and executable solutions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Wind business teams, Digital Technology, Data Engineering, Data Science, AI Architecture, cybersecurity, and delivery partners while maintaining clear accountability for outcomes.
Governance and Risk Management: Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including responsible AI, cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.
Process Improvement: Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of AI products.
Influential Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with users, mentor and energize technical teams, influence senior stakeholders, establish a shared vision, and maintain momentum through complex business and technical challenges.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Our Company:

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning. 

You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes

Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria. 
Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region. 
Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. 
Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors. 

Automated Workflow Assembly

Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer. 
Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback. 
Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced. 
Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces. 

How Success Is Measured

Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce. 
Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction. 
Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines. 
Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment. 
Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms. 
Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them. 
Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production. 
Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems. 
Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems. 



Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Product Owner / Product Manager with experience building and shipping Generative AI and Agentic AI products. In this role, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle, turning vision and agentic workflows into a well-groomed backlog of epics, features and sizeable, testable user stories that gives engineering a continuous flow of ready work. Working with the Innovation and Execution teams, the Engineering Manager and the Architect, you will establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, multi-tenant and cloud-ready deployment requirements, and production scaling. You will bridge business strategy, user experience, and cutting-edge AI engineering to build autonomous, reliable, and high-impact AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Backlog & Agile Execution:
Own the backlog end to end: translate complex AI capabilities into clear PRDs, epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Keep a groomed backlog 3–4 two-week sprints deep, with a clear definition of ready, so the Execution team has a continuous flow of work.
Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, and cross-functional delivery with engineers, backend developers, QA, and UX designers.
2. Innovation-to-Execution Bridge:
Work with the Product Innovation team and the Architect to shape new ideas and prototypes into prioritized, ready stories for the Execution team.
Partner with the Engineering Manager on scope, priorities, and predictable delivery (team and individual velocity).
3. Product Strategy & Roadmap:
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap for Agentic AI solutions that solve core customer and enterprise workflows.
4. Agentic Workflow & Requirements:
Define end-to-end agentic experiences and their requirements, including tool use (function calling), memory management, multi-agent orchestration, planning loops, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) fallback mechanisms, partnering with the Architect and engineers on the technical design.
5. Multi-Tenancy, Cloud & Deployment Requirements:
Define product requirements for multi-tenant deployment, including tenant isolation, per-tenant configuration, quotas, and data boundaries.
Work with Infra/DevOps on deployment topologies (cloud, private cloud, on-prem) and their product trade-offs.
6. Responsible AI, Safety & Governance:
Define guardrails, privacy controls, and compliance standards (data security, tenant data isolation, PII redaction, prompt-injection mitigation, and auditability) to ensure safe enterprise deployment.
7. Metrics & Continuous Iteration:
Monitor post-launch adoption (ideas to adoption), task success rates, user feedback, and unit economics (inference costs vs. ROI) to drive rapid, data-informed product iterations.
Required Qualifications

Product Experience:
5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner, with at least 1.5–2+ years directly shipping Generative AI, LLM-powered, or Agentic AI products into production.

Technical Fluency in GenAI & Agents:
Deep practical understanding of LLMs (hosted and open-source), RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool/API orchestration, and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom orchestration), including model serving and hosting trade-offs.

Cloud, Infra & Multi-Tenancy Understanding:
Working knowledge of cloud and Kubernetes-based platforms, deployment topologies (cloud, private cloud, on-prem), and multi-tenancy models (tenant isolation, per-tenant configuration, quotas), sufficient to write sound product requirements and challenge design trade-offs.

Evaluation & Observability Mindset:
Experience defining AI eval pipelines and working with observability/tracing tools to debug agent trajectories and improve accuracy.

Agile Product Ownership:
Proven track record writing epics and user stories with testable acceptance criteria, grooming and managing product backlogs (Jira or similar), and balancing speed of experimentation with enterprise-grade reliability.

Stakeholder Communication:
Ability to translate ambiguous AI capabilities and probabilistic behaviors into clear business value and intuitive UX for non-technical stakeholders and executives.

Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on prototyping skills using Python, TypeScript, or low-code/AI prototyping tools to validate prompts, workflows, and agent behaviors before engineering handoff would be a great plus.
Prior background in software engineering, working with data science, or AI/ML engineering.
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), structured outputs, and fine-tuning/post-training workflows.

What Success Looks Like
Understanding current product, existing AI deterministic and non-deterministic workflows, model performance, and user pain points; write and groom the existing product backlog into epics and user stories for the next 3–4 sprints; align with engineering and leadership on core KPIs and evaluation baselines.
Deliver a prioritized roadmap and detailed user stories for the next wave of agentic capabilities, complete with clear definition of done criteria with the Execution team consuming stories from a continuously groomed backlog.
Work towards continuous releasing of stable product Sdemonstrating measurable improvements in product feature adoption & feature completion rate.

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

We are looking for a talented individual contributor to join a cross-functional product team responsible for integrating the Order & Portfolio Management System with the broader platform ecosystem and building new O/PMS features, with a focus on seamless trade lifecycle workflows from order creation through to position synchronization, reconciliation, and post-trade processing.

What You'll Do

Own features from concept to delivery across portfolio management and order workflows, producing roadmaps and feature specifications through domain deep-dives and requirements gathering for asset class modeling, position keeping, corporate actions processing, IBOR workflows, and order lifecycle management.
Articulate product value propositions drawing on knowledge of portfolio construction, position lifecycle management, multi-asset class coverage, reconciliation against accounting books, and order routing and execution.
Partner with engineers, architects, and platform partners to translate specs into product, bridging portfolio management workflows, trading desk operations, and back-office accounting while coordinating timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across integration workstreams.
Build comprehensive test cases covering position synchronization, asset class behavior, corporate actions handling, order routing, data mapping, exception handling, and end-to-end integration.

What You'll Need

8+ years in front, middle, and/or back-office; 4+ years in product management.
2+ years of direct experience working with PMS, IBOR, and/or OMS platforms, covering position keeping, portfolio construction, asset class modeling, reconciliation, and order management.
Familiarity with how PMS/IBOR and OMS platforms interact with execution venues, prime brokers, fund administrators, and accounting engines.
Experience collaborating with engineers in an agile environment.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams with diligence.
Graduate degree in software engineering, finance, or a related quantitative field.

At Purplle, we sell beauty and personal care brands across general trade (GT), modern trade (MT) and e-commerce. We

are building the sales and order management platform that every one of those channels depends on, from order to cash.

The core objective is simple: create real, measurable value for our sales, finance and supply chain teams by making every

order faster to place, easier to approve and more accurate to fulfil.

You will join as a Product Manager owning this platform end to end, from problem discovery through launch and

adoption.

This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.

You will own the roadmap and backlog of the platform and its ERP integrations (such as SAP HANA), working with

engineering, finance, supply chain and sales teams.

You will turn real channel complexity (credit limits, pricing, schemes, stock allocation, approvals, returns) into clear

product requirements.

Your work will directly drive order accuracy, order-to-invoice turnaround, fewer manual approvals and cleaner

handling of sales returns and credit notes.

Key responsibilities

End-to-End Ownership: Own the platform from discovery and PRDs through design collaboration, build oversight,

launch and adoption.

Roadmap & Outcomes: Own the roadmap and backlog, prioritising by business impact across GT, MT and

e-commerce teams. Define what success looks like for every feature at kick-off and instrument for it: own outcomes,

not just output.

Sales Cycle Ownership: Own the end-to-end flow from order capture through credit checks, approval, ERP posting,

invoicing and dispatch.

Sales Returns: Own the sales return and credit note flow: return reasons (expiry, damage, short shelf life, wrong

delivery), approvals, and how returns reflect in the ERP and stock.

Channel Needs: Understand how sales processes differ across GT, MT and e-commerce, and build products flexible

enough to serve each of them.

ERP & Integrations: Work with ERP and integration teams on how orders, inventory, pricing and returns flow

between the ERP, the platform, other portals and third-party tools.

Iterative Delivery: Run a disciplined delivery cadence with engineering: validate direction early, correct fast, and ship

surgically once something is approved.

Discovery & Stakeholders: Talk to sales, finance and operations users to find gaps; turn ambiguous business

problems into build-ready PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.

KPI Ownership: Own order accuracy, order-to-invoice and approval turnaround, order failure and rejection rates, and

sales return turnaround.

Live Support & Access: Be the first line of support for live issues (triage, root cause, fix) and define role-based access

so each user sees only what they should.

What we are looking for

2-3 years of B2B product management experience, with genuine end-to-end ownership of a product area (not just

feature delivery), ideally on internal tools, order management or sales and supply chain operations platforms used by

multiple user groups.

Strong understanding of how FMCG sales works across GT, MT and e-commerce, including how primary, secondary

and tertiary sales work in GT (company to distributor, distributor to retailer, retailer to consumer), plus credit limits,

schemes, MRP and pricing.

Clear understanding of the full sales cycle: order, approval, invoicing, dispatch, and sales returns and credit notes.
Basic understanding of ERP sales modules (such as SAP SD: sales orders, deliveries, billing, returns) and hands-on

experience with integrations between the ERP, internal portals and third-party tools.

Systems thinking: comfortable reasoning about platforms with multiple integrated modules, dependencies and

stakeholders rather than isolated features.

Strong PRD and user story writing: well-scoped, edge cases covered, precise acceptance criteria, and low-fidelity

wireframes.

Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake. 

This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build. 

Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents. 

Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity. 
AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous. 
Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets. 
Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases. 
Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI. 
SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints. 

Who You'll Work With

You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

15+ years in databases, query engines, or distributed data systems, including senior product management or equivalent principal or staff engineering experience 
Expert understanding of database internals: query planning, cost-based optimization, execution models, and MPP trade-offs 
Deep SQL expertise: a heavy SQL user (data engineer, analyst, or DBA) with strong opinions on language design, ergonomics, and compatibility 
A hands-on performance mindset: reading query plans, designing benchmarks, and finding root causes with senior engineers 
A strong working understanding of LLMs and AI agents, and an informed view on how they change database design and how ML can improve database internals 
Architecture-level knowledge of Snowflake, Databricks, and ClickHouse, and fluency in lakehouse architecture and open table formats 
Degree in Computer Science or a related field; an MS or PhD in databases, distributed systems, or ML for systems is a plus 

What You'll Bring

First-principles thinking and good taste: willingness to question long-standing database assumptions, a preference for elegance over verbosity, customer obsession, daily use of GenAI tools, and the credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers 
The ability to read research critically, separate promise from hype, and design experiments to prove value, with a track record of setting multi-year platform strategy 
A plus: experience designing SQL features or language extensions, hands-on work with optimizers or learned database components, open-source contributions, or publications at SIGMOD, VLDB, or CIDR

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

HighLevel is a powerful platform containing hundreds of interconnected capabilities across CRM, marketing, communications, automation, commerce, websites, calendars, reporting, and AI. That breadth creates enormous value - but it also introduces complexity. Users should not need to know which menu contains a capability, how every object in HighLevel is modelled, or which sequence of screens is required to complete a business task. They should be able to describe what they want to accomplish, receive an accurate answer, and safely complete the work.

Ask AI is the natural-language operating layer designed to make that possible. It allows agencies and businesses to ask questions, understand customer and operational data, generate content and assets, create product configurations, invoke specialised agents, execute supported actions, automate recurring work, and interact with HighLevel through text, voice, structured artefacts, and guided workflows.

For Ask AI to be dependable, it needs accurate and current context. HighLevel Knowledge Bases provide the shared intelligence foundation for Ask AI and the broader AI Employee ecosystem. They ingest and organise information from websites, FAQs, rich text, documents, tables, cloud files, and other approved sources so AI products can retrieve relevant information and produce grounded responses.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own the long-term product strategy for this intelligence and assistance platform. This person will define the architecture, product principles, quality systems, developer model, governance, metrics, and commercial strategy required to make Ask AI the default way users understand and operate HighLevel.

This is not a generic chatbot, enterprise-search, or content-generation role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI assistants, enterprise knowledge, retrieval systems, agent orchestration, workflow execution, CRM data, permissions, automation, developer platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, establish shared platform standards, and make foundational decisions that affect every AI product across HighLevel.

Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Knowledge Bases and Ask AI.
Own the complete Ask AI experience, including chat, voice interaction, conversation history, memory, templates, artefacts, scheduled tasks, tools, actions, agent routing, browser interaction, feedback, permissions, approvals, auditability, usage, and lifecycle management.
Own the Knowledge Base platform across source ingestion, extraction, parsing, chunking, embeddings, indexing, metadata, retrieval, re-ranking, citations, freshness, versioning, testing, permissions, and observability.

Develop a deep understanding of agency owners, marketers, sales teams, customer-service teams, operations leaders, administrators, and SMB employees who use HighLevel to perform daily work.
Personally inspect Ask AI conversations, tool traces, Knowledge Base retrieval results, user feedback, support tickets, source-ingestion failures, incorrect answers, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.

About The Role

At Purplle, we are building a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands that sell across general trade,

modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce. To scale them, we need a planning system that puts

the right product in the right channel at the right time, with the least working capital tied up. We are

looking for a Product Manager to build the core of that system: the products that power demand and

supply planning for our FMCG business.

This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.

Youll work alongside the Senior Product Manager who leads our demand and supply planning

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply

planning products.

Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.

Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line

and on how fast our brands can grow.

Key Responsibilities

Roadmap & Execution: Set a prioritised roadmap with the Senior Product Manager and own

delivery.

and region level, including new product forecasting.

S&OP Collaboration: Build the tool that runs the monthly S&OP cycle and aligns sales, planning

and finance on one plan.

Supply Planning: Take FG Buying live and scale it into end-to-end supply planning.
Stakeholder Management: Work with planners, operations, sales (GT, MT, e-commerce, quick

commerce), finance, data science and engineering to define requirements and drive adoption.

Discovery & Delivery: Run discovery with planners, write PRDs and user stories, and manage the

backlog with agile teams.

KPI Ownership: Own forecast accuracy and bias, fill rate for modern trade and quick commerce,

inventory health (days, excess, expiry) and adoption of the planning products.

AI-Native Building: Identify where AI and LLMs can create outsized value in planning, such as

explaining forecast changes, surfacing demand anomalies and automating routine plan reviews.

Build these into the products, not as add-ons, and use AI tools to accelerate your own discovery,

specs and analysis.

About 2 years of product management experience with clear ownership: you have taken

products from discovery through delivery and adoption, ideally in supply chain, operations or

internal tools.

Hands-on exposure to demand and supply planning: forecasting and how accuracy is measured,

S&OP, and inventory norms (safety stock, reorder points).

Exposure to Indian general trade, modern trade and quick commerce.
Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of SQL; you make decisions backed by data.
First-principles and systems thinking: you break ambiguous problems into structured pieces and

Zero-to-one ownership of demand and supply planning products for a fast-growing FMCG

Role Overview

For most SMBs, a customer conversation is not merely a support interaction. It is where a lead is qualified, an appointment is booked, a customer question is resolved, a sale is advanced, or a relationship is lost. Businesses receive these conversations across SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, live chat, and other messaging channels. Customers expect immediate, accurate, and context-aware responses — but most SMB teams cannot monitor every channel around the clock. HighLevel's Conversation AI product is designed to close that gap.

Conversation AI enables businesses to deploy AI agents that can answer questions, nurture and qualify leads, collect structured information, book and manage appointments, trigger workflows, follow up with inactive contacts, route conversations between specialised agents, and hand interactions to humans when appropriate. The product supports multiple ways of building agents — from guided forms and configurable prompts to visual conversation flows and AI-assisted agent creation. It also includes knowledge retrieval, multi-channel deployment, agent actions, routing, testing, analytics, logs, permissions, reusable snapshots, and APIs for deployment at agency scale.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy for Conversation AI and establish the architecture, product principles, quality systems, operating metrics, and commercial model required to make AI agents dependable across millions of real customer interactions.

It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role at the intersection of AI agents, CRM, messaging infrastructure, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, appointment scheduling, analytics, developer platforms, and agency-led distribution. You will be expected to influence multiple product and engineering teams, make difficult platform-level trade-offs, and turn Conversation AI into one of the most valuable and trusted products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Why This Role Exists 

Voice is one of the highest-intent customer interaction channels for SMBs. Missed calls, delayed follow-ups, poor qualification, inconsistent appointment booking, and manual outbound outreach directly translate into lost revenue for local businesses and agencies.

HighLevel’s VoiceAI product is designed to change that.

VoiceAI enables businesses to deploy AI-powered voice agents that can answer inbound calls, hold natural conversations, collect customer information, book appointments, trigger workflows, send post-call summaries, and support both phone-based and browser-based voice experiences. VoiceAI also supports outbound calling from workflows for use cases like lead follow-up, appointment outreach, prospect engagement, and reactivation campaigns.

The Staff Product Manager – VoiceAI will own the strategy, execution, and quality bar for one of HighLevel’s most important AI products. This role sits at the intersection of AI agents, telephony, CRM, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, compliance, analytics, and user experience.

You will be expected to deeply understand agencies, local businesses, call-heavy industries, and the real operational jobs that VoiceAI must perform: answer calls, qualify leads, route conversations, book appointments, follow up, summarize outcomes, and help businesses scale without adding headcount.

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Tokenization & Stablecoin Infrastructure team and drive the products that let institutions issue, mint, redeem, custody, and move stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets. You will work closely with stablecoin issuers, asset managers, banks, and token foundations, along with engineering, compliance, legal, and go-to-market teams, to bring new issuers and assets onto BitGo's regulated infrastructure.

This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where regulation, market structure, and technology are evolving together. You will own the roadmap, shape strategy, and see products through from first customer conversation to launch and scale.

Own the roadmap, strategy, and execution for BitGo's tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure, including mint/burn and redemption flows, issuance workflows, reserve and settlement integrations, and tokenized asset lifecycle management.
Lead and motivate a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and operations and compliance partners to build institutional-grade solutions.

Partner with stablecoin issuers, tokenized fund and asset managers, banks, and ecosystem and blockchain foundations to understand needs, shape partnerships, and turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off builds.
Work with compliance, legal, and risk teams to make sure every product meets regulatory, security, and licensing requirements across jurisdictions.
Evaluate new chains, token standards, and market-structure developments (for example, tokenized securities, tokenized deposits, and onchain settlement) and turn them into a clear point of view and prioritized opportunities.
Define and track success metrics such as issuer onboarding time, volumes, revenue, and reliability, and iterate based on data and client feedback.
Work with GTM, sales, and client success teams on positioning, pricing, and client enablement, and act as a trusted product partner to key clients.
Mentor junior PMs and help raise the bar for product craft within the team.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, crypto, or financial infrastructure, with a record of shipping B2B or institutional products.
Strong working knowledge of crypto and blockchain: token standards and mechanics, multiple L1/L2 ecosystems, wallets and custody, and onchain settlement.
Understanding of stablecoin and tokenization models: issuance, mint/burn and redemption, reserves, fiat on/off-ramps, and how tokenized funds, securities, or deposits work.

Experience leading cross-functional teams, with the ability to coordinate engineering, business, and external partners and to build consensus in ambiguous areas.

Job Purpose

Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

Key Responsibilities

Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business. 
Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity. 
Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog. 
Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved. 
Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them. 
Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution. 
Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria. 
Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery. 
Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers. 
Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation. 
Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office. 
Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise. 
Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise. 
Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy. 
Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate. 
Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout. 
Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers. 
Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private. 
Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate. 
Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope. 
Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. 
Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

Mobile estate strategy across iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and specialised field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices.

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future.
