Purpose And Scope

The R&D Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma R&D domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner.

The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy.

Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog.
Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities.
Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns.
Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria.
Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner.
Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies.
Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering.
Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness expectations into domain planning.
Define product initiation and handoff criteria; identify and onboard the accountable Data Product Owner before detailed product delivery begins.
Transition each approved product's delivery backlog, acceptance criteria, releases, consumer engagement, adoption, and ongoing lifecycle management to its Data Product Owner; provide portfolio-level coordination thereafter.
Facilitate domain planning, backlog refinement, roadmap reviews and cross-team dependency forums with Core and Value Teams.
Serve as Value Team (VT) captain to align team objectives with approved domain priorities, facilitate planning and progress reviews, coordinate commitments and dependencies, and escalate risks and decisions.
Where assigned, perform Scrum Master responsibilities, including facilitating Scrum events, supporting impediment resolution, coaching the team in Scrum practices and enabling continuous improvement.
Monitor domain-level business value, roadmap progress, adoption, reuse, and bottlenecks; recommend adjustments and improvements to the operating model and ways of working.
Support cross-domain alignment and portfolio scaling while preserving the Data Domain Owner's authority over outcomes, investments, and major prioritization decisions.
When required, provide Business Analyst (BA) support during discovery and mobilization by eliciting user needs, analyzing business processes, and developing requirements, user stories and initial acceptance criteria with stakeholders and the designated Data Product Owner.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or master’s degree in information systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
Seven or more years of relevant experience, including at least three years directly defining or managing data, analytics, platform, scientific-informatics or AI-enabled products
Demonstrated experience translating business outcomes and use cases into roadmaps, strategic backlogs, product definitions, and phased delivery plans.
Experience facilitating prioritization, managing cross-team dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders across business, architecture, governance, platform, and engineering teams.
Understanding of domain-oriented data products, data contracts, canonical models, metadata, governance, and medallion architecture.
Working knowledge of scientific and regulated-data principles, including provenance, traceability, FAIR practices, privacy by design and, where applicable, GxP and ALCOA+ expectations.
Strong facilitation, communication, executive storytelling, negotiation, and Agile/product delivery skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Broader experience across multiple pharmaceutical or biotechnology R&D functions and data domains.[MCR7.1]
Experience with scientific, clinical, operational, safety or regulatory data products and AI-enabled R&D use cases.
Experience with federated or data-mesh operating models, domain blueprints, product certification and enterprise governance.
Familiarity with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Jira or Azure DevOps, metadata and catalog platforms, product analytics, SQL or business-intelligence tools.
Experience defining responsible-AI, model-evaluation, data-suitability or AI-observability requirements in regulated or high-impact settings.
Experience incorporating privacy, security, cross-border data-use constraints and purpose-based access requirements into global data-product planning.
Experience leading global, geographically distributed teams and organizational change.

What awaits you at Astellas?

Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.

Real-world patient impact : Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.

Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future

Job Description

Global Servicing (GS) oversees consumer travel and concierge experiences, all customer service functions supporting the company's global consumer, banking, merchant, and commercial customers, as well as the critical enablement capabilities that power our products and services. GS is committed to delivering the world's best customer experience every day by building on American Express's legacy of service excellence, leveraging innovative technologies to drive transformation, and bringing a human touch to every customer interaction.

We are seeking an innovative and forward-thinking Digital Product Manager, Global Servicing Automation to help transform how we work through automation, emerging technologies, and intelligent process design.

This role will serve as a Product Owner for Global Servicing Automation, supporting the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery of capabilities that simplify operations, reduce manual effort, improve quality, and enhance customer and colleague experiences.

The successful candidate will bring a passion for innovation, strong product ownership skills, and a continuous improvement mindset. As an automation ambassador, they will develop expertise in enterprise automation platforms, including the Automation and Case Management Ecosystem (ACE), while exploring emerging AI and non-AI capabilities to identify scalable, reusable solutions.

This is an opportunity for a curious, independent thinker who challenges the status quo, thrives in ambiguity, and enjoys turning innovative ideas into meaningful business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Drive automation innovation by partnering with Operations, Strategy, Technology, and Product teams to identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve quality, and enhance customer and colleague experiences. 
Own and manage the automation product backlog, translating business needs and strategic priorities into well-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities aligned with the product roadmap. 
Serve as a subject matter expert for the Automation and Case Management Ecosystem (ACE), developing a deep understanding of platform capabilities, integrations, and opportunities to optimize and expand automation solutions. 
Explore and evaluate emerging automation technologies, including AI and non-AI capabilities, to identify innovative, scalable, and reusable solutions that address business challenges. 
Lead product discovery, proofs of concept, and pilots, partnering with cross-functional teams to assess feasibility, define requirements, and validate potential automation solutions. 
Drive product delivery and implementation by collaborating with Technology, Architecture, Operations, and other partners throughout Agile development, testing, release planning, and operational readiness. 
Drive timely and effective decision-making by resolving competing priorities, removing barriers, and ensuring clear ownership and accountability to maintain execution momentum. 
Leverage data and operational insights to inform product priorities, develop business cases, and recommend improvements that deliver measurable business value. 
Champion automation adoption and continuous improvement by sharing expertise, challenging conventional approaches, and encouraging innovative ways of working across Global Servicing. 

Qualifications

3+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, product ownership, automation, process improvement, customer servicing, technology, or related disciplines. 
Experience translating business requirements into product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs. 
Working knowledge of Agile product development methodologies and experience partnering with business and technology teams to deliver solutions. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and independently drive results. 
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and overcome barriers in a matrixed organization. 
Strong communication, organizational, and presentation skills with a high degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability. 
Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, automation, and challenging the status quo to improve how work gets done. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as a Product Owner or Digital Product Manager supporting an enterprise technology platform. 
Experience implementing automation solutions, including workflow automation, case management, robotic process automation, or AI-enabled capabilities. 
Knowledge of customer servicing processes and experience in a large-scale contact center environment. 
Experience redesigning processes to improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience. 
Experience working in financial services or another highly regulated industry. 
Experience developing business cases, managing complex initiatives, or supporting Agile product delivery. 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or a related field; equivalent professional experience considered. 

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will be a trusted Product Owner and automation ambassador who brings innovative ideas to life, makes timely decisions, and works effectively across teams to deliver meaningful results.

They will help Global Servicing move beyond automating existing tasks to reimagining how work gets done—creating simpler, smarter, and more scalable processes that empower colleagues and elevate the customer experience.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salaries
Bonus incentives
Support for financial-well-being and retirement
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment. 

What You’ll Be Part Of

Manager, Product Management role is responsible for defining and delivering visual experience solutions across HARMAN’s automotive display portfolio. This role focuses on creating scalable, modular, reusable and differentiated solution offerings (HW + SW + UX) that align with OEM needs, consumer expectations, and business objectives.

You will act as the common thread across product lines, driving system integration, roadmap alignment, and commercial success of solutions and UIUX features that are common across product lines.

Your Team

This position reports to Director, Product Management within Strategic Business Unit - Intelligent Cockpit, Product Management Group at HARMAN.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Solution Strategy & Bundled Portfolio Packaging

Define product roadmap, scope and features for solutions that cut across different product families and manage their lifecycle.

Define TAM/SAM/SOM, MRD and PRD for such features

Define solution bundles (e.g., entry, mid, premium cockpit experiences) with clear feature tiers, variants, and upgrade/downgrade paths and price benefits

Drive platform reuse, modularity, and account for regional customization strategies

Cross-Product Integration & Roadmap Alignment

Manage inter-product dependencies for features that are common across product lines and ensure roadmap coherence and release alignment across product families

Define scope, requirements and maintain model reference costs for these common UIUX features

Drive system-level integration across HW, SW, and UX layers for these common UIUX features, managing technical solution differences for the same feature across product families while maximizing reuse

Drive partnerships, sourcing and manufacturing solutions and decisions including Make & Buy analysis for common features

Define HMI requirements, solution KPIs and acceptance criteria for common features

Drive system level testing and validation readiness and chair cross-component issue resolution

Drive profitability and competitiveness through reuse and optimized content for common features

Customer Engagement & Solution Shaping

Partner with OEMs, Sales, and GTM teams to define bundled solution scope, differentiation, value narrative and trade-offs

Translate OEM visual experience requirements into solution architectures and promote cross-product selling

Define bundled pricing strategies, feature monetization, and business models

Stakeholder Alignment & Management

Act as the central point of alignment across other Product managers, Engineering/delivery teams, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and GTM teams for common UIUX features

Own solution-level demos and reference platforms aligned with roadmap vision

Develop customer-facing narratives highlighting differentiation, scalability, and value.

Resolve trade-offs to optimize portfolio-level outcomes

Manage strategic partners supporting the solutions for these common UIUX features

What Makes You A Strong Fit

Education

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Display Technology, Optics, Physics, or related field
MBA or equivalent business experience is a plus

Key Skills

6-8+ years of experience specially in product management, system engineering, or hardware development related to displays
Experience in product or solution management within automotive, cockpit systems, or display technologies
Strong understanding of Software, Hardware & HMI system integration requirements
Strong ability to connect OEM needs, UX, and business value into scalable solutions
Proven experience in cross-functional leadership and system-level thinking
Strong commercial acumen (costing, pricing, business cases)
Strong understanding of global market requirements for displays and UX

Be willing to travel domestic and international Be willing to work from office as required Successfully completing a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

Bonus Points if You Have 

Experience with premium automotive cockpit / luxury OEM display programs Product management experience specifically with displays Supplier management exposure Strong familiarity with automotive or consumer display market.

What You Can Expect

A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week. 
Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
Tuition reimbursement support
Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

You Belong Here 

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology 

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

About Accelerate

Accelerate is InMobi’s AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate’s agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.

We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).

About The Role

You will build Accelerate’s payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.

There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.

You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

What You Will Own

Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate’s success framework depends on your system.


What We’re Looking For

6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms. Strong pluses
You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.


How We Work

Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.


Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Role

HighLevel is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and evolve Custom Objects - a foundational part of our CRM platform. 

Businesses operate around more than Contacts, Companies, and Opportunities. A real estate business may need Properties, an automotive business Vehicles, and an insurance business Policies. Custom Objects allow customers to model these unique business entities, define relationships between them, and use that data across workflows, reporting, integrations, and other HighLevel products.

We're looking for a technically strong Product Manager with deep understanding of databases, data modeling, APIs, and integrations who can work closely with Engineering to take this platform to the next level.

What You'll Own 

Define the product strategy and roadmap for Custom Objects and the evolution of HighLevel's CRM data model. 
Build scalable capabilities for creating custom entities, fields, records, relationships, associations, and permissions. 
Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on data models, schemas, APIs, scalability, data integrity, performance, and platform extensibility . 
Make Custom Objects a first-class citizen across Workflows, Reporting, Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, Forms, Integrations, AI, and other HighLevel products . 
Evolve our API, webhook, import/export, and synchronization capabilities so customers and developers can reliably integrate Custom Objects with external systems. 
Translate complex customer requirements into reusable platform primitives rather than one-off solutions . 
Drive the product lifecycle from customer discovery and technical design through delivery, adoption, and iteration. 
Define and own success metrics across adoption, usage, API consumption, platform reliability, and customer outcomes. 

What We're Looking For 

7+ years of Product Management experience , with significant experience building platform, CRM, data, developer, infrastructure, or integration products. 
Strong understanding of relational databases, entity-relationship modeling, schemas, metadata, and one-to-one / one-to-many / many-to-many relationships . 
Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, data synchronization, integrations, imports/exports, and data mapping . 
Ability to reason about data integrity, scalability, performance, backward compatibility, and system-level trade-offs . 
Proven ability to work deeply with Engineering and Architecture on technically complex products. 
Strong product judgment - able to simplify sophisticated platform capabilities into experiences that are intuitive for SMB customers. 
Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM teams around a clear direction. 

Strong Plus 

Experience building products in one or more of the following areas:

CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics 
Flexible data platforms such as Airtable, Notion, or Coda 
API or developer platforms 
Integration/iPaaS platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io 
Database, ERP, CDP, data infrastructure, or systems-of-record products 

Hands-on familiarity with SQL, APIs, data modeling, or integration architecture is highly valuable.

What Great Looks Like 

You're someone who doesn't just ask:

"What features should we build?"

You ask:

"What capability or primitive should exist in the platform so this problem is solved consistently across the CRM, APIs, Workflows, Reporting, Integrations, and AI?"

You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to go deep with engineers, understand architectural trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and jointly arrive at scalable solutions. 

The decisions you make will help shape how HighLevel models and connects customer data across the entire platform.

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

At MoneyGram, we connect the world by making cross border money transfers seamless, affordable, and secure for everyone. We are a customer centric, digital first, cross border money movement network, serving millions of customers across the globe.

Own the payout rails roadmap: which corridors, rails, and partners we add, and in what order, based on volume, cost, and customer demand

Practical understanding of REST and JSON APIs, authentication methods such as OAuth 2.0 and mTLS, webhooks, and idempotency. You can read a partner API specification and a raw request and response trace
Clear writing: product requirements and updates for engineers, partners, and executives

The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. The role will help ensure that the platform is designed to address business needs and is tailored to the organization structure and scale, while simultaneously being an advocate for data-driven decision-making and the enablement of the platform across the organization.

Acting as the bridge between business domains, data platform teams, and engineering, the Product Owner translates business needs into clear platform requirements, defines priorities, and ensures delivery of capabilities that maximize business value. The role is accountable for maintaining a clear product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the platform, balancing strategic initiatives (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration) with operational stability and efficiency.

The Product Owner works closely with platform engineering, data architects, other Product Owners and DevOps teams to ensure that platform capabilities are delivered in a standardized, reusable, and scalable manner. They also collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to define how the platform is consumed, ensuring clarity in delivery models, ownership, and support structures.

A key responsibility of the role is to establish and enforce ways of working for the platform, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and governance standards. This includes ensuring that data product ownership, privacy-by-design, and compliance requirements are consistently embedded across all platform use cases.

As a key figure in a global, organizational-scale software initiative, the Data Platform Product Owner must be a promoter of the Agile mindset and a champion of continuous delivery and feedback, cooperating with the DevOps teams to implement practices that generate incremental and steady feature delivery at scale that adapts quickly to feedback and business changes.
The role contributes to the continuous improvement of the platform by identifying gaps, driving enhancements, and aligning platform evolution with broader strategic initiatives such as data mesh adoption, data governance, and cloud transformation.

Working closely with delivery leads, architects, and business product owners, the Data Platform Product Owner ensures a clear and transparent roadmap, enabling high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that support both current operations and future growth.

Main Responsibilities

Vision & Product Strategy
Define and maintain a clear product vision for the platform, balancing innovation, scalability, and operational stability.
Own and manage the Data Platform product roadmap and backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic initiatives.
Monitor platform adoption and usage, identifying gaps and driving continuous improvements.

Stakeholder & Business Engagement
Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data product teams, and platform engineering.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and priorities.
Foster an understanding of product goals and vision. Ensure alignment on expectations, ownership, and delivery outcomes across stakeholders.

Product Delivery & Advocacy
Lead and coordinate platform-related initiatives end-to-end (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration), ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, and expected business outcome.
Drive project management activities, including planning, tracking, risk management, and escalation handling.
Champion the promotion of the platform across the business functions and advocate for its usage in upcoming analytics or data-driven initiatives across domains.

Operating Model & Governance
Define, implement, and continuously improve the platform operating model (delivery models, ownership, support).
Establish and govern intake, prioritization, and demand management processes.
Ensure transparency on capacity, trade-offs, and prioritization decisions.

Platform Standards & Compliance
Ensure adoption of platform standards, including data product frameworks, privacy-by-design, and governance requirements.
Work with relevant teams to embed compliance and data ownership practices across all use cases.

Collaboration with Engineering & Architecture
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reusable, and maintainable platform capabilities.
Align platform evolution with enterprise architecture and long-term technology strategy
Contribute to identifying and prioritizing technical improvements and platform enhancements.

Communication & Reporting
Provide clear and consistent communication to stakeholders and leadership.
Share roadmap updates, delivery progress, risks, and key decisions.
Ensure transparency and alignment across all platform-related initiatives.

ABOUT QUINCE
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 
If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE
We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead our Factory Tech within our Sourcing team. Quince is building the operating system for the factories, mills, and vendors that make our products. Factory OS is the software our supply partners run their operations on — planning, scheduling, capacity, quality, and compliance — replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one system of record for how goods actually get made.
As Principal PM, you own this platform end to end: the vision, the roadmap, and the hard calls about what we build, for whom, and in what order. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with vendors and mills on the factory floor, and with our engineering, ops, and sourcing teams, to turn messy real-world production workflows into reliable software. This is a builder's role with outsized scope — you're defining a category, not iterating on a mature one.
Responsibilities
Own the Factory OS product strategy — from vendor/mill discovery through roadmap, specs, and launch — and be accountable for adoption and measurable operational impact (adoption, on-time production, capacity utilization, quality yield, planning accuracy).
Design the core operational workflows — production planning, scheduling, capacity management, order and material tracking — so they hold up under the reality of a working factory, not just a demo.
Build for compliance and auditability from day one. Factory data touches sourcing, labor, quality, and trade requirements. You'll make compliance, traceability, and auditability first-class product surfaces, not bolt-ons — and ensure the system produces the records our partners and Quince are held to.
Drive real adoption on the floor. A system that vendors and mills won't use is worthless. You'll obsess over onboarding, change management, and the gap between "shipped" and "used daily"
Set the AI and automation thesis. Architect Factory OS for a future where every automatable workflow is executed by an agent, not a person clicking through screens. Decide which steps to automate first, design the human-in-the-loop and exception paths, and treat agents, APIs, and humans as composable actors in auditable, business-grade workflows.
Partner deeply cross-functionally with engineering, ML, design, sourcing, and factory operations — translating ambiguous problem statements into shipped products.

Qualifications
Required
10+ years in product management, including senior/principal-level ownership of a complex B2B SaaS or operational software product from zero-to-one or through significant scale
Direct experience building workflow-automation software - you've taken manual, multi-step operational processes and turned them into software that runs them, and you understand the difference between digitizing a workflow and actually automating it.
Domain proximity to manufacturing, supply chain, or factory/operations software (MES/MOM, ERP, planning/scheduling, quality, or sourcing systems). You don't need to have run a factory, but you need to have built for people who do.
A credible point of view on AI and agents in production software - not slideware. You've shipped, or can clearly articulate how you'd ship, agentic and human-in-the-loop automation into a real operational system.
A track record with compliance-sensitive products — you've built software where auditability, traceability, and regulatory or contractual requirements were core to the design.
Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI tools daily for discovery, spec-writing, and prototyping, and you build to think.
Comfort in the field — you'll spend time with vendors and mills, and you're energized (not deterred) by messy, physical, real-world operations
Preferred
Experience building software used by external partners/suppliers (not just internal or single-tenant customers).
Background in apparel, textiles, consumer goods, or hard-goods manufacturing supply chains

WHY QUINCE?
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messa

Airtel Digital is at the forefront of digital transformation, redefining how millions of customers experience telecom, content, and financial services. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, leveraging data, and implementing cutting-edge AI-driven solutions, we’d love to have you on board. 

Role Overview 
We are looking for a Product Manager with deep customer empathy, strong business acumen, and a data-driven mindset. You will own and drive AI-driven product initiatives that enhance customer experience, optimize business processes, and significant growth. This role requires a mix of strategic thinking, hands-on problem-solving, and technical fluency in AI/ML models. 

Key Responsibilities 
Customer-Centric Product Thinking

Customer Obsessed: You deeply understand customer pain points and prioritize solving them effectively. 
Qualifications 
Proven track record of building products with a mix of business, design, and technical considerations. 
Excellent communication skills to collaborate with engineering, design, and leadership teams. 
1+years of product management experience, preferably in AI/ML-driven products. 
Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL, Python, or other data tools. 
Experience working with data science teams, defining ML product requirements, and deploying AI-driven features.

About DHL Group and IT Group Functions:
DHL Group the logistics provider of the world with over 580,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. We are an organization that is not just moving goods around, we have a very clear purpose, and we are: Connecting People. Improving Lives. We provide challenges and opportunities for personal and professional development, we recognize the difference you bring to our business and together we share the pride of building one of the largest world leaders in logistics and supply chain.

Our role at IT Group Functions (IT GF) is to address the information and technology needs of the Corporate Center the GBS Service Lines and CSI to make them successful in their digital transformations. We maximize the value for our Business Partners by delivering transformational programs, IT applications and IT architecture that are integrated, innovative and cost-efficient. We address the critical topics of information security (incl. SaaS security), data protection and compliance to protect DHL Group from harm. We pride ourselves that our employees are professionally capable, diverse and socially responsible.

Ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of IT Group Functions? Join the team and bring your expertise on board! As part of DHL Group, you will be working with a global network of IT colleagues and benefit from a wide range of development opportunities.

We are looking for an immediate, full-time, permanent position in APAC at Chennai, India.

Job Purpose:
Lead DHL Group's strategy, development, adoption, and evolution of shared customer data and interoperability capabilities. The scope spans Group customer identification, customer and account information, legal-entity and hierarchy models, matching and mapping, data quality, stewardship, source integration, and controlled publication of customer information.
The role owns the product vision, multi-year roadmap, governance, prioritization, and value realization for the Group Customer Data & Interoperability product domain. Its purpose is to create a consistent and reusable customer view across divisions and to enable identity, onboarding, customer-experience, analytics, and divisional products with reliable customer information, while strengthening data quality, customer experience, compliance, information security, operational efficiency, and cross-divisional adoption, without assuming ownership of those consuming products.
Success requires strategic direction combined with execution focus: establishing clear boundaries between central and divisional data responsibilities, creating alignment across systems of record and consuming products, balancing customer, business, operational, data, and technical considerations, and leading through expertise, constructive challenge, and accountability. The role additionally defines and evolves the operating model, governance framework, organizational interfaces, and contribution model required for the long-term development and sustainable operation of the Group Customer Data & Interoperability pillar.

Your tasks:
Product Strategy & Vision
Own and continuously evolve the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Group Customer Data & Interoperability. Provide input to the IT Product Management strategy and lead its implementation within the product scope. Prioritize data products and features, identify dependencies and interfaces, and maintain a clear focus on business outcomes and reuse.
Define strategic priorities for the Group customer identifier, customer and account information, legal-entity and hierarchy models, matching and mapping, data quality, stewardship, source integration, and controlled publication, aligned with DHL Group business objectives, customer and consuming-product needs, regulatory requirements, data-management developments, and emerging technology trends.
Identify future capability requirements and drive product evolution beyond current application boundaries, including agreed extensions into selected financial, risk, reporting, or related customer-information domains.

Stakeholder Leadership & Alignment
Lead cross-divisional stakeholder engagement with business representatives, source-system owners, consuming products, data-management teams, engineering, architecture, security, privacy, legal, finance, and other functions to establish alignment on priorities, investment, adoption, data responsibilities, and strategic direction, supported by clear decision documents.
Facilitate decisions across complex stakeholder networks where interests, priorities, source authority, quality expectations, contribution models, and funding responsibilities may differ, and influence customers, vendors, external partners, and engineering-team priorities.
Act as trusted advisor to senior stakeholders regarding Group customer-data strategy, customer identification, master-data management, customer hierarchies, matching, data quality, governance, stewardship, interoperability, and controlled data publication.
Act as the senior coordination point for the Customer Data & Interoperability pillar and represent the pillar in cross-divisional governance, investment, architecture, compliance, and strategic planning forums. Drive alignment across DHL divisions and functions regarding customer-data priorities, adoption, operating-model evolution, and long-term capability development.

Product Governance & Prioritization
Own product and backlog prioritization and maintain transparent governance processes balancing business value, customer and user experience, consuming-product needs, data quality, ownership, lineage, privacy, information security, risk, compliance obligations, interoperability, operational requirements, and technical sustainability.
Establish and maintain product governance, data-governance interfaces, decision forums, roadmap reviews, product standards, and critical implementation documentation so that agreed models, rules, interfaces, and processes are applied consistently.

Delivery Leadership
Provide end-to-end product leadership and direction to the multidisciplinary Customer Data & Interoperability team through backlog ownership, requirements management, prioritization, and acceptance of delivered outcomes. Establish clear scope, timelines, dependencies, interfaces, and escalation paths.
Translate business strategy and stakeholder requirements into actionable data products, epics, features, information models, quality and matching rules, source mappings, APIs, events, snapshots, and publication interfaces. Define functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, auditability, lineage, and data protection.
Ensure consistent delivery of value by monitoring milestones, data-product health and adoption, managing change control, assessing scope impacts, and developing contingency and mitigation plans.
Act as escalation point for difficult product-development, data-ownership, quality, integration, and operational scenarios and drive issues and risks back to an acceptable status.

Security, Privacy, Compliance & Data Risk
Own security, privacy, compliance, auditability, retention, permitted-use, data-access, and risk requirements relevant to the Group customer-data products, in cooperation with responsible specialist functions.
Ensure adherence to DHL Group standards, regulatory obligations, audit requirements, data-sharing controls, and risk-management practices, including traceability of data and configuration changes and appropriate segregation of duties.
Financial & Resource Management
Accountable for development of investment proposals, funding recommendations, resource-allocation strategies, and long-term financial sustainability planning for the Customer Data & Interoperability pillar. Leads prioritization discussions regarding product investment, sourcing approaches, implementation capacity, and operational sustainability.

Job Description

At NIQ, we show the world what people want, thanks to our Full View of consumer intelligence. Our solutions uncover the most granular details to inspire big-picture ideas and empower business leaders to take decisive action. For more than a hundred years, NIQ has focused on delivering the most trustworthy, relevant, and actionable data. 

eCommerce is one of the fastest growing and strategically important areas of NIQ's business. This role is central to shaping the region's eCommerce measurement product strategy, driving scalable, high-quality, full-market coverage, and ensuring our solutions keep pace with a rapidly evolving digital commerce landscape 

EEMEA region covers Africa, Eastern Europe, India and Middle East countries 

Role Overview 

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused eCommerce Product Leader to own and drive the eCommerce measurement product agenda across the EEMEA region. This role is pivotal in defining and executing the regional eCommerce roadmap, rationalizing and evolving our product portfolio, and ensuring our solutions are client-centric, operationally robust, and aligned with NIQ's broader global product strategy. 

The successful candidate will provide visionary leadership across a diverse and fast-growing set of markets, partnering closely with regional and global to translate market dynamics and client needs into clear product priorities. They will balance strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution, and will be comfortable operating in a matrixed, multi-country environment. 

Key Responsibilities 

Regional eCommerce Strategy 

Develop and execute a comprehensive EEMEA eCommerce measurement strategy aligned with NIQ's global vision and goals 

Identify emerging trends and technologies, proactively gather voice of client to ensure solid prioritization and focus on delivering value to clients’ business 

Define and continuously refine the regional eCommerce product and opportunity roadmap, in line with the market needs, and NIQ overall global and regional strategy 

Partner with global and regional eCommerce leadership to secure close alignment to the business priorities and vision 

Drive competitive intelligence: continuously scan and assess the external marketplace for competitive risks and partnership opportunities 

Champion the adoption of AI capabilities within eCommerce measurement products at all levels from data collection to insights 

Leverage AI-powered tools to automate and enhance internal performance and speed of execution 

Collaboration & Execution 

Drive execution against the roadmap to support ambitious revenue and expansion targets across the region 

Lead the product development cycle end to end. Ensure consistent product approach and cohesive execution across all EEMEA markets 

Coordinate with market teams to ensure a healthy balance of local needs and regional and global harmonization 

Partner with region eCommerce leadership to achieve overall business targets, and participate in key client negotiations on strategic and product matters. Act as a key business partner to the eCommerce EEMEA Commercial Leader 

Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable guidance for Technology and Operation teams 

Collaborate with marketing, commercial, and pricing teams in setting go-to-market strategy and pricing for eCommerce solutions. 

Launch new eCommerce product initiatives to drive the growth and penetration. Oversee financial metrics of the initiatives, to control for the revenue and costs, as well as optimal use of resources. Take priority calls when necessary 

Control for continuous product profitability, driving healthy rationalization and simplification 

Profile 

We are looking for a highly analytical, results-oriented product leader with a strong ROI mindset and a demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-market initiatives from ideation through delivery. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with a strong bias for action, and possesses the influence and communication skills required to engage senior stakeholders across a diverse, multi-country region. 

Qualifications 

Minimum of 7 years of experience in product management, data analytics, technology, or business leadership, preferably within eCommerce, market intelligence, or data platform environments. 

Proven track record of managing and delivering data products, with strong knowledge of NIQ measurement portfolio and standards 

Good understanding of digital retail and consumer ecosystems 

Experience working in cross-functional, matrixed organizations spanning functions and teams across multiple countries 

Solid business acumen, including budget/P&L ownership and ROI-driven decision-making 

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities; proficiency in data-driven decision-making. 

Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; able to put complex things in simple, powerful form 

Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple, competing priorities 

Fluency in English 



Additional Information

Our Benefits

Flexible working environment
Volunteer time off
LinkedIn Learning
Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

About NIQ

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Want to keep up with our latest updates?

Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook


Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/diversity-inclusion

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad influence across the company. You will own the product strategy for Equinix's conversational AI and assistant platforms — chat, voice, and agentic interfaces that employees, customers, and partners interact with directly. You will work closely with engineering and architecture teams on technical decisions while also helping executives understand business implications, investment choices, and risk.

You will serve as a conversational AI product leader across Go to Market, Operations, Product, and Corporate functions. Depending on the initiative, you may advise business leaders, partner with product and engineering teams, or directly lead product strategy and delivery for conversational experiences and the platform capabilities that power them.

The conversational AI market is changing quickly — from single-turn chatbots to multi-agent, tool-using assistants. An important part of this role is evaluating new conversational AI technologies, identifying which capabilities are relevant to Equinix, and translating them into practical product and platform investment decisions.

Responsibilities

Conversational AI, Cloud, and Data Architecture

Bring strong working knowledge of conversational AI, dialogue systems, agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data architecture to product and platform decisions
Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate large language model architectures, conversational agent design patterns (orchestrator/worker, multi-agent handoff, tool calling), cloud deployment approaches, and enterprise data pipelines
Participate meaningfully in technical and architecture reviews, as well as product and roadmap discussions for the conversational platform
Translate technical choices, constraints, and risks into clear business implications that leaders can understand and act on
Help ensure conversational AI products are designed for enterprise scale, security, reliability, multi-channel support (chat, voice, embedded assistants), and reuse across business functions

Conversation Design, Model Strategy, and Deployment

Guide decisions on prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, conversation flow and dialogue management, model customization, fine tuning, and model selection for conversational use cases
Help teams determine when a smaller model may provide better latency, cost, or control for real-time conversational interactions than a larger model
Partner with AI and machine learning engineering teams on deployment approaches for conversational agents across cloud, private infrastructure, and low-latency environments
Evaluate emerging approaches such as multi-agent coordination, model routing, tool/function calling, memory and context management, and hybrid model deployment for conversational systems
Use conversation quality metrics, containment and escalation rates, model performance data, evaluation results, user feedback, and business outcomes to guide product priorities

Platform Reliability and Responsible AI

Define product requirements for conversational AI system reliability, availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and incident response
Partner with engineering teams to improve visibility into conversational agent behavior, model performance, cost, conversation logs, and production issues
Establish requirements that support traceability, explainability, auditability, fairness, privacy, and regulatory compliance across conversational interactions
Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and AI Governance teams to incorporate company policies and responsible AI requirements into conversational products and platforms, including data handling within chat, voice, and memory features
Partner with Design to create clear conversational UX that explains how AI is being used, manages user expectations, and provides appropriate review, control, hand-off to a human, and approval within the conversation itself

Product Decisions and Risk Management

Lead decisions involving tradeoffs among business value, delivery speed, technical complexity, cost, performance, and risk for conversational AI features
Establish clear and repeatable methods for evaluating major conversational AI product and architecture decisions
Help teams identify risks early — including hallucination, unintended actions, and improper data exposure in conversational contexts — and determine the appropriate level of governance and human oversight
Balance the need to deliver conversational value quickly with the requirements of security, reliability, and responsible AI

Executive and Cross Functional Leadership

Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Information Security, Data, Design, and business functions on the conversational AI roadmap
Influence decisions through expertise, clear reasoning, and strong working relationships rather than direct authority
Explain complex technical topics in clear language that is relevant to both technical and business audiences
Work with senior leaders to connect conversational AI investments to business priorities, customer value, productivity, and operational outcomes
Develop trusted relationships so that teams engage early when evaluating important conversational AI opportunities or decisions

Qualifications

Master's degree or doctorate in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field
Experience working with models and platforms from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or the open source community, including agent frameworks and orchestration tooling
Experience with machine learning operations, model evaluation, AI monitoring, or conversational AI observability tools
Experience defining service requirements for conversational AI systems, including availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and operational support
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including explainability, model documentation, evaluation, audit processes, governance, and policy implementation for conversational systems
Experience working with research, engineering, or innovation teams to bring conversational AI capabilities into production
Experience designing conversational AI user experiences that support transparency, consent, user review, and appropriate human control (e.g., escalation to a live agent)
Experience in data centers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or enterprise technology
Experience building AI assistants, chatbots, voice agents, or AI-enabled conversational workflows at enterprise scale
Experience with business software, enterprise platforms, or products designed for developers

Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!

Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here's why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities.

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you'll fit right in.

The role:

As Principal Product Manager, you will own and shape the strategy, define KPIs and be responsible for the roadmap delivery of products built under the portfolio of Business Messaging. You will play a key role in the 10-100 journey for a product line that has scaled to become the most anchored offering in Truecaller's suite of enterprise products.

What you'll do: 



You will develop and drive the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap for everything within the Business Messaging solutions portfolio, ensuring alignment with the company's strategic goals, objectives with strong skills in modern AI tooling.
You will deliver high-quality products in-time, to meet important business revenue goals that excite our investors and customers.
You will conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new opportunities, trends, and customer needs in the business communications space.
You collaborate with cross-functional teams, product & engineering, analytics as well as marketing and sales, to ensure seamless product development and go-to-market processes.
You will develop a deep understanding of our customers and their needs, acting as the voice of the customer within the organization and with leadership.
Drive and coach teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses of new feature(s)/feature areas.
Create clarity for the team by communicating the business priorities and vision and helping them incorporate that into their plans.
Build strong relationships with customers, business partners and other stakeholders to generate long-term value.
Constantly monitor progress and look for ways to improve the product.

What you bring in: 



8-10 years of overall work experience with at least 5-7 years in product management.
Worked at either a CPaaS, CCaaS or UCaaS ecosystem in building communication solutions or solutions for contact centre management for businesses in India or globally.
Past experience building consumer mobile applications at scale will be a huge plus.
Sound technical knowledge of APIs and workflow management.
Sound understanding of monetization and an ability to build pricing strategies.
You know how to work with partners as well as end customers to identify problems and build a roadmap that reflects strategic as well as business priorities.
You have the ability to influence multiple cross-functional teams without authority to get the job done - sales, customer success and more.
Exceptional analytical, strategic, and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to a diverse range of stakeholders.
Get stuff done mindset - small team, audacious goals and flawless execution.
Passionate about creating great user experiences both for businesses and consumers.
Proven track record of product management for mobile devices and/or applications.

It would be great if you also have:



Experience working with Android & iOS teams
Tools: Jira / Trello/ Confluence/Looker/GA

What we offer: 

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

A comprehensive compensation package: Learning and development allowance, voluntary provident fund (VPF) and/or national pension scheme (NPS) tax saving option provided, creche allowance
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller's "Lab Days" offer a space for imagination: 5 days each quarter, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they've always wanted to. It's a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today.
