Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About The Role

Harness is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define the future of Agentic Application Security. You will lead our Code Security and AI Security Agents portfolio, spanning static application security testing (SAST), AI-powered vulnerability triage, and autonomous remediation.

As AI coding agents transform how software is built, security must evolve beyond detecting vulnerabilities to autonomously investigating, validating, and fixing them at machine speed.

We are looking for a product leader who can help build autonomous security engineering systems that understand code, reason about security risks, generate secure fixes, and continuously validate outcomes across modern development environments.

Autonomous Security Agents: Define and build AI agents for threat detection, vulnerability investigation, intelligent triage, and automated remediation.
Agentic Security Workflows: Design end-to-end workflows where agents investigate findings, correlate security signals, assess risk, recommend actions, generate fixes, and verify outcomes.
Agent Skills & Integrations: Build extensible agent capabilities using skills, plugins, MCP, tool calling, and integrations across security scanners, repositories, IDEs, SCM, and CI/CD platforms.
Autonomous Remediation: Drive agent-powered code fixes, dependency upgrades, test execution, validation, and pull request generation with appropriate human oversight.
Agentic Developer Ecosystem: Integrate security capabilities into AI coding assistants and autonomous development platforms, enabling security to operate alongside developers and coding agents.
Product Strategy & Execution: Own product vision, differentiation, roadmap, customer adoption, and business outcomes while partnering with engineering, security research, and go-to-market teams.

What We're Looking For

7+ years of product management experience in AI Developer Tools, Application Security, DevSecOps, or developer platforms.
Hands-on experience building or delivering AI agents that autonomously plan, execute tasks, invoke tools, and complete multi-step workflows.
Strong understanding of LLM orchestration, agent skills, plugins, MCP, tool calling, and agentic execution frameworks.
Experience designing intelligent workflows for investigation, decision-making, automation, and iterative validation.
Understanding of vulnerability management, security detection, risk prioritization, remediation, and developer workflows.
Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into reliable, secure, enterprise-grade products.
Proven track record of driving product strategy, technical execution, customer adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Nice to Have

Experience building autonomous coding agents, AI-native developer tools, or security automation platforms.
Background in application security testing, SAST, SCA, vulnerability management, or code scanning.

Why This Role Exists

Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In This Role You Will Be The Person Who

Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:

Role

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

Key Responsibilities:

Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing

Hunt for high-value AI opportunities within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
Quantify value rigorously. Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
Develop deep domain pattern recognition so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:

Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain. Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
Make trade-off recommendations. When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
Protect engineering focus. Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes. 

Engineering Partnership & Enablement

Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain. Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
Shape engagements end-to-end. Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
Surface re-use and platform leverage when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
Design the human–digital split. Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

Stakeholder Alignment & Communication

Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders. Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
Build sponsor coalitions that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
Communicate impact clearly in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

Measurement, Learning & Iteration

Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

Required Functional Experience:

18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

#AGTech

Skills

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

About The Role

You will own Accelerate’s growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment.

What You Will Own

Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what “activated” means for each.
Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.


What We’re Looking For

6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.

Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.


Strong Pluses

Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.

Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.


How We Work

Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.

Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Product Manager (AI)-2

About The Team

Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.

We are currently looking for a Lead Product Manager (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for an AI agent platform that serves

Mastercard issuers and acquirers - enabling non-technical financial operations teams to surface insights, investigate anomalies, and act on reconciliation data through natural language. You will define what gets built, sequence when it gets built, and ensure every decision is grounded in measurable customer and business value. You work at the intersection of customer discovery, AI capability, and compliance - and you are comfortable making hard prioritization calls in all three dimensions simultaneously.

Roles And Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end product strategy for the AI agent platform: define the vision, articulate the roadmap, and maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects real customer need, business impact, and delivery


feasibility.

Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and


distinguish symptoms from root causes.

Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you


for clarification.

Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering


enthusiasm or conservatism.

Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those


constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.

Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.


All About You

Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually


meets the product intent.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Own AI-native products from first idea to real-world impact

As a Product Owner at Ideas2IT, you'll define what gets built in a world where software is increasingly written, tested, and operated with AI. You'll set product vision and strategy, turn messy business problems into products that customers trust, and work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, designers, and clients. You'll own outcomes, not just outputs: adoption, quality, and business impact.

What you'll actually do as a Product Owner with us

Define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for AI-native products, and make clear calls on what to build, buy, or leave to a foundation model.
Own the product end to end, from ideation and rapid prototyping to launch and scale, with accountability for customer and business outcomes.
Turn business problems into sharp specifications: user stories, acceptance criteria, and the evaluation criteria that define what "good" looks like for AI behavior.
Design for AI realities: accuracy and hallucination risk, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, explainability, and user trust.
Make product decisions grounded in AI economics, including model choice, inference cost, latency, and data readiness, and tie them to pricing and margins.
Prototype and validate ideas yourself using AI tools, so you can put something real in front of customers in days rather than waiting for a full build cycle.
Work with engineering teams that build with AI-assisted development, and rethink how sprints, backlogs, and refinement work when delivery is faster.
Partner with architects, designers, and clients to evaluate technical feasibility, and guide implementation priorities across Generative AI, Data Engineering, Cloud, and Application Development.
Navigate governance, privacy, and compliance, particularly in regulated domains such as healthcare, and build them into the product from the start.
Track product performance with real metrics (adoption, task success, quality scores, cost per outcome), then use the feedback to improve the product continuously.

Must-haves

8+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership, with a record of shipping and scaling software products.
Strong technical acumen. You can hold a credible architecture conversation with senior engineers and challenge feasibility claims.
Proven strength in product strategy, roadmap development, and prioritization under uncertainty.
Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into precise, testable product requirements.
Sound judgment on AI risk, covering data privacy, governance, and responsible use.
Strong analytical and stakeholder skills, with clear written and verbal communication, including with senior client leaders.
A habit of using AI tools in your own daily work (research, specs, prototypes, analysis), and strong opinions on what works.

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience building or shipping products with Generative AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, copilots), or deep experience in Data Engineering or Cloud with a clear route into AI product work.
Fluency in how AI products behave in practice: non-determinism, evaluation, failure modes, model and cost tradeoffs, and when AI is the wrong answer.
Experience with agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, or LLMOps practices.
Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.
CSPO or equivalent Agile certification, plus a view on how Agile needs to evolve for AI-assisted delivery.
Experience with startups or high-growth product engineering companies, including 0-to-1 product launches.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, DevOps, CI/CD, and release management.
Experience with distributed engineering teams and global clients.

Why Ideas2IT, and why now?

AI is changing how software is built, modernized, tested, and governed. Most companies are adapting to that shift. We're building for it.

Ideas2IT combines a product company's ambition with a technology services firm's depth. We build our own AI-native platforms and also partner with startups and global enterprises like Meta, Roche etc. on their hardest problems. We have a proven track record of taking multiple ideas to venture backed startups like e5.ai, carefi.in and more. That means your product ideas meet real customers, real codebases, and real regulated environments early, and you learn what works in weeks rather than quarters.

With a strong focus on Generative AI, Data Engineering, and Cloud, you'll shape product direction at a time when the playbook is still being written, and your judgment will carry real weight.

Where Ambition Meets Innovation

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

Job Title: Product Manager - Data & AI

Client Location: Canada

Work Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday (9.30 PM to 6:30 AM IST)

Experience Level: 5+ Years

About The Role

As our Product Manager - Data & AI, you'll own the journey from the data we collect to the AI-powered experiences we deliver to customers. You'll work across product and engineering to determine what information we should collect, how it should be used, and how we can turn it into useful, reliable AI features.

This is a hands-on product role. You won't just define requirements and hand them to a technical team, you'll work with engineering to analyze AI performance, define how AI should behave, and establish the measures we use to determine whether our products are actually delivering value.

What You'll Do

Own the Attendee Data Platform (ADP) to AI-feature value chain end-to-end, from determining what signals and data we should collect through to how that data powers customer-facing AI experiences.
Partner closely with engineering to define the data required to build and improve AI-powered features.
Use SQL, notebooks, and other analytical tools to run analysis, explore data, identify patterns, and answer product questions.
Build and maintain datasets used to develop, evaluate, and improve AI features.
Conduct error analysis on AI outputs to understand where models are performing well, where they fail, and what we can do to improve them.
Write clear, precise product specifications that can be reliably interpreted and executed by both engineers and AI coding agents.
Design consent, privacy, and data-use considerations as an intentional part of the product experience, not as something addressed after the fact.
Define meaningful product and AI performance metrics and establish how we will measure success.
Decide where AI genuinely earns its place and where a simpler, deterministic approach serves the customer just as well at a fraction of the running cost — and be able to show the reasoning behind the call.
Work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to turn complex technical capabilities into useful customer experiences.
Continuously evaluate our AI products and data practices to identify opportunities to improve quality, reliability, and customer value.

What We're Looking For

Significant product management experience, ideally working on data-intensive, AI-powered, or technically complex products.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently work with data using SQL and notebooks.
Experience building products where data is a core part of the product experience.
A strong understanding of how AI systems are developed, evaluated, and improved, including experience analyzing AI errors and outputs.
A pragmatic view of AI — you can tell the difference between a problem that needs a model and one that needs a rule, and you treat running cost as a product constraint rather than an engineering detail.
Exceptional ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear, precise requirements and specifications.
Experience working closely with engineering and data teams and the ability to comfortably engage in technical discussions.
An understanding of data privacy, consent, and responsible data use, with the ability to incorporate these considerations directly into product decisions.
A metrics-driven approach to product management, with the ability to define meaningful measures of success.
Strong judgment and curiosity, with a willingness to get hands-on and investigate problems yourself rather than relying entirely on others for the analysis.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring product, technical, and business perspectives together.

About The Role

We are looking for a commercially oriented portfolio and customer lifecycle manager to help grow, deepen and manage our Affluent Credit Cards franchise.

The role will own portfolio performance across acquisition, activation, usage, spend intensity, balances, monetisation, retention, attrition and portfolio health. It will also have horizontal ownership of Add-on Cards and Referral Cards, building both into scalable acquisition and relationship-deepening businesses across the credit card portfolio.

We are open to candidates from banking as well as other customer-led industries such as fintech, payments, loyalty, travel, hospitality, e-commerce, telecom, subscriptions, retail and consumer technology.

Key Responsibilities

Affluent Portfolio Growth and Performance
Own affluent portfolio performance across acquisition, activation, activity, spends, spend per active card, balances, lending, retention and attrition.
Track performance by product, customer cohort, acquisition channel, vintage and lifecycle stage.
Identify opportunities to improve share of wallet, primary-card behaviour, spend frequency and overall customer value.
Develop differentiated growth plans for mature, emerging and newly launched propositions.
Identify gaps such as customer growth without corresponding spend growth, balances without engagement, or acquisition without activation.
Customer Lifecycle Management
Build structured programmes across onboarding, early activation, usage deepening, dormancy prevention, reactivation, high-value retention and win-back.
Design interventions for high-value, high-potential, inactive and at-risk customer cohorts.
Use customer behaviour and propensity models to determine whom to target, when to engage and what intervention to offer.
Develop category-led engagement strategies across international usage, travel, lifestyle, UPI, digital payments and other relevant use cases.
Improve spend productivity and engagement within new and under-penetrated cohorts.
Portfolio Economics and Profitability
Own portfolio P&L, budgets, forecasts and unit economics in partnership with Finance.
Track revenue, acquisition cost, rewards, benefits, lending income, fee income and customer-level profitability.
Evaluate the commercial impact and incrementality of acquisition, engagement, retention and migration programmes.
Develop rewards economics, breakage and ROI models to support periodic benefit and proposition reviews.
Identify cost leakage across rewards, waivers, offers and campaigns.
Improve cost-to-impact metrics such as acquisition cost, cost per activation, campaign ROI and incremental revenue.
Add-on & Referral Cards: Horizontal Ownership
Own the strategy and performance of Add-on and Referral Cards as scalable acquisition and relationship-deepening levers across the franchise.
Identify high-potential customer and household cohorts and build targeted journeys across digital, branch, assisted and relationship-led channels.
Track the end-to-end funnel across sourcing, issuance, activation, spends, retention and customer value.
Optimise programme design and incentives to drive incremental acquisition, household engagement and sustainable economics.
Analytics and Business Reviews
Own portfolio MIS, dashboards, forecasts and monthly business reviews.
Track acquisition, activation, spends, SPAC, share of wallet, international usage, UPI, balances, lending, attrition and portfolio quality.
Translate data into clear conclusions on what changed, why it changed and what action is required.
Build early-warning indicators for inactivity, attrition, high utilisation and deterioration in customer value.
Establish test-and-learn frameworks to measure the true incremental impact of portfolio interventions.
Develop business cases and impact assessments for proposition, pricing, benefit and policy changes.
Portfolio Quality and Governance
Partner with Risk and Collections to maintain portfolio quality while growing balances and monetisation.
Track utilisation, revolving behaviour, payment patterns, delinquency and emerging risk cohorts.
Develop early-warning scorecards and pre-emptive customer-treatment strategies.
Establish clear governance for exceptions, benefits, waivers and portfolio interventions.
Work with Compliance, Legal, Product and Operations to ensure propositions and customer journeys remain aligned with approved constructs and disclosures.

Define migration cohorts, destination propositions and customer-treatment strategies.
Protect customer retention, usage, balances and relationship value through the transition.
Track post-migration activation, spend transfer, balance transfer, attrition and customer experience.
Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance, Marketing and Customer Service.

Higher activation, active-customer penetration and spend per active card.
Sustainable growth in spends, balances, share of wallet and customer profitability.
Lower dormancy and high-value attrition.
Strong portfolio quality alongside deeper lending and monetisation.
Add-on Cards becoming a meaningful household-penetration and relationship-deepening lever.
Referral Cards developing into a scalable, high-quality acquisition channel.
Measurable improvement in programme ROI and cost efficiency.
Customer migrations that successfully preserve engagement, spends and balances.
Portfolio reviews that lead to clear and timely business actions.

Strong commercial orientation and understanding of customer and portfolio economics.
Strong analytical capability and comfort working with data, dashboards and performance reports.

Experience designing and measuring targeted customer interventions.
Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to drive outcomes without direct authority.
Clear, concise executive communication.
MBA/PGDM or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

Prior credit-card or financial-services experience is useful, but not mandatory.

Role Title: Lead Consultant - S/4HANA – IT Product Manager - Tax

Location: Chennai

We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.

AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.

The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.

The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.

The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are aiming to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.

The S/4HANA Product Manager – Tax assists in the technical solution design for the Tax capability or as part of a multifunctional component. It is a key position within the Axial Programme IT Design Team, with a central role in defining AstraZeneca’s global template in line with our Fit-to-Standard ambition, using SAP standards. You will be part of the wider Axial IT Design Team responsible for shaping the technology that supports our global standardised business processes.

The Product Manager will primarily align to a capability associated with the Record to Report (R2R) Enterprise Process Owner (EPO) domains or, in some cases, a cross-domain capability. During the global process design phase, you will develop the Tax solution and act as the central point for defining the integrated approach for your area, connecting business process requirements, SAP functionality and SAP data objects.

You will be responsible for ensuring the global standard is accurately documented and tested in accordance with project requirements, while guiding the core design through the appropriate governance forums. You will collaborate with IT Enterprise Business Partners and other Product Managers to effectively integrate the Tax capability into the wider AstraZeneca template. This will also involve partnering with SMEs from external organisations to ensure the AZ solution adopts standard, cutting-edge technology to deliver required business capabilities and outcomes.

As the project moves into deployment, you will continue to play a pivotal role in ensuring that localisation requirements for individual operating units are appropriately reflected while maintaining the integrity of the Fit-to-Standard best-practice template. You will support deployment teams through the business change journey, migration and cutover to the standard model for each entity. You will also be a key participant in hypercare, helping resolve capability-related issues in a timely and effective manner.

In this role, you will apply extensive knowledge of SAP best practices to enable core business capabilities through a standard global template utilising SAP DRC, EDICOM and a Tax Engine.

What You’ll Do

Lead the IT solution underpinning the global standard process for the Tax capability / lead area, including integrations.
Be accountable for aligning system design and best practices with business capability requirements within the Tax domain.
Partner with business process teams to maintain alignment with S/4HANA best practices and SAP standard functionality.

Medication administration is a critical part of care delivery, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.

Our mission is to support and improve the medication administration capabilities customers depend on every day. We focus on product reliability, effective clinical workflows, customer responsiveness, and practical enhancements that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety.

We are seeking a Product Manager 2 to support medication administration products and contributing to requirements definition and product development for medication administration. This role emphasizes understanding current customer workflows, helping address product issues, documenting requirements, validating solutions, and supporting release readiness and adoption. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering, UX, regulatory & compliance, support, consulting, and customer-facing teams.

Working with guidance from senior team members, you will contribute to product decisions and roadmap priorities for assigned capabilities. You will be accountable for progressing assigned deliverables, communicating status, and escalating risks or decisions requiring broader review. Your work will help maintain reliable medication administration experiences for clinicians and the patients they serve.
Product Support and Maintenance: Support medication administration capabilities used by Oracle Health customers. Assist in reviewing customer-reported issues, defects, workflow gaps, and adoption barriers. Gather relevant information and work with senior product managers and cross-functional partners to support investigation, prioritization, resolution, and customer communication.
Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Develop and maintain requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation for assigned fixes and enhancements, with guidance and review. Collaborate with product and engineering to clarify expected behavior and ensure requirements are actionable and testable.
Roadmap Contribution and Execution: Share responsibility with senior product managers for the roadmap of assigned capabilities. Provide input based on customer feedback, support trends, product quality, and workflow needs. Support agreed priorities across maintenance, enhancements, technical debt, and lifecycle activities.
Clinical Workflow Understanding: Develop a working understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, and clinical communication. Partner with clinical experts to understand current workflows and validate proposed changes.
Customer and User Engagement: Participate in customer and internal stakeholder discussions to capture requirements, understand workflow challenges, and gather feedback. Advocate for customer needs with guidance, document findings, and support follow-up on product questions and issues.
Product Validation, Safety, and Quality: Contribute to user testing and perform feature acceptance testing against agreed requirements. About the Team

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.
What will you do
Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.
What you will need
Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::
5+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
An AI-forward way of working. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
A business owner's mindset. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
Technical fluency. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
A strong point of view, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.
What you'll be doing::
Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and execution-oriented Product Manager who will act as a central coordination point between the Sales, Marketing, Product Coordination, and Product Development functions.

The primary responsibility of this role is to take end-to-end ownership of product delivery commitments made to clients by the Sales team and ensure that products currently under development are completed, made market-ready, and successfully handed over to the Marketing team for launch.

The individual will work closely with our existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, who are responsible for managing individual products and development programs and coordinating with engineering management and development teams.

The new Product Manager will oversee and coordinate across these program owners, track overall progress, ensure alignment on priorities and deadlines, proactively identify bottlenecks, and take ownership of ensuring that business commitments are fulfilled.

This is a highly coordination-driven and ownership-oriented role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, work with cross-functional teams, proactively identify challenges, and drive timely execution.

*2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Client-Specific Product Delivery Management*

· Take complete ownership of product delivery commitments made by the Sales team to different clients.

· Coordinate with the respective Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers responsible for the development of those products or features.

· Ensure that client-specific requirements, priorities, and committed delivery timelines are clearly communicated to the respective program owners.

· Maintain proactive tracking of multiple ongoing client deliveries, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines across different programs.

· Regularly follow up with the respective coordinators and program managers to understand development progress and identify potential delays or roadblocks.

· Proactively identify risks, resolve coordination bottlenecks, and escalate critical issues to senior management whenever required.

· Maintain clear communication and alignment between Sales, Marketing, and Product/Program Management teams regarding delivery status, changes, and expectations.

· Ensure that client commitments are not just tracked but successfully fulfilled, taking full accountability for overall delivery outcomes.

*B. Product Completion & Market Launch Management*

· Take ownership of existing products and features that are in the development or finalization stage.

· Work closely with the respective Product Coordinators and Program Managers to ensure pending development activities are completed.

· Track product readiness, identify gaps, and drive closure of pending requirements before launch.

· Ensure completed products and features are properly documented and handed over to the Marketing team.

· Work closely with Marketing to communicate product capabilities, features, use cases, and launch requirements.

· Ensure products are ready for marketing campaigns, customer demonstrations, and commercial rollout.

· Track the overall product launch pipeline and ensure products do not remain indefinitely in the development or finalization stage.

*C. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management*

· Act as the central coordination point between Sales, Marketing, and the existing Product Coordination / Program Management teams.

· Maintain visibility into the progress of all ongoing product development initiatives and client-specific commitments.

· Ensure business priorities, client requirements, and deadlines are aligned with the respective program owners.

· Conduct regular follow-ups and status reviews to ensure timely execution.

· Proactively identify dependencies, delays, resource constraints, and risks that could impact product delivery.

· Coordinate with the relevant program owners to resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to senior management, engineering management, or the CEO whenever necessary.

· Keep senior management informed about delivery progress, critical dependencies, risks, and challenges.

· Ensure smooth information flow between technical and non-technical teams.

*Important clarification about the role:* The Product Manager will primarily coordinate with the existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers rather than directly managing developers or assigning day-to-day technical development tasks. The respective program owners will continue to manage development execution through engineering management and development teams. However, the new Product Manager will be accountable for tracking and driving overall delivery outcomes.

*3. Candidate Profile & Required Experience*

We are specifically looking for someone with:

· Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

· Exposure to international markets and experience working with international clients or customers, preferably the US market.

· Previous experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.

· Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, particularly Sales, Product, Program Management, and Engineering functions.

· Experience in product delivery management, program coordination, product operations, or product management.

· Strong project execution, delivery management, and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, client commitments, products, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Experience tracking deliverables through multiple project or program owners.

· A proactive approach to identifying problems, following up, and ensuring things get completed.

*4. Preferred Mindset & Additional Requirements*

· Flexible and adaptable to a fast-paced startup environment.

· Willingness to multitask and take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

· Strong execution-oriented mindset rather than just planning and reporting.

· Ability and willingness to learn the technical aspects of AI-powered products and solutions.

· Willingness to understand the construction technology industry and its workflows.

· Good communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Ability to work independently, drive accountability, and ensure follow-through without requiring constant supervision.

*5. What We Are Looking For*

The ideal candidate should be able to ensure that:

1. Whatever Sales commits to clients gets delivered within the agreed timelines.

2. All existing Product Coordinators and Program Managers are aligned with business priorities and client delivery commitments.

3. The overall progress of multiple products and development programs is proactively tracked.

6. Products nearing completion are driven towards launch readiness.

About Tekion

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.

About the Role

Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.

What You’ll Do

• Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

• Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

• Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

• Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

What We’re Looking For

• Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

• Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

• A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

• A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

• Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

Why Join Us

• Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

• Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

• See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

• Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

The Digital Services AI Product team is building the foundation for the next generation of help experiences on eBay. We are focused on making support personalized, effortless, fast, and trusted, providing seamless help where and when customers need it.

With hundreds of millions of listings and a global community of buyers and sellers, eBay’s scale creates a unique opportunity to transform how people find help, resolve issues, and navigate an increasingly complex global commerce and regulatory environment. We are developing an ecosystem of AI Agents and composable AI platforms that enable adaptive, scalable help experiences across every customer touchpoint.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will define and lead the strategy for how we design, build, and scale AI-powered help experiences, including capabilities that help eBay address product regulatory compliance requirements and policies at scale. You will work closely with design, engineering, data science, operations, policy, legal, and compliance teams to turn emerging AI capabilities, customer needs, and regulatory requirements into simple, trusted, and impactful products for customers and the business.

What You Will Accomplish

Define the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for AI Agents, composable AI platforms, and capabilities supporting product regulatory compliance and trusted commerce experiences.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and data to improve how regulatory requirements and product policies are understood, operationalized, and surfaced across customer experiences.
Translate customer, business, policy, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product direction and requirements.
Partner with Legal, Policy, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Engineering, Design, and Data Science to build scalable solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory obligations, and business objectives.
Use data and experimentation to guide decisions, measure impact, identify emerging risks, and drive continuous improvement.
Bring customer insights, regulatory developments, data, and industry trends together to inform product strategy and improve the product experience.
Develop scalable capabilities that can adapt to evolving product regulations, marketplace policies, and requirements across markets and jurisdictions.
Partner closely with design, engineering, and data science to deliver reliable, explainable, and high-quality AI-powered products at scale.
Build alignment and strong partnerships across teams to stay focused on shared goals and drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Keep customer trust, safety, and ease of use at the center of product decisions while enabling eBay to meet its regulatory and policy commitments.


What You Will Bring

6+ years of product management experience, ideally including experience with AI/ML, data-driven products, trust, risk, compliance, policy, or marketplace platforms.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve customer experiences and solve complex customer or business problems, such as conversational AI, decisioning, classification, policy interpretation, or workflow automation.
Experience working on product regulatory compliance, trust, risk, policy, or other regulated product domains is highly valued.
Ability to translate complex regulatory, policy, operational, and technical requirements into scalable product capabilities and intuitive customer experiences.
Skilled at using data and insights to uncover opportunities, drive prioritization, assess risk, and measure success.
Technical fluency and foresight to collaborate effectively with engineers, data scientists, and AI/ML teams.
Strong judgment when working with AI-powered products where accuracy, explainability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance are important.
High ownership mindset with a bias for action and focus on creating customer and business impact.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams, including Legal, Compliance, Policy, and Operations.
Experience building 0→1 products and navigating ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder environments with confidence.
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, customer support, self-service, trust, risk, or regulatory technology is a plus but not required.


Additional Details

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. About EdgeVerve
EdgeVerve Systems Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Infosys) builds AI-, automation-, and analytics-led digital platforms that help enterprises transform operations at scale, with security and scalability at the core
About AI Next
