AI Next also includes platform capabilities that support flexible model choices and enterprise-ready foundations for secure, scalable deployments.

Role Summary
We are looking for a strategic and technically savvy Product Manager to lead AI‑First initiatives within our AI Next Platform team. This role focuses on creating scalable, high-impact AI solutions by partnering closely with data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to productize cutting-edge machine learning models and AI capabilities.
As the champion of AI‑first thinking, you will help define and drive the roadmap for AI‑powered features, platform services, infrastructure, and tools that power intelligent applications across the organization and/or for external customers.

Key Responsibilities
Market and Competitive Analysis: Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes in the iPaaS space.
Product Roadmap & Strategy: Develop product vision and roadmap based on market insights, customer feedback, and business goals. Own the product strategy and roadmap for AI‑first capabilities and features across the applied AI platform.
Requirement Gathering & Prioritization: Collaborate with stakeholders, including customers, sales, and customer support teams, to understand their requirements and prioritize features.
Product Development & Execution: Work closely with engineering, design, and other teams to ensure the successful development and delivery of product features.
Translate AI research, prototypes, and experimentation into production-ready products by working closely with research, data science, MLOps, and engineering teams.
Define requirements for AI services, APIs, platform components, and infrastructure needed to support enterprise-scale AI use cases.
Collaborate with UX, engineering, and stakeholders to prioritize AI use cases that deliver measurable business value and outcomes.
Establish clear KPIs/OKRs to measure impact and performance of AI-driven features; continuously optimize using data and insights.
Evangelize an“AI‑First” mindset across product and business units—help teams adopt AI as a native capability in their products.
Stay on top of AI/ML trends including foundation models, generative AI, and MLOps best practices, and convert learnings into actionable platform strategy.
Drive experimentation and model validation pipelines, ensuring deployed models meet expectations on reliability, fairness, and explainability.
Partner with Responsible AI / compliance stakeholders to ensure AI initiatives align with ethical, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Create strong product artifacts (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria), communicate trade-offs, and ensure crisp alignment across cross-functional teams (UX/Eng/Data Science/GTB/Support).
Support go-to-market readiness by enabling internal stakeholders with positioning, value narratives, and adoption plans (as applicable to the platform/module owned).

Required Skills
Product Management & Execution
Hands-on experience in Product Management / Product Owner roles (B2B/enterprise product experience preferred).
Strong ability to define problems, identify user/value drivers, write product requirements, and drive prioritization using data and business impact.
Familiarity with Agile development practices (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, and iterative delivery.
Technical & AI/Platform Understanding
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts (e.g., model lifecycle, evaluation metrics, inference vs. training, drift/monitoring).
Exposure to APIs, platform products, and enterprise SaaS concepts (multi-tenant considerations, reliability, security, scalability).
High comfort collaboration with engineering and data science teams; ability to translate between technical and business contexts.
Stakeholder & Communication
Strong stakeholder management & ability to align diverse groups and drive decisions amid ambiguity.
Excellent written and verbal communication, structured thinking, and storytelling for leadership and cross-functional teams.
Responsible AI & Governance Mindset
Awareness of privacy, security, and Responsible AI considerations (bias, explainability, guardrails, human-in-the-loop patterns).
Industry Knowledge
Industry knowledge across Supply Chain, FMCG, Retail, Sales and Distribution.
Education / Experience
MBA from a good-tier institute.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Computer Science / related field
5+ years of relevant Product Management/Product Ownership experience.
Experience in one of the following preferred - Business Process orchestration, Agentic AI solutions, Data orchestration, Transformation and Operational transformation

This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Product Manager in the Product Operating Model (POM), your focus is on defining, prioritizing, and delivering products or capabilities that solve customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. You are accountable for the success of your product, partnering closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. You balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility to ensure your product creates real value.

In This Role You Will Get To

1. Product Discovery & Strategy

Understand the flight order lifecycle through research, data analysis, and feedback loops
Define the product vision, goals, and outcomes in alignment with the group and portfolio strategy to reduce risk to flights P&L. 
Research, troubleshoot, diagnose, and recommend solutions to complex business and technical problems.
Translate data insights and market trends into product opportunities
Outcome Ownership
Define, track, and deliver against product outcomes, lagging and leading indicators. Focussed on outcomes over output. 
Balance short-term risks, long-term opportunities , technical debt, and enabler work in your product backlog
Continuously evaluate whether product initiatives are driving intended value
Stakeholder Alignment & Communication
Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, including Commercial Teams, Finance, Technology, Accounting, and Financial Planning & Analysis to bring products to market.
Partner with business sponsors, portfolio managers, and cross-functional teams to align on outcomes
Partner with Data teams to identify insights that drive faster decision making. Act as the voice of the flights business and advocate for value delivery in decision-making.
Planning & Execution
Lead quarterly and sprint planning for your product team with an outcomes focused approach. 
Ensure dependencies are identified, managed, and communicated
Participate in demos, standups, and retrospectives to support delivery progress
Roll up your sleeves. We are a lean team and there is no job either big or too small. Some days you will be planning for the next quarter, and other days you will be diving into database records or inspecting API responses to help the development team troubleshoot an issue. We are very hands-on.

Who You Are

Requires a Bachelor's degree; an MBA is preferred.
4-6 years of experience taking full ownership of product success by defining visions and managing priorities to drive business and customer value.
A strategic thinker capable of connecting business opportunities with technical execution across engineering and design teams.
Strong quantitative skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making; knowledge of SQL, Tableau, and BigQuery is advantageous.
Active practitioner of the Product Operating Model, skilled at making trade-offs and empowering teams to deliver consistent value.
An effective communicator who builds alignment across teams and stakeholders fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity within the Flights team and throughout the organization
Experienced at translating complex problems into clear product requirements and roadmaps with a strong understanding of technical architecture,
Highly organized, self-directed, and focused on outcomes over output
Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

Key Roles and Responsibilities
Develop the long-term vision and strategy for the product and create and execute on a compelling roadmap
Build deep user empathy with Alacriti’s clients and partners, understanding global payment industry trends and competitors' offerings to influence the roadmap effectively
Collaborate with engineering, design and other teams to jointly shape product experiences that delight end-users
Ensure we are building a reliable, performant platform, including system reliability, API extensibility, and latency

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for precise and concise articulation of user problems
Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments (e.g., holdback tests), and using data to measure product impact on revenue, adoption and margins
Experience working on products that require aligning multiple stakeholders, developing joint roadmaps, and navigating competing priorities between internal goals and external partner objectives
Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility
Strong business acumen and comfort with complex ecosystem and platform-level problems

Who you are

Data-Driven Decision-Making: Experience defining product success metrics, analyzing performance data, and measuring business impact.
Customer-Centric Mindset: Strong problem-discovery skills and the ability to translate user needs into effective product solutions.

At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We are looking for a high-performing Senior Product Manager – Technical to own and drive the product strategy for enterprise-ready Business Account Management capabilities, with a focus on enabling large multinational organizations to seamlessly adopt and scale Amazon Business across their global operations.

In this role, you will work backwards from the needs of enterprise procurement leaders, IT administrators, and end-users at Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies to define, build, and launch capabilities that simplify account onboarding, user governance, organizational hierarchy management, and cross-border account administration. You will build AI and agentic solutions to automate account configuration, administration tasks, and intelligent onboarding workflows for enterprise customers. Work Backwards from the Customer: Deeply understand the needs of enterprise procurement, IT, and finance stakeholders at large multinational organizations; translate those needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
Enterprise-Ready Capabilities: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for features such as multi-entity account hierarchies, cross-border account management, SSO/identity federation, delegated admin controls, bulk user provisioning, and compliance/governance frameworks.

Innovation: Identify new opportunities to innovate on behalf of enterprise customers; deliver innovative, simple solutions that impact thousands of business customers globally.

You will define and prioritize the product roadmap for enterprise account management, writing requirements and leading sprint planning with engineering. Day-to-day, you'll conduct customer discovery calls with Fortune 500 procurement leaders and IT administrators, analyze account onboarding and adoption metrics, and author product artifacts to align stakeholders and leadership. The Foundational Services team within Amazon Business is responsible for giving large business customers a seamless and robust experience to onboard and manage their employees' accounts using Amazon Business. We are building the next generation of enterprise-ready capabilities to serve large multinational customers operating across multiple countries, currencies, and regulatory environments.

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

The Product Manager will lead the development and evolution of digital learning and knowledge-sharing platforms that connect educators and accelerate educational impact worldwide. You will own the product strategy and end-to-end delivery of a global knowledge-sharing portal while overseeing a broader portfolio of learning technologies and digital tools. Working closely with international program teams, engineers, content specialists, and external technology partners, you will translate user needs into scalable product solutions. You will also contribute to emerging generative AI initiatives, exploring innovative ways to improve knowledge discovery, accessibility, and user engagement. This role combines hands-on product management, strategic vendor oversight, and cross-functional leadership within a globally distributed team. It offers an opportunity to use technology and innovation to support educational equity and strengthen collaboration across international communities.

Accountabilities

As Product Manager, Global Learning & Knowledge Platforms, you will oversee a portfolio of digital products designed to facilitate learning, knowledge exchange, and collaboration across international networks. You will take ownership of product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and delivery while ensuring that platforms remain aligned with organizational objectives and user needs.

Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and manage product strategies, roadmaps, and priorities for the global learning and knowledge-sharing platform portfolio, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.

User Research and Discovery: Conduct product discovery and user research to understand the needs of global educators, program teams, content owners, and other stakeholders, translating insights into actionable product requirements.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in digital product development, knowledge platforms, or digital learning ecosystems. Strong ownership and execution skills, with the ability to translate broad organizational objectives into actionable roadmaps, priorities, and measurable deliverables.

Job Description

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

What We Need

Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.
Hands-on with AI agents — you've actually built something with LLMs, not just read about them. Prompt engineering is table stakes.
Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.
Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.

This is not a feature PM role. There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.

What you'll do -

Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist

Mandatory Qualifications

You are obsessed with users but grounded in business and data.
You have 8+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.
You're hands-on, hungry, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
You have a strong command over product analytics and experimentation frameworks.
You understand technology deeply enough to work well with engineers, but your core superpower is thinking from a customer-first and business-first lens.
You think in systems, love solving root problems, and approach prioritization through impact and effort.
You’re structured in thinking, biased for action, and love taking ownership end-to-end.

The Role 

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for aSenior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

What You'll Do

Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy

Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

Build Data-Driven Fraud Products

Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

Lead Product Execution

Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

Manage Fraud & Risk Events

Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

Collaborate Across Tala

Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

What You'll Need

5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.

About The Role

Cornerstone's Intelligence+ portfolio is building the workforce intelligence layer for the world's largest organizations — connecting skills, roles, people, and external labor market data into a single decision-making fabric. At the heart of this is a family of analytics and insight products that turn complex, multi-source data into trusted answers for enterprise leaders.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Our client is on a mission to make school transportation safer for children and communities. As a leader in AI-powered safety solutions, our client brings cutting-edge technology—AI, machine learning, and IoT—to school buses across North America.

Key Outcomes

This role is critical to transforming how our client thinks about the health and lifecycle of our units deployed in the field and the experience of numerous internal and external stakeholders (target users). High-level goals for this new capability include:

Reduce mean time to resolve (MTTR) for bus and hardware issues by 25–50% within 12 months. 
Increase in-field uptime of critical hardware kits (e.g., cameras, sensors, edge devices) by a defined target (e.g., X%) through improved monitoring, diagnostics, and maintenance workflows. 
Clarify and prioritize asset criticality, enabling operations teams to focus on buses and routes with the greatest safety and enforcement impact. 
Improve detection, triage and automated remediation of asset issues (e.g., false alarms, connectivity problems, firmware regressions) through better dashboards, alerts, and root-cause analysis tools. 
Strengthen collaboration between Product, Hardware, Firmware, Data, Operations, and Support, with a shared set of metrics and a transparent roadmap in Jira. 

Responsibilities

Own the Vision & Roadmap

Define the strategy for Asset Health across BusPatrol's hardware portfolio, with a clear, data- driven strategy for reliability, availability, and lifecycle management. 
Balance user empathy with enforcement rigor to drive behavior change. 
Make clear trade-offs between short-term reliability fixes and longer-term platform investments, ensuring we build for scale. 

Lead with Data and Insight

Define and own key performance indicators for Asset Health (e.g., MTTR, failure rates, uptime, alert precision/recall). 
Leverage strong analytical skills to do impact sizing, opportunity assessment, and "Fermi style” estimation to guide decision-making. 
Establish feedback loops with internal users and customers to continuously refine problem definitions, success metrics, and solutions. 

Design for Predictive Maintenance & Operational Excellence

Partner with Hardware, Firmware, and Data teams to design telemetry and diagnostics needed to predict failures before they affect service. 
Define health indicators and thresholds (e.g., error rates, connectivity drops, temperature, performance degradation) and ensure they are surfaced in usable tools. 
Build or enhance internal tools, dashboards, and workflows that help Support and Operations quickly identify, triage, and resolve asset issues. 
Incorporate behavioral design principles so internal users know when to act, what to do, and how to prioritize among competing alerts. 

Drive Experimentation in a Regulated, B2G Environment

Innovate testing to design pilots, phased rollouts, and proxy metrics that work in a B2G context. 
Collaborate with government partners and school districts to validate changes within legal and contractual frameworks. 
Use structured experimentation and strong metrics to de-risk changes that affect enforcement, evidence quality, and service levels. 

Foster Cross-Functional Alignment

Act as a quarterback for a broader set of teams when issues are root caused to various layers in the technology stack, hardware, firmware, software, human process 
Partner closely with many stakeholder groups across the company 
Communicate roadmap and trade-offs clearly to executives and external partners. 

Champion Governance, Safety & Compliance

Ensure asset-related data and monitoring solutions respect privacy, retention, and evidentiary requirements, in collaboration with Legal and Compliance. Especially navigating these challenges from outside the United States. 
Balance the need for rich telemetry and model training data with evolving data privacy and retention constraints. 
Advocate for transparency and auditability in the systems that support enforcement and evidence integrity. 

What You Bring

7+ years in product management, with experience in predictive maintenance, asset monitoring, or similar, especially in B2G. 
Experience working with hardware + software products (e.g., cameras, sensors, IoT devices, edge computing, or telematics). 
Strong analytical skills, comfortable with proxy metrics, impact sizing, and experimentation. 
Ability to navigate ambiguity and regulatory complexity with creativity and rigor. 
Exceptional communication skills for executive and government audiences. 
Experience in automated traffic enforcement or fleet safety is a strong plus. 
A bias for action, the experience to lead from the front, and the wisdom to empower others while leading from the back. 
Proven ability to lead cross-functional strategic initiatives with senior executives. 
Proven experience leading high impact teams across time zones. 
Strong data science and analytical skills with experience in sizing, Fermi style estimation, impact analysis, metrics, experiments, and measurement. 
Comfortable with ambiguity, developing clear and concise priorities and roadmaps. 
Demonstrated track record of leading cross-functional initiatives that involve senior executives and multiple stakeholder groups. 
Experience collaborating with distributed teams across time zones; comfortable working remotely from India while partnering closely with North American counterparts.

About The Role

We're building India's premium retail media platform, taking the commerce and AdTech infrastructure we've built and battle-tested at scale and externalizing it as a high-performance ads platform for brands, sellers and retail partners. This is a rare opportunity to productize proven infrastructure: high-QPS ad serving inside live shopping journeys, rich first-party commerce signals and closed-loop measurement that connects ad spend directly to sales.

We're looking for a Staff product manager who can operate as true owners, people who go deep on the problem, write the doc, align the room, ship, refine and repeat. This is an individual contributor role with outsized scope and direct access to leadership, customers and partners.

What You'll Do

Own the product end-to-end. Break down the vision, define the scope for your area of the retail media stack- from competitor research and seller ecosystem discoveries through PRDs, MVPs, launch and iteration. You write crisp docs, and your docs drive decisions.
Translate business goals into product strategy. Take ambiguous, high-stakes objectives, monetization targets, brand adoption, shopper experience guardrails and turn them into a clear, sequenced roadmap with measurable outcomes.
Ship, measure, refine. Break complex problems into executable slices, run tight sprints with engineering, define success metrics upfront (ROAS, ACOS, relevance scores, incrementality) and iterate fast on real data, delivering at scale and on time.
Build experiences, not just features. Obsess over both sides of the marketplace: brands and sellers who need intuitive self-serve tools, and shoppers whose experience must never degrade for the sake of monetization. Think in ecosystems campaign consoles, APIs, reporting, retail partner workflows, not isolated deliverables.
Balance relevance and revenue. Partner deeply with search, recommendations and data science teams on auction mechanics, product relevance/ranking and ad-load decisions where commerce relevance and monetization meet.
Drive alignment across the company. Work daily with engineering, QA, ops, category, and seller-facing teams and liaise with Legal, Finance, IT, and Regulatory on the things that make or break an ad platform including (but not limiting to) privacy, compliance, billing, fair marketplace policies.
Be the face of the product externally. Engage directly with brands, sellers, retail and tech partners, from discovery conversations to API and feed integration deep-dives and bring their voice back into the roadmap.
Influence without authority. Communicate product vision clearly to senior leadership and key stakeholders and shape how the platform is positioned in the retail media market.

What We're Looking For

4-8 years of product management experience, with meaningful time in retail media or commerce ads. You've built or scaled ad products on a marketplace, e-commerce/q-commerce platforms, retail media networks or commerce DSPs.
Hands-on exposure to the retail media stack. Sponsored products, sponsored brands, PLA/PLP (collection based display ads), Search Ads. Understands ad placements, auction design and bidding (CPC/CPM, second-price), budget pacing and self-serve campaign management for advertisers of every size from enterprise brands to long-tail sellers.
Fluency in commerce data and measurement. First-party shopper signals, catalog and feed integrations, closed-loop attribution, ROAS and incrementality measurement with exposure to clean rooms, audience products with offsite extension to programmatic and social.
Strong grasp of marketplace dynamics and privacy. You understand the tension between ad load and shopper experience, fair-ranking and marketplace-neutrality considerations and the evolving privacy landscape (DPDP, GDPR, consent frameworks, and the post-cookie shift).
Sharp analytical instincts. You're comfortable in data, defining metrics, sizing opportunities, debugging funnel drops and making a quantitative case for your roadmap.

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. About The Role

Payment is the moment a customer decides to complete a booking or walk away. As an Associate Product Manager – Payments, you will own journeys at this step for GCC customers who pay in AED, SAR and USD using local cards, wallets, Apple Pay, bank-linked payments and loyalty points.

You will work with a senior product owner, engineering, finance, design, analytics and external payment partners to raise payment success, widen payment-method coverage and manage the cost of every transaction.

What will you be doing

Payment success: analyze drop-offs and failures by payment method, issuing bank, gateway, currency and device; run experiments to lift success rate and checkout conversion. 
Local and alternate payment methods: drive integration and launch of methods preferred in the UAE, KSA and wider GCC, and improve how customers discover them at the payment step. 
Gateway and processor partnerships: work with payment partners on integrations, smart routing, retries and performance reviews. 
Payment cost and P& L: help reduce processing cost per transaction through routing, pricing and mix decisions, without hurting success rate. 
Checkout experience: design, test and improve a fast, clear and trusted payment experience across web , Android and iOS. 
Authentication and compliance: partner with risk, finance and engineering on 3D Secure, tokenization , fraud controls and local regulatory requirements. 
Loyalty and offers at payment: improve how customers redeem points, bank offers and promotions at checkout. 
Metrics and reporting: own dashboards for payment success, conversion, cost and method mix, and turn the data into clear recommendations. 
Delivery: write product requirements, manage releases with engineering, design and QA, and measure impact after launch. 

Qualification & Experience

MBA from a reputable institute; an engineering background is preferred. 
1–3 years of experience in product management, or in payments, fintech, e-commerce, travel or consumer internet. 
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break ambiguous problems into clear actions. 
Working knowledge of SQL and dashboards; comfort reading funnel and conversion data. 
Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, business and external partners

Familiarity with Adobe Analytics or similar tools.

Customer centricity: deep interest in why customers succeed or fail at payment. 
Ownership and execution: turns ideas into shipped products with cross-functional teams. 
Analytical rigor : decisions backed by data and clear success metrics. 
Innovation and agility: keen to experiment, learn fast and adapt to new markets.

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Product Manager- Technical

Overview

Are you a product management professional who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?

ROLE

We are looking for seasoned Product Management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Product Management-Technical (PM-T) are technical roles and work closely with Technical Program Managers, Software Design Engineers, User Experience, Operations and internal customers to define the details behind the business requirements, the specifications, the user experience, and the API strategy for platform building blocks they own. Our PM-Ts use the Working Backwards process, which is all about is fleshing out the concept and achieving clarity of thought about what will ultimately be built. PM-Ts are in it for the long term, looking beyond the current project to become experts in their domain. They feed engineering a well groomed and backlog of user stories. They encourage re-use of their building blocks, continuously innovating on behalf of internal and external customers. As new capabilities are required, they will define its place in the platform ecosystem and write / prioritize the user stories to build the new block. When commercialization opportunities are identified for their building blocks, they will tee up ideas to the product development teams for further development.

All About You

Like to dive deep into the operational characteristics of the product
Demonstrated ability to operate with complete independence and autonomy
Experience defining and building cloud-native software products as a platform at scale

Cards and or Payments expertise a huge plus
BE/BS/MBA in related discipline.
Product development experience

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Multi Enterprise Interoperability and B2B Integration | Pune India | TraceLink

Role purpose

TraceLink is seeking a Senior Product Manager to define and scale reusable canonical transaction models for multi-enterprise value chains. The role converts complex business workflows and heterogeneous partner messages into standards-aligned, implementation-ready product specifications that can be reused across industries, customers, partners, applications, and integration technologies.

This person will operate at the intersection of product management, multi-enterprise business processes, B2B standards, enterprise applications, and data modeling. Success requires more than gathering requirements: the role must determine the business meaning of a transaction, reconcile industry standards and customer variants, define a durable canonical model, and guide that model through subtype design, transforms, user experience, testing, release, adoption, and lifecycle governance. The resulting models must work across Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Logistics, Medical devices, Healthcare, Food and Beverage, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, and other partner-intensive industries.

What You Will Own

A portfolio of canonical transactions across order management, procurement, planning, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, logistics, transportation, customs, finance, master data, and operational messaging. 
Research the end-to-end business process, including how a transaction is generated and triggered, sender and receiver roles, expected response, exception paths, regulatory implications, and system-of-record behavior for each transaction. 
Normalize equivalent business concepts across such global data standards as JSon and XML, ANSI X12, SAP IDoc, UN/EDIFACT and EANCOM, GS1, ODETTE and VDA, UBL and Peppol, and a variety of ERP system APIs while preserving source-specific semantics, version differences, qualifiers, and implementation constraints. 
Define canonical object structures, reusable components, identifiers, references, parties, locations, dates, quantities, amounts, statuses, code lists, conditions, loops, cardinality, and validation rules.,
Design canonical schema data structures for reuse across partner roles such as buyers, suppliers, manufacturers, contract manufacturers, distributors, warehouses, 3PLs and 4PLs, carriers, automotive OEMs and tier suppliers, retailers, marketplaces, dealers, service providers, customs participants, and regulatory stakeholders. 
Produce canonical designs and documentation, field-level mapping specifications, business rules, sample JSON and XML payloads, subtype requirements, picklists or enumerations, and transformation acceptance criteria. 
Create detailed specifications for transformations between global data standards and TraceLink canonical structures for both inbound and outbound interfaces across a complete range of transactions and business processes, including formats for standard LinkActions that drive connectivity to major ERP systems, reference-data conversion, test data, system reconciliation, and error handling. 
Perform gap analysis against customer and industry implementation guidelines, sample messages, ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, and commerce-platform structures, and existing TraceLink canonicals; distinguish true canonical gaps from mapping, configuration, reference-data, or source-data issues. 
Partner with Architecture and Engineering on schema design tradeoffs, extensibility, backward compatibility, versioning, performance, UI depth constraints, and migration strategy. 
Create, groom, and prioritize system documentation in Epics and Stories. Define acceptance criteria; review implementations; support QA automation and regression testing with representative customer files, and release readiness. 
Govern the transaction lifecycle by assessing enhancement requests, preventing customer-specific overfitting, maintaining compatibility, standardizing code lists, and measuring reuse, adoption, defects, and delivery speed. 
Serve as the product expert for customers and internal teams, supporting discovery, design reviews, implementation decisions, demos, enablement, and roadmap prioritization. 

Required Qualifications

7+ years of product management, business analysis, solution architecture, integration consulting, or standards implementation experience in multi-enterprise supply chains, B2B integration, ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, commerce, or manufacturing platforms. 
Demonstrated ability to model complex business transactions and translate process semantics into structured schemas, mappings, validation rules, and testable requirements. 
Working knowledge of at least two enterprise B2B formats or integration ecosystems, such as JSon and XML, ANSI X12, SAP IDoc, UN/EDIFACT, EANCOM, GS1, cXML, OAGIS, ODETTE and VDA, UBL and Peppol, APIs, or ERP-native business objects. 
Strong understanding of multi-enterprise flows across master data, forecasts, orders, schedules, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, fulfillment, shipping, receiving, transportation, invoicing, settlement, traceability, and exception handling. 
Ability to read implementation guidelines and sample payloads at segment, element, qualifier, loop, and cardinality level and explain their business meaning to technical and nontechnical audiences. 
Experience working with Architecture, Engineering, UX, QA, Services, and customer-facing teams through discovery, specification, delivery, validation, and release. 
Strong analytical judgment: can separate a reusable product requirement from customer-specific configuration and make explicit tradeoffs around scope, compatibility, and time to market. 
Clear written and verbal communication, including concise product requirements, design reviews, customer workshops, executive updates, and enablement content. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more partner-intensive industries such as Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Logistics, Medical devices, Healthcare, Food and Beverage, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, and other partner-intensive or regulated industries. 
Exposure to such cross-industry concerns as traceability, product and location identification, quality, customs, sustainability, cold chain, recalls, or regulatory compliance is valuable. 
Hands-on familiarity with enterprise processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, forecast-to-fulfill, plan-to-produce, inventory and warehouse management, transportation, product information, and financial settlement. 
Experience with SAP or other ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, MES, PIM, marketplace, or commerce platforms is valuable. 
Experience designing canonical or common data models, API resources, event schemas, master-data structures, reference-data management, or schema governance.

Mstack wants its B2B chemicals commerce to run itself. AI agents and automated workflows will handle the routine work, and people will spend their time on decisions that need judgment. We’re hiring a hands-on product leader to own this charter and make it happen.

What you’ll own
The charter has four areas, and each one has its own metrics:
Core commerce workflows: lead management, quoting, procurement and supplier sourcing, logistics, fulfilment, invoicing and collections. You’ll track lead-to-order conversion, quote turnaround, order cycle time, on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery and days sales outstanding (DSO).
Commerce platforms: CRM, ERP, buyer and supplier portals, integrations, and communication with buyers and suppliers. You’ll track adoption, data accuracy, integration uptime and response times.
Intelligence for commerce: business intelligence, demand and price signals, supplier performance and margin visibility. You’ll track forecast accuracy, gross margin per order, time from data to decision, and the share of reports people pull themselves.

Strategy and outcomes
Set product scope and priorities with business leaders, tied to revenue, margin and cost-to-serve goals.
Own the annual operating plan (AOP) for commerce products with the technology team. Run its governance: quarterly roadmap reviews, capacity planning, delivery tracking and trade-off calls.
Set the charter’s metrics, track them and report progress to leadership.
Building autonomous commerce
Work with sales, procurement, supply chain and finance to map how work runs today and where it breaks.
Rethink business intelligence and process workflows for an AI-first operation, rather than digitising the current process as it is.
Build autonomous workflows yourself: design agents, write prompts and evals, set human approval points, and prototype with AI and automation tools.
Run go-to-market with business teams, covering rollout plans, training, adoption tracking and feedback after launch.
Leadership and orchestration
Lead and coach PMs or analysts, depending on the level of the hire.
Bring engineering, data, design, operations and business teams together behind one shared plan.
Make prioritisation and trade-off decisions across teams, and resolve conflicts quickly.
Give leadership clear, numbers-first updates on progress, risks and results.

3 to 10 years in product management on B2B commerce, supply chain, procurement or enterprise workflow products.
Experience working directly with sales, procurement or finance teams to define and ship workflows.

Clear writing and a habit of making decisions with data.

Experience in chemicals, industrial goods or cross-border trade.
Multi-step AI agents built and running in production.
Exposure to ERP, CRM or procurement systems such as Dynamics, Bitrix24 or HubSpot.

Experience taking a B2B product from 0 to 1.

By day 30: Map the core workflows from lead to cash with business teams, set baselines for the charter’s metrics, and ship one automation that removes manual work.
By day 90: Agree priorities and the AOP with business and technology, and launch the first autonomous workflow in one area, such as quoting or procurement.

Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

We're Osome - an international fintech startup making the lives of entrepreneurs easier. We help thousands of businesses kick admin, accounting and bookkeeping out of their day-to-day, so they can spend more time on what's important to them. We've developed a unique solution that combines SaaS with a human-in-the-loop approach to provide full-fledged services in real-time.
We’re experiencing rapid growth in both client base and team, which now comprises around 500 people across our offices worldwide. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for more bright minds who are excited to make a real impact by solving complex problems.

What To Expect
Intelligence builds the AI capabilities no single team at Osome should carry alone, and helps every other team ship AI well. It works in three modes. It owns cross-cutting capability. It enables product teams by pairing with their engineers, so the pattern transfers and the team runs it afterwards. It incubates only by exception: building inside another team's area when that team has no capacity, always with a written hand-back plan.

This is a hands-on PM role. You'll find problems by talking to end users, dig into the data in BigQuery and Postgres to prioritise, prototype cheaply before committing engineering effort, and ship small fixes yourself. You'll also be the team's main liaison with Operations.

What You'll Do
Own the Intelligence roadmap, OKRs and delivery, with two or three big bets each quarter. You make the prioritisation calls, own the business outcome behind the backlog, and write the release notes when things ship.
Set the evaluation bar for AI across Osome: eval datasets, confidence thresholds, human-review sampling and go/no-go gates.
With our Security team, set the safety and data-handling bar for AI across Osome: escalation rules, pre-action checks on agents, fail-open vs fail-closed behaviour, privacy and retention, client data isolation, and provider governance (e.g. zero data retention agreements).
Define the success metrics for each AI product before it ships, then keep checking the data yourself after launch to see whether it's working. Brief the analyst on what to build, and review the result. Use that evidence to make model and provider calls, e.g. benchmark a new model against our own labelled documents before switching.
Break epics into clear stories and tasks that engineers can pick up without a meeting. Pair with product teams' engineers to build AI features, and define what "successfully handed over" means.
Be the team's liaison with Operations: run training and feedback rounds, collect baseline data, and drive adoption until the AI version beats the manual process.
Run a small research track: test new techniques and approaches (e.g. retrieval, memory or agent patterns) on our own problems, and write up what we should adopt and what we should skip.
Represent this team's priorities to senior stakeholders.
As the team grows, mentor other PMs and help manage them.

Who You Are
Evaluated against our PM capability framework. At the Senior PM level, that means:
Strategic impact: you can define and drive a strategy spanning 12 months or more for a platform-style team whose customers are other teams, tied to a company-level goal such as gross margin.
Domain ownership: you own the OKRs, roadmap and business outcome of a complex, ambiguous, cross-functional area. You understand applied LLM/ML products deeply (evaluation, retrieval, memory, agent safety), and can become credible in our accounting and operations domain within two quarters.
Collaboration: you drive high adoption of new tools with operations teams, including the processes needed to run them. You build consensus among senior leaders with conflicting goals, and you can say no while leaving the stakeholder feeling heard.
Problem-solving: you map ambiguous, system-level problems, and know when a rule, a classifier or an LLM is the right tool.
Execution: you reliably ship complex, cross-functional launches involving Operations and other product teams. You prototype to de-risk before committing engineering time, and you spot risks early.
AI-literacy: hands-on well beyond prompting. You build prototypes and ship small PRs with AI coding tools, build eval datasets and run model experiments, read traces, and judge where models fail.
Leadership: you shape direction across teams you don't manage, improve how the team works, and are ready to mentor at least one other PM as a player-coach.

What you bring
AI/ML features shipped to production, with quality measured after launch (accuracy, coverage, deflection).
Experience building evaluation datasets and running model experiments: thresholds, go/no-go gates, human-in-the-loop decisions, and reading traces in an observability tool (we use Langfuse) to see where models fail.
Experience shipping AI features that handle sensitive or financial data, and deciding when they should escalate to a human or stop.
Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to read code and ship small changes.
Strong SQL. You can pick the right metrics for a product and explain what you need to an analyst. Data modelling is not required.
Experience working directly with operations teams: running training, collecting feedback, and proving time saved against a manual baseline.
A track record of good calls under ambiguity, and of checking afterwards whether they were right.
(Nice to have) Setting company-wide safety and data-handling rules for AI: fail-open vs fail-closed policies, privacy and retention, and client data isolation, including knowing when a new AI vendor needs a security review before it sees any data.
(Nice to have) Bookkeeping or accounting literacy: enough double-entry, chart-of-accounts and GST/VAT knowledge to judge whether an AI accounts review or document check is right. Either a qualification or hands-on bookkeeping experience counts.
(Nice to have) Document AI/OCR in production: classifying or extracting invoices, bank statements and receipts, and the trade-offs between coverage, accuracy, confidence thresholds and cost.
(Nice to have) Agentic systems or MCP in production: agents or tools that take real actions, with permissions, human approval steps and multi-step evaluation.

Our Benefits
Multi-cultural environment to enhance your global perspective.
Learning opportunities and mentorship from peers and leaders.
Remote working arrangement.
An agile working model focused on goals and performance.

Equal Opportunity Statement
At OSOME, creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable really matters. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. We want to ensure that we represent the diversity of talent in the society we live in today.

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the application and interview process, please let us know so that we can support you.
We believe that entrepreneurs are society's problem solvers. They see opportunities in complexities and drive us towards progress. Osome doesn't want entrepreneurs to be distracted from the important task of searching for the best solutions. By letting us handle all the routine tasks, entrepreneurs can focus on driving their business forward.

Position Overview

The Agile Product Owner Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.

The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well-defined work items for the development team.
Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer-centric thinking and business rationale.
Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source-to-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python

Qualifications

11-13 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test-driven development.

Synechron is seeking a Product Owner with 7–12 years of experience to define and communicate product vision and strategy in alignment with business goals. Role Purpose

We’re looking for a customer-focused Product Owner who is excited by the chance to transform how major construction and infrastructure projects are delivered through smarter, more connected digital products.

Working closely with customers, engineers, designers and product leaders, you’ll turn complex, real-world industry challenges into intuitive product solutions that improve project outcomes, strengthen information management and make collaboration easier for the people delivering critical projects every day.

You’ll play a central role in deciding what we build, why it matters and how we deliver measurable value, helping shape innovative capabilities across Common Data Environments (CDE), Information Management, workflow automation, data insights and AI-enabled product experiences.

This is a high-impact opportunity to influence products used on some of the world’s most complex and high-profile projects, with the freedom to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions and help set the direction for the future of digital construction technology.
If you enjoy solving meaningful problems, working with passionate teams and seeing your ideas become real product improvements used by customers, this role offers the opportunity to make a visible difference.

Role Description

Product Strategy & Delivery
Own and prioritise the product backlog for your product area.
Turn customer problems and strategic goals into clear product requirements.
Work closely with engineering, UX and QA teams to deliver valuable, high-quality product improvements.
Balance customer needs, technical priorities and long-term product strategy.

Customer Discovery & Industry Engagement
Engage directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges and goals.
Facilitate workshops, demonstrations and discovery sessions.
Champion the voice of the customer while maintaining alignment with the wider product vision.
Use Jobs To Be Done (JTBD) techniques to uncover underlying customer needs and opportunities.

Construction & Information Management Expertise
Develop a strong understanding of construction and infrastructure delivery.
Help ensure product capabilities align with industry best practice, including Information Management and Common Data Environment (CDE) principles.
Support solutions that improve compliance, quality, governance and user experience.

Innovation & Product Growth
Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, data insights and AI-enabled capabilities.
Support product launches, customer adoption and go-to-market activities.
Use customer feedback, product usage data and market insight to shape future priorities.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Work closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, Customer Success and Commercial teams.
Communicate priorities, progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.
Build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

Skills & Experience

What We're Looking For
Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis or Agile delivery within a SaaS environment.
Strong communication skills and confidence engaging directly with customers in English.
Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities and technical considerations.
Experience working with Agile delivery teams and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or similar.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
A passion for creating products that solve real-world problems.

Highly Desirable
Experience within construction, infrastructure, engineering technology, BIM, CDE or Information Management.
Familiarity with ISO 19650 principles.
Experience with AI-enabled products, workflow automation or data-driven solutions.

Why Join Us?

You’ll help shape digital products used by major construction and infrastructure teams to deliver some of the world’s most complex projects, giving you the chance to work on technology that has a real-world impact beyond the screen.
This is a role for someone who wants more than a backlog to manage — it’s for someone who wants to influence product direction, understand industry problems deeply and help create solutions that customers genuinely rely on.

This role offers the opportunity to:
Influence and own meaningful product strategy and roadmap decisions, with the opportunity to see your ideas move from discovery through to customer adoption.
Work directly with industry-leading customers and understand first-hand how digital products can improve the way complex projects are delivered.
Explore emerging AI, automation and data-led opportunities that can redefine how information is created, managed and trusted across project teams.
Join a collaborative environment where curiosity, ownership and continuous improvement are encouraged, and where your contribution can help shape the next phase of product growth.
Solve real-world construction and information management challenges.
Be part of a growing product function with significant opportunity for personal development and progression.
Asite builds future leaders, working with us will lead to a succession plan for future growth along with training and development.

Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field, with full professional proficiency in English.

Be part of the journey. Shape the future of Finance.

Job Summary

The Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

The role also focuses on monitoring, issue resolution, process standardization, data governance, and stakeholder communication, while guiding Level 1 resources and working closely with Level 2/3 IT support teams to drive long-term stability and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Lead product discovery by gathering requirements from stakeholders, users, and technical teams.
Design, implement, and govern data quality controls, reconciliation frameworks, and exception management mechanisms.
Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products aligned with business goals.
Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, and strategic fit.
Identify high-impact opportunities where data products can improve decision-making, operations, or customer experience.
Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business leaders to deliver data products.
Drive implementation of data products in data platforms, dashboards, semantic layers, self-service analytics tools, APIs, and ML-enabled solutions.
Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure adoption, usability, data quality, and business impact.
Champion data quality, governance, documentation, and trust across products.
Ensure data products are intuitive, accessible, and fit for purpose for target users.
Manage stakeholder communication, expectations, timelines and risks.
Continuously improve products through feedback, usage insights, and performance measurement.
Support data ownership, governance frameworks, privacy, and compliance requirements where applicable.

Qualifications & Skills

7–10+ years of experience in data product management, data, analytics, or platform delivery.
Extensive hands-on and architectural experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms handling high-volume, business-critical Finance data.
Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics workflows, and reporting ecosystems.
Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Familiarity with data governance, metrics design, and data quality principles.
Experience delivering internal or external data-driven products.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Snowflake, including performance tuning, complex validations, reconciliation logic, and troubleshooting.
Strong experience with data warehousing, ETL frameworks, and cloud data platforms.

Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, controls, and reconciliation frameworks in Finance environments.
Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions: Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology: Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
Drive transformation: Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
Collaborative environment: Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
Growth & learning: Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
Global exposure: Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
Innovation-driven culture: Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

India Hybrid: Bengaluru

The Opportunity

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a Group Product Manager for the Physical AI Robotics product team. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.

Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.

Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

Product Strategy & Voice AI Innovation

Job Summary
The RD Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma RD domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner. The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. About the role:

  • As an Associate Product Manager on the VMDR team, you'll help define how security and IT teams discover, assess, prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities across on-prem, cloud, container and remote assets. Success is measured in real risk reduction (TruRisk), not raw finding counts.
  • This role is for early-career problem-solvers with hands-on vulnerability management experience who want to grow into a full product manager. You'll own well-scoped features end to end and learn alongside senior PMs, engineering and Threat Research.

Key responsibilities:

1. Product definition and roadmap

  • Collaborate with engineering to define product requirements and specifications: PRDs, user stories, prioritization logic, workflows, wireframe annotations and acceptance criteria.

  • Translate concepts such as CVSS vs. EPSS vs. QDS, asset criticality, toxic combinations, SLA breaches and MTTR into product features with measurable risk reduction.
  • Test and validate features before release: scans, detections, QQL queries, dashboards, reports and APIs.

3. Customer reporting and insight

  • Help design and generate vulnerability management reports for customers: executive TruRisk summaries
  • Partner with SMEs, SSAs/TAMs, support and customers to refine requirements, triage escalations, validate assumptions and iterate fast.
  • Define workflows for integrations with ServiceNow (ITSM/CMDB), Jira, SIEM/SOAR

4. Market research and competitive intelligence

  • Assist in market research to identify new opportunities and customer needs in vulnerability and exposure management (CTEM, attack surface management, cloud and container security).
  • Run competitive analysis against Tenable, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight and exposure management platforms; maintain feature comparison matrices.
  • Stay current on industry trends and regulatory requirements affecting VM: NIST CSF/SP 800-40, PCI DSS v4.0, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SEC cyber disclosure rules, EU NIS2, DORA, CERT-In and DPDP Act (India).

5. Product collateral and enablement

  • Create sales enablement content and support launches, webinars and customer demos.
