Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis

Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights

Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.

Job Description

Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.

The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.

You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.

The Opportunity

Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
Clients expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive finished work.
Document data extraction, preparation and review are going AI-native, and practices are adopting agentic tools now.
Practices increasingly want open APIs, so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
Regulatory change, such as Making Tax Digital, keeps raising the bar for reliability at filing peaks.

Key Responsibilities

Own the product vision and roadmap. Balance customer needs, regulatory change and commercial priorities into a clear, evidence-based plan, and own the commercially consequential decisions that follow from it.
Deliver the portfolio, season over season. Own your products end to end, at the reliability and scale that filing deadlines and compliance peaks demand.
Converge products without disrupting customers. Bring overlapping products and capabilities together into one connected experience for every practice and client, and migrate existing customers without breaking what they rely on.
Componentise the portfolio. Turn each part of the product into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the practice workflow and the wider platform, rather than locked inside a single application.
Open the platform through APIs and orchestration. Expand the API surface (open APIs, events and integrations) as a first-class capability, so practices and partners embed our products in their own portals and workflows, and AI agents and partner systems can coordinate work programmatically.
Bring agentic, AI-driven workflows to practices. Work with the platform team to bring AI-driven extraction, preparation and review into the product experience, so more of the work shifts from practice staff to the platform while the practice stays in control.
Turn customer problems into well-defined solutions. Use AI tools to turn customer problems into clear, testable requirements that engineering and design can build from with confidence, in whatever form works best for the team.
Prototype early, then build. Use Claude Code or similar tools to build working prototypes that test ideas with customers and stakeholders before significant engineering investment is made, and increasingly contribute real, reviewed code alongside engineering.
Partner heavily with engineering and design. Work side by side with engineers and designers, often shaping ideas together in prototypes and in the build itself, to prioritise the backlog, clarify requirements and remove blockers, so valuable releases reach customers predictably.
Listen to customers and use data to decide. Run discovery with accountants and practice staff, work with large practices as design partners, and use usage analytics and support insight to measure whether what we ship delivers real outcomes.
Keep stakeholders informed and aligned. Communicate progress, trade-offs and decisions clearly to senior leaders, sales, support and customer-facing teams.
Raise the team's AI capability. Share effective prompts, skills, workflows and lessons learned so that AI-assisted product practice becomes the norm across the team.

What success looks like

Practices experience one connected workflow, whatever mix of products they run today.
Our APIs are something practices and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
Practices reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through our products, season over season.
Clients get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience, and practices see measurably less manual work.
Releases land predictably, and roadmap decisions are backed by customer evidence and usage data.
Colleagues across the team are using AI-assisted ways of working because you showed them how.

Required Qualifications

Education and experience

Degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 or more years as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a software product environment, delivering in an agile/scrum setting.
Demonstrable experience turning customer problems into clear requirements and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can deliver against.
Experience working on platform, API or developer-facing capabilities, not only features on top of them.
A track record of converging, migrating or replacing product capabilities without disrupting existing customers.

Technical skills and tools

AI tools for product work (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) for drafting requirements, analysis and synthesis.
Hands-on building with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools, from prototypes through to contributing code alongside engineering.
Familiarity with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
Backlog management tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira.
Product analytics or customer feedback tools such as Pendo.
Working familiarity with APIs and product architecture: able to read API documentation, understand how services and components fit together, and discuss design trade-offs with engineers.

Core competencies

Customer focus: seeks out real user problems and keeps them central to decisions.
Systems thinking: sees a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
Structured, clear communication: writes precise requirements and explains trade-offs simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
Prioritisation and judgement: makes sound decisions with incomplete information, owns commercially consequential calls and can say no with good reasons.
Curiosity and adaptability: learns new tools and domains quickly, is comfortable in a role that is still being redefined, and leans into new ways of working.
Collaboration and ownership: partners heavily with engineers and designers, builds trust with stakeholders, influences without authority and follows through on commitments.

About Commotion
Everyone’s chasing speed, but true conversation isn’t just fast, it’s human.
People naturally pause around 200-300 ms between turns. That’s the rhythm where dialogue feels alive. Most voice systems lose reasoning and tone when they push below 500 ms.

At Commotion, we’re building full-duplex, speech-to-speech models that listen, reason, and speak at the same time. We’re achieving emotionally rich, natural turn-taking at around 500 ms, a latency that doesn’t just sound quick but feels human.

Our flagship product, Voice AI, lets anyone create autonomous voice agents that connect to multiple knowledge sources, tools, and systems to get real work done, through voice, chat, APIs, webhooks, and events. Think of it as giving every person or business their own digital teammate, and we’re just getting started.
The Role
We’re looking for a Product Manager to take complete ownership of how Voice AI is designed, implemented, and scaled for enterprise customers.
You’ll work with Product Owners on the roadmap, lead customer implementations from discovery to go-live, and make sure every deployment shows the full power of the Commotion platform.
This is a hybrid role that combines product leadership with implementation ownership. You don’t just define the vision, you deliver it.
What You’ll Own1. Product Strategy & Discovery
Identify the highest-value Voice AI use cases across enterprise customers.
Shape the roadmap for Voice AI, spanning reasoning, orchestration, latency, and integrations.
Translate customer workflows and business needs into clear product requirements and success metrics.

Drive features end to end, from concept to release.
Write crisp PRDs, set priorities, and make trade-offs that balance innovation with reliability.
Ensure platform modules (APIs, orchestration layers, and UX) ship with speed and polish.
3. Customer Implementation & Onboarding
Lead every implementation phase for new enterprise clients, from requirement discovery to go-live.
Own the integration of Voice AI into customer ecosystems: data pipelines, APIs, webhooks, telephony and voice routing, and more.
Configure, test, and optimize voice agents for smooth performance and measurable outcomes.
Deliver onboarding sessions, enablement collateral, and adoption playbooks that embed long-term success.
4. Post-Launch Success & Continuous Improvement
Monitor live call performance, usage data, and latency benchmarks to improve reliability and conversational quality.
Capture insights from customer deployments and turn them into product enhancements.
Keep refining implementation frameworks for faster, more scalable rollouts.
What We’re Looking ForExperience
2-5 years in product management in AI Agents or Voice AI.
A proven record of owning full-cycle product launches or enterprise implementations.
A strong grasp of data flows, APIs, and integration architectures.
Technical Acumen
Ability to discuss design, infrastructure, and latency trade-offs fluently.
Understanding of AI reasoning, prompt design, or real-time systems (preferred).
Bonus: experience with speech-to-speech or voice AI products.
Execution & Communication
An end-to-end owner who thrives on accountability, not coordination.
Exceptional clarity in writing, planning, and cross-functional execution.
Comfort making decisions quickly, with evidence and conviction.
Mindset
Resourceful and fast-moving: you figure things out.
Thrives in ambiguity and builds structure where none exists.

Own the product experience that defines how humans and AI talk to each other.

See your work move from idea to production, and into customer conversations, every week.

Product & solution vision (cross-functional leadership): Own the product vision for AI interfaces and agent solutions — including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights and agentic workflow tools — identifying client needs and use cases, sizing opportunities, creating prototypes with relevant cross-functional stakeholders and validating ideas with clients, translating prototypes into requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering, and leading launch and commercialization with cross-functional colleagues.

7+ years in product management or other related role, including ownership of AI/ML-enabled or data-distribution products — financial data, ESG/sustainability, or index/analytics experience preferred.

Familiarity with data distribution mechanisms — APIs, data feeds, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), and client-facing UI platforms.
Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements for engineering and user documentation for clients.
Strong executive presence — comfortable presenting to senior internal stakeholders and high-profile client stakeholders.
Track record of excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Research, Programme Management, Legal, Client Coverage and Marketing.
Demonstrated enthusiasm and curiosity for learning about and using cutting-edge AI tools and technologies

Overview

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

Opportunity

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.




Responsibilities
* Vertical Strategy. Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* Time to Payroll. Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees. 
* Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals. Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* Worker Time Tracking. Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* Commercial Impact. Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* Operational Velocity. Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* Customer Empathy. Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.


Qualifications
A Product Leader. 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
Strategic & Influential. You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
Domain Depth. You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
A Proven Growth Driver. You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
An Ambitious Problem Solver. You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
Customer Obsessed & Analytical. You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
Technical Fluency. You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
Education. BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission-critical workflows.
THE OPPORTUNITY
As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the end-to-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end-user experience
Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
Drive cross-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
4+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

About us
We build subscription apps for Bharat: the hundreds of millions of people in tier 2, 3 and 4 India who pay by UPI and live on their phones. Our apps include BhaktiLok (daily devotion, aartis, AI palm and face reading), MeraTune (ringtones with your own name in them), CashAlert (voice alerts for UPI payments) and HeyBuddy (voice lock and assistant).
We are a small team that ships fast. An idea on Monday is usually a live test by Friday, and the numbers decide who was right.

The role
You will own the path from install to paid subscriber on one or more of our apps: onboarding, paywall, trial, autopay and retention. You work directly with the founders, engineers, designers and the ads team, and you get real ownership from week one — this is a backfill role, so you'll be stepping into live funnels and running experiments from day one, not easing in slowly.
This is a junior role (6 months to 2 years of experience). We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than about your title so far.

What you'll do
• Run experiments on onboarding, paywalls, pricing and trials, from hypothesis to result, and call the winner with data.
• Live in Mixpanel: build funnels, spot where users drop, and turn that into the next test.
• Track the subscription numbers that matter: login to trial, trial to paid, autopay success, renewals and churn.
• Write short, clear PRDs and work with engineers and designers to ship them quickly.
• Tear down competitor apps and bring back what is worth testing.
• Work with the ads team so the promise in the ad matches the first screen of the app.
• Shape features around how our users actually behave: regional languages, low-end Android phones, UPI autopay habits.
• Use AI tools every day to move faster on research, specs, copy and analysis.

Who we're looking for
You should have
• A feel for consumer apps in India, especially subscription, UPI autopay or content apps for the next billion users.
• Comfort with numbers. You can read a funnel, question it, and explain what it means in two lines.
• Clear writing in English and good spoken Hindi. You should be able to think like a user in Patna as easily as one in Pune.
• A bias to ship. You would rather run a rough test this week than a perfect one next month.
• Curiosity. You install apps just to see how their paywall works.
Good to have
• Hands-on time with Mixpanel, Firebase or a similar analytics tool.
• Hands-on experience with UPI AutoPay, mandate flows, recurring billing, or payment retry/dunning logic — big plus given our autopay and D2C payments work.
• Exposure to paywalls, pricing tests, payment gateways (Razorpay, Juspay, etc.) or Meta ads.
• Experience in devotional, astrology, utility or entertainment apps.
• A side project, app, page or channel you grew yourself.

Why you'll like it here
Real ownership. Your tests go live to real users, and you see the result in days.
Grow with us. This is an immediate backfill with real scope from day one — if you own it well, there's a clear path from Associate PM to PM as the product and team grow.
Learn the full stack of a subscription business. Product, pricing, payments, ads and analytics, all in one seat.
The gear you need. Laptop, tools, AI subscriptions: ask and it is sorted.
We celebrate. Team parties every month, and nobody needs a reason.
No heavy process. Few meetings, short docs, quick decisions.
A fun bunch. We take the numbers seriously and ourselves a lot less.

How to apply
Send your resume to hr@spacewiretech.com with two things:
• One app you think has a great paywall or onboarding, and why.
• One thing you would test first on any of our apps.

About the company

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.

A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.

At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.

Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?

Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.

Our values

Be a wolf, not a sheep: we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
Knowledge equals power: we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy: we want work to be something you look forward to.
Quality results in quantity: we care about excellence and attention to detail.
TEAM, Together everyone achieves more: collaboration is how we get our best results.
Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

About the role

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

Key responsibilities

Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.

Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.

Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.

Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.

Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.

Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

What we are looking for

Competences

Hosting & Security Products Knowledge: Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.

Supplier & Vendor Management: Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.

Commercial & P&L Acumen: Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.

Product Strategy & Roadmapping: Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.

Project & Programme Management: Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.

Data & Funnel Analytics: Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.

AI Proficiency: Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

How we work at Openprovider

Self-management: you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.

Learning Agility and AI Literacy: you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.

Adaptive Innovation Mindset: you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.

Quality Orientation: you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.

Customer Focus: you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

What we offer

100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);

Paid time off and sick leave;

International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;

Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;

Quarterly review and annual salary review;

Flexible working hours;

We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;

Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;

Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;

A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

About us

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.

We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.

That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.

We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

The Role:

We’re looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, not features. Our team — including product admins and student success managers — handles a large and growing workload, and much of it is still manual: watching customer Slack channels, cross-referencing Google Sheets, catching escalations late, onboarding our students etc. Your job is to design the product and infrastructure that takes that load off people so they can focus on the work that actually matters.

You’ll own the full picture: how the dashboard and interface fit together, how information flows between systems, and where AI can quietly do the heavy lifting. The bar is simple — every feature you ship should make someone’s day easier, never add cognitive load.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is product-minded with a real technical sense. Use AI to remove work, not create it. Identify where LLMs, RAG, and automation can take tasks off people’s plates — triage, summarization, flagging, routing, follow-ups — and design those capabilities so they feel invisible and trustworthy.

Build a unified view of the customer journey. Integrate conversations from customer Slack channels with our core applications and Google Sheets so the team sees one picture instead of many.

Make service proactive. Build systems that automatically flag and triage customer escalations before they become critical, and that help student success managers identify at-risk clients and trigger timely, automated follow-ups.

Prototype and verify quickly. Use Dify.AI to build LLM-powered prototypes, implement RAG, and iterate on prompts; use n8n to orchestrate automated workflows across third-party apps and APIs. Validate ideas with working prototypes before committing engineering time.

Lead AI product design. Prompt engineering, model selection and configuration, interaction design for AI features, and an evaluation framework that tells us whether an AI feature is actually working.

Run on data. Monitor product and AI-effect metrics, analyze user behavior, identify pain points, and drive continuous iteration.

Stay current. Track developments in AI tooling (Dify, n8n, Coze, and others), analyze competitors, and bring what’s useful back into our product.

Shape the roadmap. Contribute to short-term product planning and offer well-reasoned input on product strategy and technical direction.

We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to own that second problem. You’ll take products from the first client conversation through launch and growth, and you’ll be the one who catches the fuzzy requirement, the dropped handoff, or the hidden risk while it’s still cheap to fix.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain

Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting

About the Role

The Team

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

Position Summary

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

Work You'll Do

• Business problem definition & success criteria: Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

• Domain-to-build translation: Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

• Use case discovery beyond the original ask: Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

• Stakeholder alignment & adoption: Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

• Value realization & measurement: Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

• Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets: Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

Qualifications

Required

• 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

• 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

• Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

• Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

Preferred

• Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

• Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

• Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

• Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

Core Competencies

• Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

• Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

• Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

• Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

• Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

• Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

• Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

• Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

• Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

• Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

• Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

Job Description

Hansen Technologies is a global software and services provider supporting the energy, utilities, water, and telecommunications industries. Our solutions help organizations deliver essential services, introduce new products, engage customers, and manage critical revenue and customer operations across more than 80 countries.

We are looking for a Product Manager who can combine product strategy, delivery leadership, and people leadership. You will own the platform’s vision, roadmap, and end-to-end lifecycle, turning emerging AI innovation into a trusted enterprise platform with measurable adoption and customer value.

Working closely with our Chief Innovation Officer, AI Spark team, engineering, architecture, and global product stakeholders, you will bring structure, pace, and accountability to one of Hansen’s most important AI investments.

Proven ownership of product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, lifecycle, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

About The Role

PubMatic is building the next generation of AI-powered products for digital advertising, including intelligent agents that help customers monitor marketplace performance, identify new opportunities, troubleshoot issues, make recommendations, and take action. We are also evolving our data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform that publishers and partners rely on to understand their performance.

We are looking for a highly technical, customer-oriented Product Manager to lead our Agentic Platform and AI strategy while driving the roadmap for our analytics and reporting platform. This role owns the foundational capabilities that enable teams across PubMatic to build, evaluate, deploy, and operate production-grade AI agents, and leads strategic customer-facing AI and analytics experiences that turn complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.

You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, agentic systems, advertising technology, data, and product experience. You will partner closely with engineering (onshore and offshore), design, and commercial teams, and with DSPs, ad networks, agency trading desks, exchanges, publishers, and audience/data providers, to turn emerging AI capabilities into scalable products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

AI and Agentic Platform

Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for PubMatic's shared AI and Agentic Platform, enabling teams company-wide to build and operate production-grade AI agents.
Own platform capabilities including agent orchestration, model and tool integration, context and knowledge management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, and reusable agent infrastructure.
Lead the strategy and development of publisher- and marketplace-facing AI experiences that transform complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.
Build rigorous evaluation methodologies combining offline evaluation, golden datasets, LLM-based evaluation, human review, experimentation, and production telemetry.
Define success metrics across AI quality, customer adoption, task completion, business impact, latency, reliability, and cost.

Data Visualization, Reporting & Analytics

Define, develop, and execute the vision, roadmap, and requirements for PubMatic's data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform.
Develop clear, compelling PRDs and user stories for new initiatives and enhancements, including business justification, revenue potential, and operational impact.
Monitor product adoption, proactively identify opportunities, and make actionable recommendations to drive uptake and effectiveness.

Common Responsibilities

Validate product direction through customer and internal stakeholder interaction and by analyzing market and product trends.
Create and maintain a prioritized product backlog.
Work closely with UX and engineering teams to guide development and testing.
Partner with Sales, Services, and Product Marketing on training, collateral, and product rollout, and evangelize PubMatic offerings internally and to prospects and the installed base.
Own the full product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and strategy through requirements, experimentation, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

We'd Love for You to Have

Required Qualifications

6-8+ years of Product Management experience, including 1-2 years of hands-on experience leading technically complex agentic platforms and building AI agents in production, and experience in data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence.
Strong understanding of modern AI application architecture, including LLMs and reasoning models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and knowledge systems, agent orchestration and tool use, AI evaluation and experimentation, prompt and context engineering, and observability and production monitoring.
Demonstrated ability to identify business problems and strategic, revenue-generating opportunities.
Demonstrated ability to partner deeply with engineering and AI teams, making thoughtful product and technical tradeoffs.
Experience taking ambiguous, zero-to-one products from concept through production and measurable adoption.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define metrics and evaluation frameworks for probabilistic AI systems.
Firm sense of accountability and ownership for the end-to-end product lifecycle.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical teams, customers, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

2-5 years of experience in the online advertising industry, including ad tech, programmatic advertising, and marketplaces.
Experience building enterprise AI products where reliability, governance, privacy, security, and explainability are critical.
Familiarity with agent interoperability standards and architectures, such as MCP, agent-to-agent communication, structured tool calling, and multi-agent systems.

Qualifications: 

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics or an Engineering discipline (e.g., Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

Additional Information:

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Experience in preparing BRDs, functional specifications, process flows and user stories, along with conducting UAT.
Working knowledge of UCP 600, ISBP, URDG 758, ISP98, RBI and FEMA regulations applicable to Trade Finance.

Understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies and their applications in Trade Finance.
Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
Graduate degree in a relevant discipline.

About

Asha Health is building an AI OS for outpatient care. It’s the year of AI agents, and startups selling AI agents to healthcare organizations will do great in this wave. While we’re rooting for them, we’re building what comes after. We're based in New York and backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, 186 Ventures, Reach Capital and many more. About The Role

We're looking for a Product Manager, AI to join our team in our Bangalore office. With how AI models are evolving, we don't believe in traditional roles. Whereas in an old-school company you may write long PRDs and hand off to designers and engineering, and spend weeks in back and forths trying to get 1 feature approved, we operate completely differently. Here's what your day-to-day may look like:

Instead of writing PRD's, you'll build prototypes.

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned Product Management leader to drive the strategy, development and growth of an enterprise SaaS product portfolio catering to the manufacturing and industrial sector.
The role will be responsible for defining product vision, owning the roadmap and driving end-to-end product execution across critical industrial workflows, including manufacturing operations, production, maintenance, asset management and frontline workforce productivity.
The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of product leadership, enterprise SaaS experience and deep domain understanding of manufacturing or asset-intensive industries. They should have experience translating complex plant-floor and industrial workflows into scalable, intuitive software solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers.
This is a strategic yet hands-on leadership role requiring close collaboration with engineering, design, sales, customer success and implementation teams, along with regular engagement with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the industrial SaaS product portfolio, ensuring alignment with customer needs, market opportunities and business objectives.
Product Lifecycle Ownership: Own the complete product lifecycle, from customer discovery, market research and requirement definition to prioritization, development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
Domain & Customer Understanding: Work closely with manufacturing, plant operations, maintenance and frontline teams to understand operational challenges and translate complex industrial workflows into scalable product capabilities.
Product Innovation: Identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities across manufacturing operations, production efficiency, maintenance management, asset reliability, workforce productivity and operational excellence.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Sales, Customer Success and Implementation teams to drive product development and successful execution.
Customer Engagement: Engage with enterprise customers, understand business requirements, conduct product discussions and demonstrations, validate solutions and incorporate customer feedback into product strategy.
Product Performance & Metrics: Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics and business outcomes. Use data, analytics and customer insights to drive roadmap decisions and product enhancements.
Go-to-Market: Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams on product positioning, value proposition, pricing, packaging, proposals, demos and go-to-market strategies for enterprise customers.
Team Leadership: Lead, mentor and develop Product Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, innovation and strong execution.
Executive Stakeholder Management: Present product strategy, roadmaps, business cases and performance updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Product Excellence: Establish effective product management practices, prioritization frameworks and agile execution processes to improve product quality, speed and business impact.

Required Qualifications & Experience
12+ years of overall experience, with at least 8–10 years in Product Management and 2–3+ years in a Director, Senior Product Manager, Head of Product or equivalent leadership capacity.
Mandatory experience in manufacturing, industrial operations, plant operations, maintenance management or asset-intensive industries.
Strong experience building and scaling B2B SaaS / Enterprise SaaS products, preferably in the industrial technology or manufacturing software ecosystem.
Proven experience owning product strategy, roadmap and end-to-end product lifecycle for enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of manufacturing and industrial workflows, including production operations, plant maintenance, asset management, work order management, reliability engineering or frontline workforce processes.
Experience working with enterprise customers in manufacturing, chemicals, oil & gas, energy, mining, utilities or other asset-intensive industries.
Proven ability to translate complex operational requirements into product features and scalable software solutions.
Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering, design, sales and customer-facing teams to successfully launch and scale products.
Experience managing and mentoring product teams, with the ability to drive ownership and execution across multiple stakeholders.
Strong analytical skills with experience defining product metrics, tracking adoption and using data to drive product decisions.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.

Preferred Experience
Experience with one or more of the following product categories:
Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)
Industrial IoT (IIoT) and Connected Worker Platforms
Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM)
Field Service Management (FSM)
Smart Manufacturing and Digital Factory Solutions
Industrial Workflow Automation and Digital Transformation Platforms
Exposure to OEE, predictive and preventive maintenance, asset reliability, production planning, continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Experience building mobile-first products for frontline workers and plant-floor users.
Exposure to AI/ML-enabled capabilities within industrial or manufacturing software products.
Understanding of enterprise integrations involving ERP, SAP, MES, EAM and other industrial systems.
MBA or equivalent business education from a reputed institution is an advantage.
Experience with enterprise SaaS commercial models, pricing, packaging, proposals and strategic customer engagements.

What Success Looks Like
A clearly defined and executable product vision and roadmap aligned with business priorities.
Successful delivery of scalable product capabilities addressing real-world manufacturing and industrial challenges.
Strong product adoption and measurable improvements in customer operational KPIs.
Effective collaboration between product, engineering and commercial teams.
Development of a high-performing product management team with strong ownership and execution capabilities.

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

About The Insight Program

Who are we solving for?

We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.

What are we solving for?

Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.

For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.

Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.

With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.

Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.

Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.

Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.

Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics

Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices

Experience with developing ETL pipelines

What’s in it for you?

Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Job Title: Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge Fabric

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team:

The Enterprise Knowledge Domain is a newly established capability and a foundational pillar of the Group's artificial intelligence strategy. The team will define how organisational knowledge is structured, governed, connected and made available across the enterprise. It will work closely with engineering, architecture, data, scientific and business communities to create trusted knowledge foundations that support enterprise search, knowledge discovery and intelligent systems.

Within the domain, the Knowledge Fabric team builds and operates the federated context layer that connects these foundations to people and AI agents, and the Product Owner makes sure it is adopted and delivers value.

Impact and Contribution:

As Exec Product Owner for the Knowledge Fabric, you will own the fabric as a platform product. You will set the roadmap and prioritise the backlog across the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, knowledge controls, and the consumption experience for AI agents and the harnesses they run in, including Agents.CBA, CommbankOS, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and OpenAI Codex.

You will onboard the teams building enterprise agents, user agents and user-defined agents, and make sure the fabric meets their needs for relevance, speed, security and cost. You will define and track platform measures such as retrieval latency, relevance, token cost and entitlement conformance, and coordinate closely with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office and End User Experience teams to bring use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric.

You are a platform product leader who can make a complex technical capability simple, valuable and easy for other teams to adopt.

The Knowledge Fabric is building world-leading knowledge management capabilities for our AI-powered colleagues and agents. Together, we will make trusted, permission-aware knowledge available to the AI agents that need it, through a single, consistent retrieval point.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog for the Knowledge Fabric platform. Drive product exploration (e.g. using design thinking and analytics) and formulate hypotheses to validate product strategy / design.
Translate consumer and architecture needs into clear features and acceptance criteria for the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, and knowledge controls.
Accountable for end-to-end value delivery and product lifecycle management (including managing requirements lifecycle, production deployment and release day coordination and sign off).
Assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build
Act as the voice of the customer and business and translate this for the squad. Apply expertise to support prioritisation, balance trade-offs, and explore strategies to successfully achieve business and customer outcomes. 
Lead the onboarding of consuming agent teams across multiple harnesses, with clear documentation, service expectations and support. 
Define and report platform KPIs, including latency, relevance, token cost, availability and entitlement conformance.
Work with the Chief Engineer to balance new capability, reliability, security and technical debt.
Ensure entitlements, fine-grained permissions and agent-specific access controls are reflected in product requirements and evidenced for risk stakeholders.
Coordinate roadmaps and dependencies with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office, End User Experience and the Knowledge Domain products.
Track and report progress in bringing use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric. Manage the squad’s performance to defined objectives including OKR tracking, etc. 
Ensure all obligations across customer, regulatory, internal policy and process frameworks (e.g. GDF, PDDP, RiC) are fully met and satisfied. Identify, articulate and manage risks, dependencies and compliance across streams of work (e.g. customer propositions). 

Essential Skills:

Have owned technical platform, API or data products used by other engineering teams.
Product strategy, vision setting, roadmap creation, and outcome-based prioritisation.
Understand how AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, graph network and LLM applications consume context, and what makes retrieval good.
Ability to assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build.
Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.
Can turn complex technical and risk requirements into clear priorities and acceptance criteria.
Use data and metrics to make product decisions and demonstrate value.
Understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and responsible AI principles in regulated environments.
Can align multiple teams with competing priorities towards a shared roadmap.
Build trusted working relationships with engineers, architects, risk partners and business teams.
Ideally bring experience in Model Context Protocol, agent platforms, search or data platforms, identity and access management, or cost optimisation for AI workloads.

Education Qualification: Bachelors or Master's Degree in any stream

About The Role

Purplle is hiring a Product Manager to own the post-order experience — everything a customer

goes through after placing an order: order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds, and customer

support. This is the part of the journey that decides whether a customer trusts us enough to come

back.

maintained, and be accountable for the metrics that show they're working — reachability of support,

journeys, strengthen self-service and automation, and ensure clean escalation to a human

agent when needed.

Reduce avoidable contacts (WISMO, status checks) by fixing root-cause friction in tracking and

communication — without making support harder to reach.

Raise resolution quality, measured by repeat contacts, reopens, and post-resolution satisfaction

— not just the volume of cases closed.

Monitor behavioural analytics regularly, spot abnormal changes, and turn insights into a

prioritised set of product fixes.

Partner across Engineering, Design, Customer Support Operations, Logistics, and Finance to

ship improvements and align on SLAs, policies, and delivery realities.

3–4+ years in a product role, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech.
Experience owning customer-facing journeys or post-order / order-management / customer-

support flows.

Hands-on with data — comfortable with SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Looker,

Tableau) to frame hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact.

A systems thinker who maps complex end-to-end flows and finds the highest-leverage fixes.
Customer-obsessed, with strong written communication and the ability to influence cross-

functional teams without authority.

diverse beauty catalogs in the country. We're building the operating system for beauty — connecting

consumers, brands, and beauty professionals in one ecosystem. This role owns the moment of truth:

what happens after the order, where customer trust is won or kept.
