At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost. The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member. Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.


The team's charter spans the full supply chain:


- Buying & Sourcing: demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.


- Collection Centers: first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.


- Distribution Centers (DCs): inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.


- Middle Mile: DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.


- Club Houses: receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.


- Inventory Management: single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.


- Capacity Management: labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.


- Promise Engine: what we promise each member availability and delivery ETA based on live inventory and capacity.


Why FirstClub


- Build, don't babysit: Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.


- Small team, big surface area: You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.


- Fast loops: Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.


- Ground truth over slide decks: Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.


- Scrappy beats perfect: We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.


- Your fingerprints on the company: The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.


The role


As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply chain product charter at FirstClub from how we source and buy, through Collection Centers, DCs and the middle mile, to inventory in our Club Houses and the promise we make each member. Your mandate is to build a high-control, intelligent and scalable supply chain that improves availability, freshness and speed while driving down cost per order and wastage.


This isn't a role where you inherit a mature platform and keep it running. You'll build core pieces of FirstClub's supply chain while the business grows around them: making calls with incomplete data, getting your hands dirty on the floor, and setting how product works across the charter. You'll shape how inventory moves across the network, how frontline teams work, and how FirstClub scales to new cities without losing control or quality.


What you will do


- Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Buying & Sourcing, Collection Centers, DCs, Middle Mile, Club Houses, Inventory Management, Capacity Management and the Promise Engine.


- Set and own the north-star metrics for the charter: availability and fill rate, promise adherence (promised vs. actual), inventory accuracy, days of inventory, wastage and shrinkage, cost per order and throughput per node.


- Partner deeply with Supply Chain, Category, Operations and Finance leadership to find the biggest ground-level problems and convert them into a prioritised, outcome-driven roadmap.


- Architect the core systems with Engineering: a single source of truth for inventory across nodes, a demand-led buying and replenishment engine, and a Promise Engine that balances availability, capacity and speed in real time.


- Build capacity planning across labour, slots, storage and vehicles, so the network flexes for peaks, new categories and new cities.


- Own the frontline tooling strategy for associates, site managers, QC teams and transport partners making work simpler, faster and measurable, including productivity tracking and incentives.


- Lead build-vs-buy decisions across WMS, TMS, procurement and planning systems, and drive integrations with vendors and 3P partners.


- Treat AI and automation as first principles, not add-ons: forecasting, auto-replenishment, intelligent allocation, anomaly and shrinkage detection, and agentic workflows that remove manual decisions from planners and site teams.


- Run a strong experimentation and measurement culture pilots by node or city, clear success criteria, and rigorous readouts.


- Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers, raising the bar on problem framing, execution, stakeholder management and ground-level empathy.


- Help shape the operating model for scaling FirstClub's supply chain across cities with high reliability and healthy unit economics.


What we are looking for


- 5 to 8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and scaling products with measurable business impact.


- Experience leading or mentoring Product Managers, and happy to be a player-coach who still owns hands-on product work.


- Deep experience in supply chain, warehousing, quick commerce, e-commerce, grocery, food delivery or logistics, ideally across more than one node of the chain.


- Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, warehouse operations, middle-mile logistics, capacity planning or delivery promise systems.


- Experience building products with a significant frontline or ground operations component.


- Proven ability to move operational and financial metrics such as fill rate, wastage, cost per order, productivity and SLA adherence.


- Strong analytical depth: comfortable with SQL, experimentation and working alongside Data Science on forecasting and optimisation problems.


- An AI-native mindset: you think naturally about how ML, automation and agents can change how decisions get made, not just how screens look.


- Excellent stakeholder management with senior Operations, Category, Finance and Engineering leaders.


- You thrive in early-stage, fast-moving environments: you'll write the spec, pull the data and walk the floor yourself, and you know the answer is usually a mix of technology, process and operational change.


- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related field. An MBA is a plus; strong product experience matters more.


Good to have


- Built or scaled a WMS, inventory platform, procurement system, TMS or promise/ETA engine.


- Experience with fresh, perishable and cold-chain supply chains, including FEFO, grading and expiry management.


- Exposure to demand forecasting, replenishment optimization, slotting, network planning or routing.


- Experience launching and scaling operations across multiple cities and high daily order volumes.


- Experience building frontline workforce products: productivity tracking, incentives, gamification or training.


- Experience shipping AI/ML-driven decisioning or agentic workflows in production operations.

POSITION PURPOSE:

The Principal Product Manager is responsible for the overall product vision, strategy and roadmap across a specific Platform or domain and works on the hardest problems within the Platform. They make specific contributions to Product and Platform delivery by working directly with Product Squads within the Platform to ensure each product is oriented toward business outcomes that improve company performance. The Principal Product Manager partners directly with the Platform Lead and their teams to deliver. The Principal Product Manager is an expert communicator that represents the Platform by presenting to senior leaders across Bayer and externally to accelerate digital transformation and build Bayer’s reputation as a digital leading company.

Principal Product Managers apply the product management discipline to some of the hardest problems within the Platform. They ensure that products are fulfilling their primary purpose to enable users to perform tasks that create value for the company by:

-Setting strategic vision for the product to ensure the customer and their needs are at the center; and ensuring team priorities are supporting business outcomes for customer, product, technical and enabling teams. This requires continual alignment of the product strategy and objectives with customer, product, technical, and enabling teams

-Managing the product backlog, which prioritizes the work of the assigned squads, to achieve the vision and aligned strategy.

To successfully manage these areas of responsibility, Principal Product Managers must have a deep understanding of the product domain, related technology, and architecture.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Management

The product manager is accountable for the overall success of a product throughout its lifecycle, from conception to decommissioning. They identify domain needs, develop, and validate product concepts, and build a business case. They oversee the product's build and launch, including any sourced services; as well as ensure product availability, stability, and compliance needs are met. Product managers collaborate with various teams, including product development, marketing, finance, legal, manufacturing, operations, and sales, as needed, to ensure cohesive progress and success.

Product Managers drive agile best practices with the team to improve delivery, including continuous planning ahead of each development cycle (e.g. sprint planning) and working together to co-create user stories aligned with the product backlog prioritization. In addition to guiding the team product managers have duties like market opportunity identification, competitive analysis, sales enablement, or monitoring domain performance.

Stakeholder Engagement

It is vital for the product manager to identify their key stakeholder group. Though many strong and loud opinions will be expressed, an effective product manager uses discretion to deliver their product in a way that meets the needs of users and stakeholders who will ensure value is realized for Bayer. Stakeholders should trust that the product manager not only understands their needs but will actively work to ensure their needs are met while delivering the product.

Product Strategy

The product manager must provide strategic leadership with full end-to-end ownership for their assigned products throughout the entire product lifecycle. They are responsible for planning and optimizing capabilities to deliver business outcomes in the most efficient way. Product managers require strong strategic planning, decision making, and influencing skills to balance the needs of users and various stakeholders.

Product Discovery & Delivery

The product manager is responsible for creating comprehensive product roadmaps, to clarify user needs and non-functional requirements. They provide product oversight by tracking and reporting progress against 90-day outcomes and overall product health (including budget responsibilities). They also plan and manage product delivery while streamlining the corresponding backlog. Product managers are responsible for monitoring user feedback and metrics to co-create solutions that drive a better user experience and deliver more business value. They leverage Design Thinking methodology starting with user needs to prioritize problems and through discovery they perform usability, feasibility, business fit and value testing to determine the optimal solution.

People & Collaboration

Product managers must proactively communicate and collaborate with product users and stakeholders, which requires strong strategic communication skills. Effective cross-functional collaboration is critical for product managers, bringing together diverse skills and knowledge to deliver a valuable product. It's important to maintain strong and productive working relationships with colleagues in product management, engineering, and other technically focused organizations. The Principal Product Manager serves as a Product Management Chapter Lead for their Platform, where they are responsible for development of the product management community to improve product management and agile practices, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

10 or more years of experience as a product manager

What We Are Looking For

Pepper is an agentic organic growth platform. We get brands recommended and bought across humans and AI agents, from discoverability to revenue.

Our bet.

Search is now an answer, and increasingly an action an agent takes for a person.
Every brand has three kinds of visitors: humans who search and buy, crawlers that index, and agents that discover, compare, and transact.
We are building the Organic Growth OS for all three that drives enterprise first outcomes
The winners of the next decade will be the brands that machines understand, trust, recommend, and can act on.

Agentic commerce.

A new buyer has arrived, and it is not human: AI agents research, compare, add to cart, check out, and book for customers.
Winning it means being legible to agents: discoverable in AI answers, readable at the catalog and pricing level, verifiable by identity, and able to transact.
Most brands are invisible or unusable to agents today.
We close that gap, and prove it with attribution from recommendation to agent action to revenue.

The role.

A seat for an entrepreneur, not a hire to run an existing machine.
Own Atlas and the platform around it end to end: product, architecture, and applied AI in one mandate.
The prize is US mid-market and enterprise growth.

Platform-led operations.

Pepper is moving from an AI-enabled services business that delivers with people to a platform first business that delivers with agents. You own that transition.
Today human teams run much of the client work: audits, briefs, technical fixes, content operations, and reporting.
The shift: move delivery onto Atlas so agents execute, while humans move up to strategy, judgment, creative direction, and client relationships.
The principle: agents drive delivery, humans augment strategy on top.
Decompose the services playbook into deterministic tasks and agent workflows, and automate the delivery layer end to end.
Instrument it with monitors and evals so quality holds without a person checking every output.
Redesign how the company is organized around the platform, not headcount.

You will:

Own the Atlas roadmap and agent architecture, deciding where LLMs beat deterministic code.
Grow the automation surface and raise the share of work done with no human in the loop.
Own agent readiness, identity, and commerce so agents can discover, trust, and buy.
Run the monitors, evals, and guardrails that make autonomous output reliable enough to sell on outcomes.
Build and scale the product, engineering, and AI teams, and tie the roadmap to ARR and margin.
Convert Pepper's services delivery into platform-led agent workflows, retiring manual steps so agents execute and strategists direct.

Who you are.

A founder or founding engineer who has taken something from zero and wants to build again.
Has scaled product and engineering teams through real growth.
Has shipped agentic systems to production, not demos, and knows when to use LLMs versus deterministic code.
Has built for US mid-market and enterprise buyers and their reliability and security bar.
Combined product and technology fluency. SEO, GEO, or MarTech experience is a plus.
Has turned a manual operation into a product or platform, and wants to do it at Pepper's scale.

Anyone can get a GenAI prototype working in a weekend. The hard part is everything after: passing a security review, staying inside budget, keeping costs per query sane, and earning the trust of real users.

We’re looking for a Product Manager who treats that hard part as the real job. Product vision and scope

Surface and escalate delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and runaway costs.

2+ years as a Product Manager shipping complex enterprise software on time and on budget.

Room to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

DexCare, a digital care orchestration platform, streamlines care delivery logistics. About the Role

DexCare is building the AI-first patient navigation platform that health systems rely on to connect patients with the right care, fast. The Platform Foundations team owns the trust and control layer that every product at DexCare — and every customer that integrates with us — depends on: authentication, identity, tenant and license management, and the API gateway that fronts our services.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Security, Engineering, Compliance, and Commercial teams to ensure the platform meets healthcare-grade security and privacy requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2, FedRAMP) without slowing down product velocity.

Roadmap & Prioritization: Translate platform reliability, security, and scalability needs into a prioritized backlog; make explicit build-vs-buy and sequencing tradeoffs.

7-9 years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion of that in platform, infrastructure, or identity/access domains.

Direct experience with authentication/authorization systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, or API platform products.

Comfort operating at a technical level — you can read an API spec, participate in architecture discussions, and push back credibly with engineering.

A track record of balancing security/compliance requirements against usability and delivery speed.

Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineering and executive audiences.

Has migrated a legacy system to multi-tenant SaaS with live customers

Experience in healthcare technology, regulated industries, or enterprise B2B SaaS is a strong plus.

Identity and access aren't a back-office concern at DexCare — they're the foundation that makes every other product trustworthy and scalable. IoT is the only focus area for Silicon Labs and is one of the most visible and fastest growing segments of the semiconductor industry. Our portfolio of industry leading wireless solutions includes Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, Wi-Sun, Proprietary Wireless and other emerging technologies driving the next generation of IoT smart connected products. With the addition of AI acceleration, rich MCU content combined with best-in-class software stacks, tools and development environments we offer compulsive and complete solutions to customers.

Provides leadership and vision on IC product roadmap and requirements.
Continuously improves our portfolio offering, balancing business needs with R&D efficiency.
Creates product roadmaps based on various segment inputs to meet the requirements for a diverse range of applications

Define SoC product requirements, features, specifications, and system KPIs for core CPU, co-processors, accelerators, power management, digital and analog peripherals, security sub-system, radio sub-system, and packages.

Manage the entire portfolio of scalable products with clear mapping to target applications.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www.silabs.com.
Meet the Team
IoT is the only focus area for Silicon Labs and is one of the most visible and fastest growing segments of the semiconductor industry. Our portfolio of industry leading wireless solutions includes Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, Wi-Sun, Proprietary Wireless and other emerging technologies driving the next generation of IoT smart connected products. With the addition of AI acceleration, rich MCU content combined with best-in-class software stacks, tools and development environments we offer compulsive and complete solutions to customers.

As a member of the Hardware Product Management team, you will be responsible for the Silicon Labs IoT products starting from concept to plan and customer alphas. You will be required to interact with a wide range of cross functional teams including silicon design, product test, validation, software product management & engineering, project management and business management to ensure the best of the products come to the market.

As a team, hardware product management:

Provides leadership and vision on IC product roadmap and requirements.
Continuously improves our portfolio offering, balancing business needs with R&D efficiency.
Creates product roadmaps based on various segment inputs to meet the requirements for a diverse range of applications

This is one of the few functions where you will have the great opportunity to discuss with top executives regarding strategy and execution on a day-to-day basis, thus having invaluable amount of learning. 

Come and join us in our goal to become the undisputed leader in wireless connectivity for IoT! 

Responsibilities
Define SoC product requirements, features, specifications, and system KPIs for core CPU, co-processors, accelerators, power management, digital and analog peripherals, security sub-system, radio sub-system, and packages.
Map market systems application requirements to product use cases, including system block diagrams, compute and peripheral requirements, and protocol stack features and performance requirements for Wi-Fi, Matter, Thread, ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Classic, Sidewalk, Wi-SUN, and proprietary protocols.
Define hardware and evaluation tools for customers, including debug interfaces such as JTAG, SWD, ETM trace, PTI, virtual communication port requirements, and user interfaces such as push buttons, LCDs, LEDs, analog joysticks, and RHT sensors.
Collaborate with leaders and individual contributors across functional teams such as IC design, product test, software development, product and segment marketing, applications, operations, and sales to develop long-term innovation ideas, roadmap, and silicon definition.
Drive the product development process from concept through definition and pitch the most promising product ideas to executive staff.
Conduct key competitive analysis, including tear-down at the die level and various spec analyses, to provide conclusive takeaways for design, specification, and fighting guides.
Manage the entire portfolio of scalable products with clear mapping to target applications. 

Skills You Will Need
Minimum Qualifications
BSEE/BSCS (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience in semiconductor product management or IoT industry
Core development experience in IC front end / architecture / verification / embedded systems
Knowledge of key architectural considerations for PPA, including power estimation, die size estimation, and fundamental process node technology principles.
Knowledge of Wireless Modem and RF Design principles for any of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, 802.15.4, and other Low Power Wireless standards
Proven ability to work successfully at a technical level with cross-functional engineering teams, including hardware and software engineers 
Experience developing business cases for Technology investments working with Business Unit partners, sensitivity analysis of business case to variables under consideration. 
Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially to executive management

The following qualifications will be considered a plus:
Development experience in either wireless or wired communication protocols
MBA or equivalent business graduation

Benefits & Perks
Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun.
· Equity Rewards (RSUs)
· Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
· Insurance plans with Outpatient cover
· National Pension Scheme (NPS)
· Flexible work policy
· Childcare support.

jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Staff Product Manager – Developer Platform Enablement
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Overview

Join the Intuit Platform and Development Xcceleration group as a Senior Staff Product Manager. The PDX group builds the foundational capabilities that developers across Intuit rely on to build and run flagship applications on cloud native infrastructure at scale. Intuit believes in open source, both as a consumer and a contributor, and our engineers participate actively in communities including CNCF, Istio, and Argo.

We're looking for a product leader who can own two connected platform domains: the systems that provision and run Intuit's cloud infrastructure, and the systems that make Intuit's APIs and services usable by AI agents, not just human developers. You'll set direction for how infrastructure gets provisioned against policy, and for how AI agents discover, integrate with, and operate Intuit's internal services with less and less human intervention over time.

This role carries senior staff scope. You'll set product strategy independently, make tradeoffs other teams will build against, and represent these platforms directly to engineering and executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's infrastructure orchestration and provisioning platform, working closely with the engineering teams who build and operate it.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's agent-readiness platform, which evaluates how usable Intuit's internal APIs and services are for AI agents and drives the work that closes the gaps.
Define the metrics that matter for each platform, from infrastructure reliability and provisioning speed to how much manual work it still takes before an agent can operate a given capability end to end, and use those metrics to prioritize the roadmap.
Partner with the teams that define platform policy, identity, access, lifecycle rules, so that what you build upholds that policy rather than duplicating or drifting from it.
Work with capability teams across Intuit to help them raise their agent-readiness scores, generate the integration assets they're missing, and turn what used to be manual, tribal-knowledge work into something an agent or a new engineer can follow directly.
Represent both platforms to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, with a clear narrative tying platform investment to developer productivity and to Intuit's broader AI strategy.
Build and run a scrum team based in India, setting the cadence, backlog discipline, and quality bar that let a distributed team ship independently.

Qualifications

10 or more years of product management experience, including platform, infrastructure, or developer-tools products.
Direct experience with AI-enabled products or platforms, with a strong enough technical foundation to work through integration and architecture tradeoffs with engineering.
Strong experience with AI Evals, model evaluations, technical use cases, shared platform capabilities, driving adoption and growth of platform capabilities, and leveraging AI to assess technical capabilities, and agentic PDLC.
A track record of owning a product end to end: setting strategy, defining success metrics, and driving a roadmap that a distributed engineering team executes against.
Comfort partnering across adjacent platform teams where ownership boundaries matter, and judgment about when to defer to another team's policy versus when to push back.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives.
Experience managing or closely partnering with engineering teams based in India strongly preferred.
Undergraduate degree in computer science or a related technical discipline required. Equivalent professional experience will be considered. Advanced degree or MBA preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

It specialises in the design and development of high-performance trading systems for institutional participants viz Large Banks, HFTs and Corporations. Our eFX Trading Platform is the backbone of our business, supporting real-time pricing, market making, algorithmic trading, auto-hedging, and risk management.

Role overview: 
We are looking for an exceptional Technical Product Manager who combines a strong understanding of electronic trading technology with outstanding analytical, functional design, and product management capabilities.
The successful candidate will work closely with Founder, software architects, developers, and Clients to translate complex FX trading requirements into technically coherent, scalable, and implementation-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Product & Technology Architecture
Develop a thorough understanding of InTrade's existing product capabilities, technical architecture, and functional workflows.
Understand interactions between services, APIs, messaging systems, databases, and external integrations.
Evaluate how new functionality should integrate with existing platform components.
Ensure to reuse existing capabilities rather than introduce unnecessary complexity.

Support engineers throughout development by resolving functional ambiguities and evaluating design alternatives.
Collaborate with QA teams to establish comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
Validate delivered functionality against intended business requirements.

Why Join Us?
A Once in life chance to shape next-gen Trading Systems set-up
A front-row seat in managing the next-generation trading platform
A flat, engineering-first culture focused on delivery and innovation
Competitive compensation with performance upside and high ESOPs

Why UKG

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.

About The Team & Value Stream

The AI & Platform Value Stream is the engineering backbone of UKG Ready, the teams that determine whether Ready can scale, perform, and evolve at the pace the business demands. We sit within UKG Ready AI & Platform and own the foundational infrastructure, data platforms, AI frameworks, identity systems, and integration capabilities that every domain team in Ready builds on.

The Integration Framework team owns the connective infrastructure that makes UKG Ready an open, composable platform. Every third party system that connects to Ready, every external data feed that flows in or out, every webhook event that fires, every partner integration available in Solutions Exchange, all of it runs on the framework this team builds and operates. That scope includes the Audit Framework (the underlying audit and compliance infrastructure for Ready), encryption services, data import/export pipelines, middleware and integration infrastructure, and advanced webhooks.

The strategic stakes for this team are rising fast. UKG Ready is targeting $1.1B ARR by 2030. One of the six critical engineering prerequisites for that growth is Integration & Partner Scale: a mature inbound/outbound integration framework with monitoring, governance, API metering, and fairness controls that can support reseller growth and ecosystem expansion at volume. The Integration Framework PM owns the roadmap that delivers that capability.

Equally important: Integration Framework is the connective tissue for UKG Ready's AI native future. AI agents connect to external systems through integrations. Agentic workflows that span UKG Ready and third party platforms depend on reliable, fast, observable integration infrastructure. The Workflow and Integration Bryte AI Frontdoor initiative this team owns will define how AI assisted integration creation works in UKG Ready. This PM will shape the platform architecture that enables that.

You will collaborate with PMs across the value stream (Platform Services, Identity & Access, AI Framework, Analytics Platform), with Global Alliances, Solutions Exchange teams, domain PMs across Payroll, HR, and Time & Labor, and with partner engineering organizations.

About The Role

This is a technically demanding, PM role at the intersection of developer platforms, integration engineering, and partner ecosystems. You will own the roadmap for the integration infrastructure that powers every external connection in UKG Ready and the marketplace through which partners reach Ready customers.

You need both depth and range. Deep enough to make credible technical calls on webhook retry semantics, event driven architecture, API versioning strategies, and encryption at the integration layer. Broad enough to translate framework capabilities into partner value, drive Solutions Exchange as a product led growth surface, and build the business case for API monetization. You'll move between architecture discussions with engineers, roadmap reviews with senior leadership, and go to market conversations with the Global Alliances team, sometimes all in the same week.

This role also requires an AI native working style, not as a nice to have, but as a baseline expectation. UKG operates a fully agentic product and development lifecycle: our engineering teams build with AI coding assistants, our PM organization uses AI agents for research, synthesis, and documentation, and the products we ship are themselves AI powered. We're looking for someone who has genuinely internalized this shift, someone who reaches for an AI agent before a spreadsheet, who accelerates their PM work with agentic tools, and who understands how integration infrastructure must evolve to serve agentic consumers, not just human triggered workflows.

You Will

Own the integration framework strategy and evolution. Define the roadmap for the next generation integration framework: V2 enhancements, event driven architecture, advanced webhooks (editable payloads, retry logic, event filtering, webhook marketplace), batch event processing, and a generic transformation engine that reduces integration build time from months to weeks.

Drive Solutions Exchange and partner ecosystem growth. Own the Solutions Exchange roadmap as a product led growth surface: self service partner onboarding, in app integration discovery, activation flows, and the developer experience that enables partners to build and ship integrations independently.

Own the Audit Framework capability. Define the roadmap for the Audit Framework infrastructure underlying compliance and audit logging across UKG Ready. (Platform Services PM owns the Audit Trail Report surface; this PM owns the framework itself: audit event capture, data retention, encryption, and the APIs downstream systems consume.)

Lead data import/export and encryption strategy. Own the Data Import/Export Framework including SFTP, conversion profiles, and bulk data handling, and own encryption services across the integration layer. Define data security strategy at the integration boundary to meet compliance requirements across all active integrations.

Drive the Workflow and Integration Bryte AI Frontdoor. Own the AI powered interface for integration creation and workflow setup, from a partner or admin describing what they want in natural language to a configured, validated integration running in production.

Define integration standards and developer experience. Drive integration standards across domain teams to reduce time to market for new partner integrations through reusable components and configuration driven development. Own the developer portal, API reference materials, and SDK guidance.

Work as an AI native PM and raise the bar for those around you. Use AI agents daily across PRD drafting, technical research, document synthesis, metrics analysis, and stakeholder communications. Model agentic working practices within the team and bring a practitioner's perspective to the platform you are building for.

Communicate strategy and roadmap to senior leadership and partners. Translate integration platform investments into business outcomes for engineering and product leadership. Represent the integration platform story externally to key partner organizations and internally to Global Alliances.

About You

We're looking for a builder. Someone who understands that integration infrastructure is not plumbing, it is product. Someone who has shipped developer facing platforms, has the technical credibility to shape architecture decisions, and has the commercial instincts to drive ecosystem growth and monetization. This role requires both worlds: you need to earn the trust of principal engineers in a webhook architecture discussion and then turn around and build the partner GTM case for the same capability.

We recognize that background takes many forms. We will consider candidates who meet one of the following experience profiles:

Preferred: Technical founder or early engineer turned PM from an integration, API, or developer tools company. You've built something where the integration or the API was the product itself, not a feature appended to something else. You understand webhook delivery semantics, event schema versioning, and OAuth scopes not from a PM brief but from firsthand experience. That depth is exactly what this role demands.

Define and drive strategy and roadmap for Product Adoption & Insights initiatives across the Nutanix portfolio.
Partner with Product Managers, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to gather requirements and identify opportunities to improve adoption, customer health, and value realization.
Define and evolve adoption frameworks, telemetry requirements, customer health metrics, and executive reporting.
Build AI-powered actionable insights that help Customer Success and Account teams proactively identify risks and opportunities.
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify new opportunities and drive prioritization.

Self-motivated with strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.

The team focuses on helping customers realize value faster through trusted adoption insights, AI-powered recommendations, customer success innovations, and strategic services offerings.

--

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. Exceptional benefits: In addition to a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, mental health, and vision coverage for you, your spouse/partner, and children.

Your Impact

You will also establish KPIs and metrics to measure the success and ROI of ServiceNow initiatives, providing regular updates and insights to senior management and stakeholders.

You will develop and execute change management plans to ensure smooth adoption of new features and processes. You will also conduct training sessions and create documentation to empower end-users and administrators.

10+ years of experience managing ServiceNow or similar enterprise platforms

Understanding of ITIL principles and certifications (ITIL Foundation or higher) preferred

Job Description

P&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.

Dedication from Us: You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.

What we Offer: Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.

CF-IT's TOP organization is seeking a Senior IT Data Product Manager, located at the Hyderabad IT Hub. Specifically, you'll work within the Data & AI section that supports the Modern IT Service & Asset Management team.

The Digital Product Management job family involves the strategic management of digital products, from conception to launch and beyond. This includes understanding customer needs, defining product vision, and working closely with various teams to deliver value-adding digital solutions.

Digital Product Manager/Owner role involves setting priorities for a range of internal digital products within the organization. This includes translating customer needs into valuable, feasible, and usable user stories, personas, user journeys, and user flows. The role requires collaboration with partners to prioritize the product backlog and make data-driven decisions based on complex, multivariable environments.

Key Responsibilities

Define and align strategy for the functioning of IT in sub-OU, service, product, program, technology domain, or IT horizontal process.
Translate customer needs into valuable, feasible, and usable user stories.
Drive the digital product strategy and define the roadmap. 
Collaborate with partners to prioritize the product backlog. 
Make data-driven decisions based on complex environments.
Develop and run experiments to validate or disprove concepts.

Job Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, Analytics, or related field.
5+ years of experience in Product Management, Data & Analytics, Data Engineering, or related technology roles.
Strong understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data governance, data quality, and cloud data platforms (Azure, Databricks).
Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery teams.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and business value realization skills.
Preferred certifications: PSPO, SAFe, AZ-900, DP-900, Databricks Fundamentals, CDMP.

About Us

We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is seeking a Product Manager to help solve a ubiquitous problem that all knowledge workers in the world struggle with on a daily basis. You’ll deliver best-in-class products for finding, curating, sharing, discovering, and managing knowledge. We’ve only taken the first step towards our long-term vision of an intelligent work assistant, and we need great product leaders to take us the rest of the way.

We’re currently a very lean product team, so you’ll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself. You’ll collaborate closely with our stellar Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Success partners to understand our customers and build category-defining tools. You’ll wear many hats and gain both breadth and depth of experience. As Glean’s PM for Protect ( Security and Governance) you’ll develop new technologies and product features spanning explainable / transparent AI systems, identification and prevention of various vectors of AI risks, and the observability, security and privacy features around AI agents and underlying data for our customers.

You Will

Spending a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
Developing key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
Empowering your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
Driving customer-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
Coordinating cross-functionally with with leadership, go-to-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
Building processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth

About You

You have 8+ years of experience in product management at SaaS companies, primarily serving large enterprises with responsibilities spanning security, governance, trust, identity, data integrations.
You have a strong technical background and experience with both UX and API driven products, integration paths, and 3rd party product partnerships.
You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.
You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results.
You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.
You have a learning and growth mindset.
You are mission-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success.

Location:

This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

INTRODUCTION TO EVERNORTH: 

Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

Job Title

Senior Manager – Digital Product & Engagement

Job Overview

This is a senior leadership role at the Evernorth Hyderabad Office and sits within the Data, Digital and AI Portfolio for The Cigna Group. The role is responsible for building and scaling Digital Product and Engagement capabilities in Hyderabad while partnering closely with US-based Product, Customer Engagement, and Technology leaders to deliver high-impact digital, engagement, data, and AI-enabled products.

The successful candidate will lead teams spanning Product Management and Engagement Delivery, driving strategy, organizational effectiveness, execution, and business outcomes across platform, data, customer engagement, personalization, campaign, digital experience, and AI product portfolios.

This role combines organizational leadership with hands-on product and engagement leadership. While accountable for developing talent, scaling operating models, and driving portfolio outcomes, the leader must also be comfortable directly leading strategic initiatives, influencing executive stakeholders, shaping product direction, and stepping into complex or ambiguous business problems when needed.

The ideal candidate is a strategic digital leader who can operate effectively across strategy, discovery, execution, and organizational leadership while building strong teams, strong partnerships, and measurable business outcomes

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Digital Leadership

Partner closely with US-based Product, Engineering, Analytics, Experience, and Digital Engagement leaders to translate enterprise priorities into product strategy, roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
Drive implementation and adherence to product strategy across platform, data, customer engagement, personalization, digital experience, campaign, and AI-enabled product portfolios.
Act as a strategic extension of US Product leadership, providing thought leadership on priorities, sequencing, tradeoffs, investments, and organizational capabilities.
Directly lead select high-priority initiatives and complex cross-functional efforts that require senior product leadership and executive alignment.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on product direction, customer needs, organizational priorities, and business value realization.
Build and maintain strong partnerships with key US-based and Hyderabad-based stakeholders, fostering trust, collaboration, alignment, and shared accountability across Product Management, Engagement Delivery, Engineering, Analytics, Experience, and Business teams.
Develop and maintain a portfolio roadmap that provides transparency into priorities, dependencies, investment areas, risks, and expected outcomes while ensuring alignment with enterprise and DDAI strategic objectives.

Product Management & Engagement Delivery Leadership

Lead and develop teams across digital (product and engagement), ensuring strong alignment between product strategy, planning, execution, and business outcomes.
Establish clear operating models, roles, decision rights, and accountability across digital functions.
Ensure digital teams operate as an integrated organization that enables effective planning, prioritization, execution, stakeholder management, and outcome delivery.
Build leadership depth across both disciplines through coaching, succession planning, organizational development, and talent management.
Create a high-performing culture focused on customer value, ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers and Engagement Delivery experts while establishing scalable operating models, standards, and career paths aligned with global digital practices.
Mentor digital leaders and individual contributors, strengthening capabilities in strategy, discovery, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and execution.
Position Hyderabad as a trusted strategic product and engagement partner that contributes to enterprise direction and outcomes, not simply execution.
Foster a culture of innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous learning.
Accelerate organizational knowledge and business acumen across the Hyderabad team by enabling deep understanding of The Cigna Group's business model, lines of business, strategic priorities, organizational structure, Digital strategy, and Data, Digital & AI (DDAI) objectives.
Establish a culture of continuous learning and capability development by identifying skill gaps, promoting upskilling opportunities, enabling access to required tools and resources, and ensuring team members are equipped to meet current and future business needs.

Operating Model & Delivery Excellence

Partner closely with Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, Customer Experience, and Engagement Delivery teams to align product strategy with delivery and business objectives.
Act as a coordination and escalation point for major cross-functional dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges. Identify and remove critical blockers for the digital team.
Drive continuous improvement in delivery effectiveness, stakeholder satisfaction, planning accuracy, and execution quality.
Balance innovation with execution discipline to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, reliable, and adoption-ready.

Customer & Business Outcomes

Ensure product investments are grounded in customer needs, business priorities, and data-driven insights.
Serve as the primary storyteller and advocate for Hyderabad digital capabilities, clearly articulating the "What, So What, and Now What" of team accomplishments, strategic initiatives, business outcomes, and future opportunities across leadership, governance, and operational forums.
Establish mechanisms to track, measure, and communicate business value delivered, including customer impact, operational efficiencies, adoption, engagement outcomes, financial benefits, and strategic contributions, creating visibility for leadership and supporting investment decisions.
Use customer insights, behavioral data, journey analytics, and product performance to inform strategic decisions and prioritization.
Hold teams accountable for measurable business and customer outcomes across discovery, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Job Description Great data only matters if it arrives. Gracenote's delivery platform moves millions of pieces of TV entertainment data every day into the backend systems of the world's leading cable, OTT, CE, and digital companies, powering entertainment experiences used by hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own this platform from our Bengaluru product and engineering center. You will set the product vision and roadmap for our Unified Data Delivery Platform, the centralized repository that consolidates diverse data from across Gracenote into a single Source of Truth, and for the full family of Video metadata delivery solutions that carry that data to clients worldwide. You will lead a team of two product managers in India and partner daily with our engineering teams to deliver against that roadmap.

Delivery is its own discipline. It is where Gracenote's data meets client systems, with all of the schema, integration, scale, and reliability challenges that implies. It is also the tip of the spear. When something goes wrong for a client, delivery hears about it first and is expected to lead the debugging. We are looking for a leader who has lived in this problem space and knows what it takes to run a delivery platform that clients trust.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision and roadmap for the Unified Data Delivery Platform, the new platform being built to deliver all of Gracenote's Video data to clients and partners
Own the portfolio of Video metadata delivery solutions that clients rely on today
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two product managers in India
Collaborate with clients and partners to understand the business problems of delivering and ingesting TV entertainment data into their backend solutions, and turn that insight into a clear product vision and roadmap
Travel to the US and Europe a couple of times per year to meet clients and partners face to face, building the direct market understanding that informs the product vision
Partner with engineering teams, external partners, and internal stakeholders to prioritize and deliver the roadmap
Work closely with UX and engineering to deliver the configuration and analytics tools that make the platform successful for clients and internal teams
Serve as the senior product escalation point when delivery issues arise, leading root cause analysis and driving resolution with engineering and client-facing teams
Work with senior management to identify opportunities and risks, including new products, infrastructure strategy, and quality initiatives
Closely manage the cloud infrastructure and costs associated with the data platform

Qualifications

12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning data delivery, distribution, or client integration products
Experience managing and mentoring product managers
Experience building and operating high-scale data or distribution systems
Hands-on experience with XML, JSON, and REST APIs. Actively uses LLMs to write Python scripts and SQL to answer product questions independently
Experience running structured development processes with distributed engineering teams, from requirements through release
Willingness to flex working hours for regular overlap with US and European clients and stakeholders
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Skills/Experience

Bachelor's degree or higher. Computer Science or Engineering major is preferable
Experience in OTT, TV broadcast, or supporting customers who develop products for digital content consumption
Development experience with Gracenote, TMS, ROVI, or other structured entertainment databases

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

You'll be part of the Sphera AI Center of Excellence team, owning the AI CoE roadmap — what the CoE builds, in what order, for which part of the business, and at what cost. You will run the intake and prioritization of AI opportunities across the enterprise, sequence them into a delivery roadmap, and hold the program accountable for value delivered.

This is a senior, highly visible role. You will present the roadmap, portfolio status, and business value directly to Sphera's Executive Leadership Team, and you'll do it with numbers you can defend. Day to day you work across product, IT, engineering, InfoSec, Legal, L&D, and every business function, with the authority of the program and not much else — influence is the primary tool.

Key Responsibilities

Own the AI CoE roadmap end to end: intake, evaluation, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery milestones across all AI initiatives and pods.
Run the AI opportunity intake process — capture requests from across the business, assess feasibility, impact, effort, and risk, and make transparent prioritization calls that stakeholders understand even when the answer is no.
Own the portfolio view: solution status, cost, and return, tracked consistently across initiatives and refreshed on a predictable cadence.
Act as product owner for AI CoE deliverables — backlog, requirements, acceptance criteria, release sequencing — for agents, enablement assets, internal tooling, and shared AI capabilities.
Present roadmap, portfolio health, adoption, and business value to the Executive Leadership Team and program sponsors; quantify cautiously, surface risks early, and bring decisions rather than status.
Define and own the measurement framework across activity, capability, and business-outcome tiers, including cost-per-outcome and ROI for delivered solutions, and hold the line against vanity and surveillance metrics.
Manage delivery partners and vendors against an explicit ownership map — scope and SOW, named points of contact, communications cadence, content-review turnaround, milestone gates, and off-ramp terms.
Protect the transition from vendor-delivered to Sphera-owned: ensure every partner-delivered component has a named internal owner shadowing it from the start, so nothing stalls when an engagement ends.
Tie the roadmap to corporate OKRs and departmental needs, and work with each function to define what success looks like in their terms.
Own the governance interface with InfoSec, Legal, and Compliance — acceptable use, risk classification, access model, and audit requirements — and keep the governed path the fastest path.
Run the program's operating rhythm: steering meetings, status, risk and dependency management, budget and license forecasting, and the decision log.
Maintain the feedback loop from field signal, usage data, surveys, and champion input into roadmap and prioritization changes.
Partner with the Senior AI Enablement Lead, who owns curriculum and delivery, and with AI CoE architects and Platform Engineering on technical dependencies and sequencing.

Required Skills And Experience

Roadmap and Program Ownership

8-10 years in product ownership, program management, or transformation delivery, including 2+ years owning a technology or AI portfolio roadmap at enterprise scale.
Demonstrated ownership of an initiative roadmap from intake through delivery — prioritization under constraint, transparent trade-off decisions, and dependency and risk management across workstreams.
Product-owner discipline: backlog management, clear requirements and acceptance criteria, release sequencing, and saying no with a reason.
Experience building and defending business cases — cost modeling, ROI, and value realization tracking for technology investments.
Vendor and partner management: scoping, SOW support, milestone-based performance management, and clean handoff or exit.
Experience designing measurement frameworks for programs where the outcome is behavioral change and business value, not a shipped feature.
Track record influencing across functions without direct authority, including with InfoSec, Legal, HR, and senior business leadership.

AI Fluency

Strong working fluency with the enterprise AI landscape — Claude, Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and AI embedded in SaaS applications — enough to make informed scope, sequencing, and build-vs-buy calls.
Hands-on personal use of AI in your own work; credibility in this role comes from doing, not from briefing.
Understanding of AI governance and risk in an enterprise setting — acceptable use, data handling, access tiering, and auditability.

Job purpose:
The Product Owner is the execution arm of the product team and is accountable for translating product direction, roadmap initiatives, and customer needs into clearly defined, prioritised, and deliverable work for Agile development teams. The role owns the product backlog and sprint-level execution, ensuring that development teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how successful delivery will be validated.

Core responsibilities:
Product Backlog and Prioritization
Own, maintain, groom, and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with product goals, customer needs, business value, and delivery dependencies.
Lead backlog refinement and ensure items are clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritised, and ready for development.
Assess feature requests, enhancements, defects, and competing demands; recommend sequencing and trade-offs in collaboration with the Product Manager.

Requirements and User Stories
Translate roadmap initiatives and customer or business needs into epics, user stories, workflows, business rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
Break down complex initiatives into manageable increments that can be delivered and validated through Agile sprints.
Clarify functional behaviour, use cases, edge cases, and dependencies for Engineering and QA.
Review completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm whether the agreed requirements have been met.

Agile Delivery and Team Enablement
Work as the product domain expert and primary point of contact for the development team on backlog scope and requirement clarification.
Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant Agile ceremonies; support the team in maintaining sprint-level momentum.
Monitor sprint goals, backlog readiness, scope changes, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks through the appropriate channels.
Partner with Engineering and QA to support feature validation, quality, and delivery against agreed priorities.

Customer and Stakeholder Collaboration
Work with Product Managers and relevant customer-facing teams to understand customer feedback and translate it into actionable product backlog items.
Drive early feedback on new features and incorporate validated insights into backlog refinement and prioritization.
Communicate priorities, scope decisions, requirement changes, and delivery expectations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Build alignment where stakeholders have competing needs, using product priorities and customer value to guide recommendations.

Continuous Improvement and Senior-Level Contribution
Identify opportunities to improve story quality, backlog health, team collaboration, and product delivery practices.
Use delivery and quality feedback to identify recurring requirement gaps, reduce avoidable rework, and improve sprint readiness.
Share product domain knowledge and provide guidance or mentorship to less experienced Product Owners and team members, where applicable.

Role Focus and Responsibility Boundaries
Maintain focus on product backlog ownership, requirement clarity, and sprint-level product execution in alignment with the Product Manager/CPO.
Tier 2 support and technical triage are owned by Support/DevOps teams; project management and Scrum Master responsibilities by Delivery roles; customer demos and training by Enablement/Presales; and code contribution by Development teams.
Other duties as assigned.

Required experience and skills:
8+ years of experience in Product Ownership, product delivery, software product development, or a closely related role, with substantial hands-on Product Owner experience.
Mandatory: Relevant experience in the Packaging industry/domain, with specific exposure to CLF (Cartons, Labels & Flexibles). Understanding of packaging workflows, products, and industry-specific business processes is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs for software products, ideally within a global SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Strong capability in writing epics and detailed user stories, defining measurable acceptance criteria, and translating customer needs and roadmap initiatives into development-ready work.
Proven experience working with Agile/Scrum development teams and contributing effectively to sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Ability to prioritize competing requirements by considering customer impact, business value, product priorities, effort, and dependencies.
Experience working closely with Product Managers, developers, QA, Support, Implementation, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and product quality/acceptance processes.
Ability to act as a domain expert for delivery teams, resolve requirement ambiguity, facilitate decisions, and communicate scope and priority changes effectively.
Experience with JIRA and familiarity with Confluence, Agile boards, backlog tools, and customer feedback tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed SaaS business.
Experience mentoring colleagues or improving product ownership practices is an advantage.
Business-level English proficiency (written and verbal) required.
