About The Subscription Product And This Role

Sleek's revenue is overwhelmingly recurring: corporate secretary, accounting and compliance services are sold as annual subscriptions, and each year roughly a quarter of that entitlement base comes up for renewal through a process that remains, in large part, manual. Sales and account teams chase, remind, negotiate and collect; the product nudges but does not yet decide. The gap between the renewal rate we achieve and the rate the service quality warrants is revenue leakage, and closing it is the mandate of this role.

Mission: Own the subscription renewal journey from first renewal notice to collected payment, and convert it from a team-driven effort into a system-driven engine that raises the renewal rate and the share of renewals collected automatically.

We are looking for a commercially astute Product Manager on a contract basis who will sit between product, sales and finance and be measured on the renewal number itself. This person is hands on with data and experimentation, comfortable reading a collections ledger and a funnel dashboard in the same sitting, and expects to be in the room when sales sets its weekly renewal targets. The role is a lean one with real ownership over the renewal experience, the auto-renewal and auto-collection mechanics, and the commercial levers that govern them.

Primary Accountability

You own the renewal number and the three levers that move it.

#1: Renewal target, jointly with sales. Own the renewal rate across markets and plans alongside the sales and account management leads. Build the renewal pipeline view that shows every entitlement coming due by cohort, risk and value; agree weekly targets with sales; and own the product-side actions that lift conversion on the cohorts sales cannot reach by hand
#2: Automated renewal and collection. Own the auto-renewal engine and the share of renewals that are charged and collected without human intervention, including payment-method coverage, card and mandate capture at the right lifecycle moments, retry and dunning logic, and the policy for late payment, service restriction and reactivation
#3: Renewal experience and commercial levers. Own the customer-facing renewal journey (notices, reminders, pricing presentation, plan changes, upgrades triggered by usage or compliance complexity) and the experiment programme that tests which messages, timings, incentives and defaults change behaviour, with a bias toward auto-charge by default and clear consent. 

Key outcomes

Renewal rate up, measurably and by cohort: The renewal rate rises against an agreed baseline, with the improvement attributable to specific product changes and experiments rather than to sales effort alone
A larger share of renewals collected automatically: Auto-collection as a share of total entitlements increases through higher payment-method coverage, earlier mandate capture and more reliable retry logic, reducing the volume sales must chase by hand
A single renewal pipeline both sales and product work from: Every entitlement coming due is visible by market, plan, risk and value; sales works the list, product works the levers, and both report to the same number
An experimentation cadence that compounds: A standing programme of tests on renewal messaging, timing, incentives, defaults and pricing presentation, each with a hypothesis, a sample, a read-out and a decision, run on a weekly or fortnightly rhythm
Fewer leaks at the edges: Failed payments, lapsed services, downgrades and silent churn are classified, counted and owned, and the handling of each is either automated or assigned to a named process

What You Will Do

Run a weekly renewal review with sales and account management: what is due, what is at risk, what converted, what failed, and which product change would have changed the result
Pull and model the renewal data yourself: cohort renewal curves, payment-method coverage, failed-payment recovery, time from notice to payment, and the revenue at stake in each segment
Design, launch and read out experiments on the renewal journey, from reminder cadence and channel to pricing presentation, incentives and default settings, and turn winning variants into the standing flow
Specify changes to the auto-renewal engine with engineering: charge timing, retry schedules, dunning sequences, mandate and card capture, plan-change handling and the rules for service restriction and reactivation
Work with finance on collection policy, invoicing, credit terms and the reconciliation of collected renewals, so that what the product charges and what finance recognises agree
Instrument the renewal funnel end to end and publish a dashboard that sales, finance and product leadership read every week
Listen to renewal calls and read customer replies to understand why customers hesitate, and feed those reasons into both the product backlog and sales playbooks
Identify upgrade and cross-sell triggers at renewal (usage, compliance complexity, headcount) and build the prompts and offers that surface them
Ship fast and check your own work: write the spec, review the build, test the flow on a real account, and watch the first week of data

Requirements

4 to 6 years of experience building digital products, with a meaningful portion spent owning a subscription, billing, renewal, retention or monetisation surface where you were measured on a revenue or retention number
Commercially astute: you understand entitlements, pricing, discounting, collections and the P&L consequences of each, and you can hold your own in a conversation with a sales lead and a finance controller
Strong with data and experimentation: fluent in SQL or an equivalent, able to size a cohort, design an A/B test with adequate power, and read the result without an analyst in the loop
Attention to detail: you notice the mis-timed reminder, the failed retry, the wrong currency on the invoice, and you fix it before the customer does
Incredibly hands on: you write the spec, QA the build, pull the numbers and run the review yourself; this is a lean setup with no layer between you and the work
Track record of shipping and iterating on real products used by paying customers, in close partnership with engineering and commercial teams

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.

Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.

Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.

Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.

Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.

Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.

Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

Qualifications

6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.

Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.

Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.

Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.

Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.

Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.

Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.

Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.

Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.

Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.

Role Overview

Valor PayTech is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own the internal software development lifecycle for our Valor Gateway and Portal — the system of record that powers the entire Credit card processing, Payment Gateway, POS Terminals, SWITCH processing, ECOM Channel, Virtual terminal including ACH capability, and ISVs support. This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, process, and engineering execution.

You will report directly to the Senior Technical Product Manager and act as the operational and technical backbone of the Gateway’s roadmap — translating business priorities into clear, complete engineering requirements, managing sprint execution, and ensuring releases are delivered with quality and on schedule. Above all, this role owns the discipline of getting analysis right the first time: before a change reaches engineering, you are accountable for enumerating its full impact across the platform, so that what we build is consistent, complete, and free of the gaps that surface late in production.

This role does not require coding ability, but candidates with hands-on technical fluency (SQL, scripting, API / data literacy) will be considered a strong asset given the complexity of the systems involved.

What We’re Looking For

Four qualities define success in this role:

A Self-Starter and Owner — You take end-to-end ownership of your platform’s SDLC without waiting to be directed. You drive backlog, analysis, and releases forward, chase down open questions across teams, and treat every gap between intent and delivery as yours to close.

Technically Fluent — You are comfortable in the details of a complex payments platform — transaction flows, data models, integrations, and configuration — and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers and QA. You reason about systems, not just features.

Rigorous and Complete — You do not stop at the happy path. Before a change is committed, you systematically map its full impact surface — every transaction type, user persona, device population, credential form, processing feature, integration rail, and configuration state it could touch — so nothing is silently left behind. Completeness of analysis is the single most important thing this role protects.

A Strong Executor and Communicator — You run disciplined agile ceremonies, write specifications engineering can build against without guessing, and communicate clearly with a US-based team — turning business and compliance needs into precise, unambiguous requirements.

What You’ll Own

SDLC Ownership and Delivery

End-to-end SDLC management for Valor Gateway and Portal — backlog grooming, sprint planning, release coordination, and go-live sign-off, working closely with engineering leads and QA.

Project estimation and resource planning, partnering with the Senior Technical Product Manager on scoping, prioritization, and developer-day forecasting.

Release documentation, including change logs, workflow enhancement specs, and cross-processor integration notes.

Own phase one of the SDLC — analysis and requirements gathering — as the point where quality is decided. For every change, enumerate the complete impact surface before engineering commits. Facilitate pre-commitment reviews with engineering and QA — a shared walkthrough of scope and impact before build begins.

Translate business and compliance requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can execute against without ambiguity.

Platform Domain: Valor Payment Gateway and ISV Project

Handling ISVs requirements, lining up for work

What You’ll Bring

7+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, or a closely related role, ideally within fintech, payments, banking, or merchant services.

Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) with hands-on experience in Product Management to build the strategy, roadmap, discovery and execution of our GST and e-invoicing platform.

This role sits at the intersection of tax regulations, finance operations and technology. You will be responsible for translating evolving statutory requirements and real-world taxpayer challenges into scalable, intuitive and technology-led SaaS products.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory & Product Planning

• Bring GST and Compliance expertise to product development, so that features are accurate, follow the law and are ready for regulatory changes on time.

 Track GST Council decisions, CBIC/GSTN notifications and IRP/NIC changes, and turn them into product initiatives delivered ahead of compliance deadlines.

• Help prioritise initiatives based on customer impact, business value, regulatory urgency and technical feasibility.

• Spot market gaps and customer needs across enterprises, ERP ecosystems, GSPs/ASPs, tax practitioners and CA firms.

Domain Ownership

• Own the functional understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills.

• Translate law, rules and notifications into clear requirements, business rules, validations and user workflows.

• Define reconciliation logic and exception handling that improve accuracy, cut manual effort and reduce compliance risk.

Discovery & Execution

• Talk to customers, finance teams and CAs to understand workflows and pain points; validate ideas through prototypes and feedback.

• Identify AI and automation opportunities such as invoice data extraction, anomaly detection and reconciliation assistance.

• Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios; work with engineering on APIs, ERP integrations and system workflows.

• Lead UAT and functional validation to ensure regulatory accuracy and quality before release.

Required Skills & Experience

Must-Have

Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) with a demonstrated transition into Product Management.

Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Indian indirect tax, particularly GST law and processes, GST returns, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Exposure to GSP/ASP ecosystems, GSTN, IRP and NIC APIs

Product experience: Hands-on experience across the product lifecycle (discovery, requirements, launch, iteration), ideally in compliance, tax-tech or fintech SaaS.

 Documentation: Clear PRDs, user stories, functional specs and test scenarios.

 Technical understanding: Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and ERP/accounting platforms; comfortable working with engineers.

Data & communication: Uses data and customer insights to make decisions; communicates well across engineering, business, customer success and leadership.

Prior experience in tax advisory, statutory audit, finance operations or enterprise compliance before transitioning into Product Management

Good to Have

Experience building AI-enabled products or features, with an understanding of AI capabilities and their application in compliance and finance workflows.

Experience working with enterprise customers and ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.

Understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise SaaS requirements.

Qualifications

Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for Product Management

Why N-able:

At N-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end-to-end platform blends AI-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.

What You'll Do:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a defined area spanning network discovery and asset monitoring, including its roadmap and delivery. Network discovery is about finding and mapping the devices and assets in a customer's environment. Asset monitoring covers monitoring for security, device health, and device observability. The two connect closely, since you can only monitor what you can see, but each is an area in its own right with its own problems, users, and roadmap. You'll work with the guidance of a Principal PM or product leadership on strategy, and you'll be trusted to run day-to-day execution on your own.

N-able PMs are full-stack PMs. You'll partner closely with engineering on what gets built and why, but the job doesn't stop at the backlog. You're expected to understand how MSPs operate, how customer environments are built and monitored, the competitive landscape, and where the technology is heading, and to bring that into decisions others can act on. You'll regularly be in front of partners and customers.

Product areas at N-able are flexible. As priorities and the market evolve, the areas our PMs own can change, and your focus may shift or broaden over time. We're looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity to grow.

Own the roadmap and delivery for your area across network discovery and asset monitoring, contributing to its strategy and covering the lifecycle from discovery to launch.

Partner day to day with engineering and architecture to deliver capabilities that measurably improve discovery coverage, monitoring coverage and accuracy, time to detect device issues, time to onboard, and technician efficiency.
Run continuous discovery with MSP partners, internal IT teams, and prospects, separating what people ask for from what they actually need.
Track the competitive landscape (RMM, network discovery and monitoring, asset monitoring, observability, ITOM) for your area and feed it into positioning and roadmap decisions.
Build reliability, scalability, security, performance, and ease of use into product design, particularly for monitoring at scale across many customer environments.
Define and track success metrics for your area, such as adoption, retention, and monitoring coverage, and act when they move the wrong way.
Work with product marketing, sales, and support on launches, enablement, webinars, and analyst or customer briefings.
Take on new or changing product areas as priorities shift, bringing your learning and good practice with you.
Support and informally mentor newer product managers, sharing good practice with the team.
What You'll Bring:
7+ years in product management, including at least 2 years on SaaS products in IT management, network management, monitoring, or related infrastructure domains.
Technical background in IT infrastructure, endpoint, and network management technologies, and a strong understanding of how MSPs manage IT for their customers.
Self-motivation and comfort with ambiguity and change. You can take a loosely defined problem, make decisions, communicate them, and follow through with moderate supervision, and you adapt well when your area of focus shifts.
Strong product sense: good instincts for what to build, what to cut, and what "good" looks like for a technician managing many customer environments under time pressure.
A track record of shipping SaaS products in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and clear, professional communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree; a Master's degree is preferred.

Big Pluses
Hands-on experience with network discovery, network or asset monitoring, RMM, observability, or ITOM tools, as a product manager, practitioner, or administrator.
Working knowledge of discovery and monitoring technologies (e.g., SNMP, WMI, flow data, topology mapping, asset inventory, agent-based and agentless monitoring, telemetry).
Understanding of security monitoring of assets, such as configuration and patch posture, vulnerability exposure, or endpoint security signals.
Direct experience managing and monitoring production infrastructure.
Relevant certifications (e.g., Network+, CCNA, Security+) or a background in IT operations, network engineering, or security.
Experience building AI-powered product capabilities, such as anomaly detection or intelligent alerting.

Group Medical , Personal Accident & Term life coverage
Generous PTO and observed holidays
2 Paid VoluNteer Days per year
Employee Stock Purchase Program
FuN-raising opportunities as part of our giving program
N-ablite Learning – custom learning experience as part of our investment in you

The Senior Manager Product Manager will serve as a Digital Product Owner for a defined portfolio of R&D Commercialization technology products and systems and as the Amgen India (AIN) technology lead for R&D Commercialization and PPM.

This role is accountable for translating R&D Commercialization business priorities into product roadmaps, investment priorities, delivery plans, and measurable technology outcomes. The individual will maintain primary relationships with key business stakeholders for their assigned product portfolio and ensure technology investments and team capacity remain aligned to the highest-value business needs.

As the AIN lead for Commercialization, this individual will provide direct people leadership for AIN-based technology staff supporting Commercialization, including talent development, performance management, workforce planning, and building the skills and capabilities required to support an evolving Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM).

The successful candidate will combine product ownership, business relationship management, people leadership, and technology delivery experience. Translate business needs and strategic priorities into clearly defined product capabilities, value drops, features, and prioritized backlogs.

Partner with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, and delivery teams to define product outcomes, requirements, acceptance criteria, and measures of success.
Ensure product teams understand the business processes, users, outcomes, and value their products enable.
Make day-to-day product prioritization and capacity decisions within established strategic and investment guardrails.
Maintain visibility into product health, roadmap execution, value realization, risks, technical debt, and lifecycle needs.

Business Stakeholder Relationship Management

Serve as a primary technology relationship leader for designated R&D Commercialization business stakeholders and capability areas.
Develop a deep understanding of Commercialization business processes, strategic priorities, operational challenges, and emerging technology, data, and AI opportunities.
Build trusted relationships with business leaders and process owners and act as a strategic technology advisor rather than solely a delivery point of contact.
Facilitate prioritization discussions that balance stakeholder demand with product strategy, technology capacity, enterprise standards, and expected business value.
Partner with stakeholders to develop business cases, investment recommendations, roadmap priorities, and measurable product outcomes.
Communicate product strategy, roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and key decisions to business and technology leadership.
Proactively identify opportunities where technology, data, automation, analytics, or AI can improve Commercialization outcomes.

AIN Leadership & People Management

Directly manage assigned AIN Information Systems staff, including goal setting, performance management, coaching, career development, engagement, and talent planning.
Recruit, interview, onboard, develop, and retain talent needed to support Commercialization's evolving digital product portfolio.
Establish clear role expectations and ensure staff understand how their contributions connect to product outcomes and broader R&D priorities.
Develop technical, product, business analysis, Agile, data, and AI capabilities within the AIN organization based on current and future portfolio needs.
Coach staff toward greater ownership, independent decision-making, business understanding, and product-oriented ways of working.
Support workforce and capacity planning across Commercialization product teams, including alignment of skills and resources to product demand.
Foster strong collaboration between AIN and US-based staff and create an integrated global team operating model rather than location-based delivery silos.

DPOM & Product Operating Model Leadership

Champion adoption of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) within the assigned Commercialization product portfolio.
Help ensure delivery toward persistent product teams accountable for business outcomes and product lifecycle management.
Establish clear product ownership, prioritization, decision rights, roadmap management, and stakeholder engagement practices.
Partner with Release Train/Delivery leadership to establish effective execution practices across multiple product teams.
Ensure business priorities and product roadmaps provide the direction for Agile planning and execution.
Promote outcome-oriented product management, including clear measures of value and product performance.
Partner with enterprise DPOM and Agile enablement organizations to align Commercialization ways of working with evolving enterprise standards.

Portfolio, Investment & Governance

Support annual and ongoing technology planning, budgeting, forecasting, and investment management for the assigned product portfolio.
Develop and maintain appropriate business cases and investment recommendations for new capabilities, enhancements, lifecycle needs, and technology modernization.
Partner with Digital Product Management leadership on investment governance and funding processes.
Ensure products navigate applicable architecture, security, data, AI, technology, and investment governance processes and operate in compliance with standards.
Balance investment across new business capabilities, operational sustainability, lifecycle requirements, technical debt, and innovation.
Ensure appropriate product ownership exists across the full lifecycle—from discovery and investment through delivery, operation, enhancement, and retirement.

Product Delivery & Operational Accountability

Partner with Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineers, and other delivery roles to translate roadmaps into executable delivery plans.
Participate actively in PI Planning, roadmap planning, backlog refinement, product reviews, and other key product and Agile ceremonies.
Ensure product backlogs are appropriately prioritized and sufficiently mature to support effective team execution.
Resolve product-level decisions and prioritization conflicts that could impede delivery.
Monitor roadmap execution and adjust priorities based on business needs, capacity, risk, dependencies, and learning.
Ensure appropriate ownership of production health, incidents, lifecycle needs, and operational sustainability for assigned products.
Use operational, delivery, adoption, and value metrics to inform product decisions and continuous improvement.

Technology, Data & AI Leadership

Maintain sufficient understanding of the Commercialization technology landscape to make informed product and investment decisions.
Partner closely with Technical Leads and enterprise architecture teams to ensure product roadmaps account for enterprise technology strategy, architecture standards

While this is not a hands-on coding role, you’ll need well-developed technical fluency in LLMs, retrieval and grounding, and platform services to bridge engineering, data, and business teams across SAP’s ecosystem.

You will help create a plan for procurement applications and AI features. These features include assistants, agents, recommendations, insights, and automation. You will also ensure that everything aligns with Joule, SAP Knowledge Graph, the SAP Business Data Cloud, and central AI services. You’ll collaborate with engineering and platform teams to manage dependencies, accelerate delivery, and ensure consistency across products. In addition, you’ll work closely with other procurement and enterprise PMs to define how intelligent agents, shared models, and orchestration frameworks integrate across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems. This role will be pivotal in guiding teams toward an AI-first procurement experience, ensuring our products remain interoperable, grounded, and future-ready.

Shape Product and AI Strategy: Contribute and drive the procurement application and AI roadmap aligning with Joule, KG, BDC, central AI services, and support user research and customer events.

Ensure product definition: Incorporate customer input into product definitions, prioritize and describe backlog, align stakeholders on scope, and ensure rollout planning.
Ensure product delivery: Contribute to product vision, design, testing, sprint acceptance, rollout materials, and delivery. Validate scope, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and ensure high-quality software each sprint.
Lead Discovery: Identify high-impact AI opportunities by analyzing customer pain points, data gaps, and market trends.

Define Success Metrics: Establish and track KPIs for product and AI performance, adoption, and business impact to guide continuous improvement.
Ensure Data Quality: Collaborate with PMs to build ground-truth datasets and evaluate ML/AI feature quality using quantitative and qualitative signals.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with UX, platform, and domain teams to ensure consistent, contextual AI experiences across the procurement suite.
Drive Market Alignment: Partner with Product Marketing to articulate product and AI vision, differentiation, and customer value for go-to-market success.

Belong

We are part of the SAP Ariba Product Management organization. Our mission is to be the single front-door for end users to simplify their work and automate business workflows. Role: Associate Product Manager

About The Function

Flights is MakeMyTrip’s flagship business, serving millions of travellers across domestic and international routes. Within it, Flights Supply is the engine behind every fare a customer sees, books and gets serviced on. It covers connectivity with airlines, GDS, NDC and aggregators, and the content, pricing and servicing capabilities built on top.

As the business scales, the supply stack must be more reliable, more accurate and less dependent on manual effort. We are building supply systems that detect problems before customers do, keep content and pricing in parity with the source, and use AI to automate work that has traditionally been manual.

The Flights Supply team combines deep distribution knowledge, data-driven decision making and strong engineering partnerships. Product managers, analysts, engineers, designers and business teams work together to make every booking dependable and every servicing journey efficient .

About The Role

We are looking for a Assistant Manager, Product Management to own a workstream within Flights Supply, such as supply-side conversion, content and pricing accuracy, or airline and ancillary integrations. This role requires strong product thinking, a quick grasp of technical systems, execution excellence and a passion for solving problems with data and AI.

You will take features and projects from problem definition to launch, working closely with engineering, airline and distribution partners, finance, customer support and the funnel product team. You will shape the direction of your workstream and be accountable for its results

What will you be doing

Own the roadmap and delivery for a defined area of the funnel, and shape its direction and priorities in line with the overall funnel strategy. 
Identify friction and drop-offs in the booking journey through data, customer feedback and competitor benchmarking, and turn them into well-scoped product opportunities. 
Write clear PRDs and detailed user stories, and groom them in depth with tech so edge cases are covered before development, not after go-live. 
Work with design to craft simple, high-converting experiences across app, web and mobile web. 
Define hypotheses and success metrics, run A/B experiments, and read the results with rigour before drawing conclusions. 
Track funnel metrics such as search-to-book conversion, step-wise drop-offs by channel, platform and region, page performance and revenue per booking. Build dashboards and keep them current. 
Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research and routine work, and contribute ideas for AI-led booking and discovery experiences. 
Support launches of new features and experiences across the funnel, working with business, marketing and supply teams. 
Run execution from concept to launch and post-launch optimisation, and flag risks and delays early. 
You Will Operate At The Intersection Of

You will find high-impact opportunities, validate solutions quickly and ship products that create measurable value for customers and the business 

Consumer Product + Growth + Data Science + AI-powered Experiences 
Conversion + Engagement + Monetisation 
Customer Understanding + Data-Driven Decision Making

Qualification & Experience

Engineering or Management graduates from reputed institutes with 1 to 3 years of experience in product management, product analytics or growth roles in a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business. 
Experience working with data. Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and SQL is expected, along with the habit of checking your own numbers before sharing them. 
Understanding of agile product development, including requirement definition, prioritisation and metric tracking. 
Experience with A/B testing and product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel or Microsoft Clarity will be an added advantage.

Strong product thinking, with the ability to turn ambiguous problems into structured solutions.

High ownership mindset, with the ability to drive work independently from ideation to launch and communicate delays early.

As we scale our lending business, we are focused on improving customer acquisition, onboarding and conversion across the entire lending journey.

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own and optimise the end-to-end customer acquisition and onboarding funnel.

The primary objective of this role is to minimise customer drop-offs while maximising conversion and customer experience. You will own the customer journey from the initial acquisition touchpoint through application, KYC, bank verification, credit assessment, mandate registration and loan disbursal.

This role requires close collaboration with Marketing, Credit/Risk and Engineering teams to ensure seamless integrations, reduce friction across the journey and continuously improve funnel performance.

Works closely with: Marketing, Credit & Risk, Engineering and Analytics

Key Responsibilities

1. Funnel Ownership & Optimisation

Own and optimise the end-to-end customer journey, identifying friction points and drop-offs at every stage.
Track stage-wise conversion, completion rates and turnaround times to identify opportunities for improvement.
Drive initiatives to improve application completion, onboarding success and overall disbursal conversion. 
Analyse customer behaviour across different acquisition channels, devices and customer segments.

2. Customer Onboarding Experience

Own and improve critical onboarding journeys, including application forms, KYC, bank account verification, mandate registration and other pre-disbursal processes.
Ensure onboarding journeys are intuitive, seamless and reliable.
Identify opportunities to simplify customer interactions, reduce repetitive steps and improve completion rates.
Work with Engineering and external service providers to resolve technical failures and integration-related friction.
3. Marketing & Acquisition Integrations

Work closely with Marketing to optimise top-of-funnel integrations, campaign landing journeys, lead capture and acquisition flows.
Ensure seamless transition from marketing touchpoints to the product journey.
Improve tracking and attribution across acquisition sources and customer journeys.
Enable effective integration between marketing platforms and internal lending systems.

4. Credit & Risk Integrations

Work with Credit and Risk teams to integrate bureau checks, credit models, eligibility criteria and policy rules into the customer journey.
Ensure credit assessment and policy-related processes are seamlessly embedded into the application flow.
Identify and minimise unnecessary customer friction arising from credit checks, verification processes and policy integrations.
Balance conversion objectives with underwriting and regulatory requirements.

5. Product Execution & Experimentation

Work closely with Engineering, Design and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into product specifications.
Drive A/B testing and experiments across different stages of the funnel.
Use data and customer insights to prioritise product improvements.
Monitor post-launch performance and measure the impact of product changes on conversion and customer experience.

What We're Looking Fo 

2-4 years of prior experience owning or managing customer onboarding funnels in a digital lending or fintech application.
Hands-on experience with lending journeys involving KYC, bank account verification, mandate setup and loan disbursal.
Strong understanding of customer acquisition and onboarding journeys, including integrations between marketing platforms, lending systems and third-party service providers.
Ability to analyse funnel data, identify conversion bottlenecks and translate insights into actionable product improvements.
Strong execution orientation with the ability to work across multiple teams and drive initiatives independently.
Good understanding of product metrics, user experience and experimentation.

Good to Have

Prior experience in digital lending, NBFCs, fintech or consumer-facing financial services.
Familiarity with bureau integrations, credit underwriting systems and lending policy engines.
Experience working with KYC providers, penny-drop/bank verification services and mandate providers.
Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, CleverTap or equivalent.
Understanding of digital lending regulations and customer onboarding requirements.

Why Join CreditSea?

Build and own: Take end-to-end ownership of critical customer journeys and shape how customers experience digital lending.

Business impact: Directly influence customer conversion, acquisition efficiency and disbursal growth.

Ownership and visibility: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Credit and business leadership.

Opportunity to grow: Play an important role in building and scaling the product function as CreditSea grows

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
Excellent communication and presentation skills 
Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
Strong facilitation and negotiation skills 
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities 


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will be based in our Bengaluru, India office.

Purpose of the role

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities


Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements. 
Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. 
Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. 
Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. 
Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. 
Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. 
Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. 
Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals. 
Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Job Description – Associate Product Manager, Repayments & Collections
About CreditSea

CreditSea is an RBI-registered, digital-first NBFC operating at scale. We are building technology-led lending experiences that make borrowing simple, seamless and accessible for customers.

As we scale our lending business, we are focused on improving repayment experiences, increasing repayment efficiency and building robust systems to support collections operations.

The Role

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own and improve the end-to-end repayment experience.

The primary objective of this role is to make repayments seamless and convenient for customers while improving repayment success rates and collections efficiency.

You will work across customer-facing repayment journeys, payment integrations, reminders and collections-related product capabilities. The role requires a strong understanding of lending repayment cycles, payment mechanisms and collections metrics, along with the ability to drive execution across multiple stakeholders.

Works closely with: Collections, Finance, Engineering, Data & Analytics teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Repayment Journeys & Payment Integrations

Own and improve end-to-end repayment journeys across payment modes, including UPI, AutoPay/e-NACH, UPI AutoPay and other relevant payment mechanisms.
Improve repayment success rates by identifying friction across payment initiation, authentication, mandate registration, payment failures and retries.
Work with payment gateways, banks and external partners to improve payment reliability and success rates.
Enable flexible repayment options, including part-payments, early repayments and other customer-friendly repayment mechanisms.
Ensure accurate and seamless integration of repayment systems with internal lending platforms.

2. Repayment Experience & Customer Engagement

Build and optimise repayment reminders and nudges across channels such as WhatsApp, SMS, calls and app notifications.
Improve customer visibility into outstanding dues, repayment schedules, payment status and transaction history.
Identify opportunities to simplify repayment journeys and reduce failed or delayed payments.
Work on customer communication and self-service capabilities to reduce repayment-related friction.
Ensure a consistent repayment experience across different customer touchpoints.

3. Collections Product Capabilities

Develop a strong understanding of collections workflows, repayment cycles and delinquency management.
Work closely with Collections teams to improve product capabilities supporting early collections and overdue recovery.
Track and optimise key metrics such as repayment success rates, bounce rates, DPD buckets, roll rates and collection efficiency.
Build product capabilities that support more effective collection interventions and improve repayment behaviour.
Translate operational challenges and collections requirements into scalable product solutions.

4. Product Execution & Stakeholder Management

Work closely with Engineering, Design, Collections, Finance and other stakeholders to define requirements and drive initiatives end-to-end.
Translate business and operational requirements into clear product specifications, user stories and execution plans.
Prioritise initiatives based on customer experience, business impact, operational efficiency and implementation effort.
Coordinate with external payment partners and service providers for integrations and issue resolution. 
Drive testing, releases and post-launch monitoring to ensure product improvements deliver measurable outcomes.

What We're Looking For

2-4 years of Prior experience building or managing repayment journeys in a digital lending, fintech, payments or banking environment.
Hands-on experience with repayment mechanisms such as UPI, e-NACH, AutoPay, payment gateways and mandate management.
Strong understanding of lending collections processes and metrics, including bounce rates, DPD buckets, roll rates and collection efficiency.
Experience working on customer-facing repayment journeys and payment integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify problems and measure product impact.
Strong stakeholder management and execution skills, with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and drive initiatives independently.

Good to Have

Prior experience in a digital lending company, NBFC, bank or fintech.
Familiarity with loan management systems (LMS), repayment allocation, reconciliation and delinquency management.
Experience working with payment aggregators, banking partners and payment infrastructure providers.
Exposure to collections automation, customer communication platforms and digital collections channels.
Understanding of customer repayment behaviour across different DPD buckets. 

Why Join CreditSea?

Build and own: Take ownership of critical repayment journeys and payment integrations.

Business impact: Work on products that directly influence repayment rates, portfolio quality and collections efficiency.

Ownership and visibility: Work closely with business and technology leadership and drive initiatives across multiple functions.

Opportunity to grow: Play an important role in building scalable repayment technology as CreditSea grows.

Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will build the accounting infrastructure, workflows, and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve complex enterprise Finance customers. Second, you will help create a new generation of AI-powered accounting workflows that automate manual close work — from validating transaction coding and configuration readiness, to recovering failed syncs, reconciling activity, and preparing adjustments.

Rippling sits in a unique position between the systems where business activity originates and the ERP where the official books live. That gives us the context to automate work accountants perform manually today and to build an accounting product that can become a major platform in its own right.

What You Will Do

Set the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Accounting, with a clear point of view on how Rippling should help finance teams translate their operational activity in Rippling into accurate accounting outcomes. 
Build the core accounting platform behind Rippling’s Finance products, including the workflows customers use to configure rules, map data, post to their ERP, and resolve issues when syncs fail. 
Design product experiences that give accountants confidence in the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of their books. 
Lead the development of AI-assisted accounting workflows that help customers validate transactions, identify exceptions, recover from failures, and reduce manual close work. 
Partner deeply with engineering and design to turn complex accounting and integration problems into intuitive, reliable product experiences. 
Spend time with customers, implementation teams, support, accounting experts, and ERP partners to understand where accounting workflows break down and where the product can remove friction. 
Define how Rippling should support enterprise customers and their unique needs, like multi-entity setups, tax and currency needs, and high expectations for controls and reporting. 

What You Will Need

7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on complex B2B software. 
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear strategy. 
Experience building technically complex products that depend on integrations, data models, or platform infrastructure. 
A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the financial systems businesses use to run them, or the ability to quickly develop fluency in them. 
The ability to work closely with engineers on complex system and data problems. 
Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand. 
High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast-moving environment. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
